sngon 'gro'i gtam/〈zhib 'jug dang bden don〉 zhes pa 'di ni kho bos lo ngo bcu lhag gi ring la slob chen du slob gnyer gyi skabs dang dpe khrid kyi zhor la bris pa'i dpyad rtsom rnams phyogs gcig tu btus nas grub pa zhig yin/ 'di'i nang gi rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod la rags tsam dpyad pa zhes pa ni ko drug lor mtsho sngon mi rigs slob grwa chen mo nas dngos gzhi slob mthar phyin khar bris pa'i bslab gnas kyi dpyad rtsom yin la/ phyis su go dgu lo'i 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉 deb dang por bkod/ gtan tshigs rig pa dang phyi tshul gtan tshigs rig pa gnyis kyi rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa phan tshun bsdur nas dpyad pa zhes pa ni nyis stong gcig lor slob chen de'i zhib 'jug slob ma'i 'dzin grwa nas thon skabs mthar phyin 'bras rtags su bris pa yin zhing / de las tshan pa 'ga' re snga rjes su nyis stong gnyis lo'i 〈krung go'i bod rig pa〉 yi deb gnyis pa dang bzhi par bkod/mdo smad dhī ཿtsha dgon pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs thad kyi 'gyur ldog skor rags tsam gleng ba zhes pa ni nyis stong dgu lor shang gang rgya'i skad yig slob grwa chen mor bsdus pa'i 9ya gling gi rig gnas dang chos lugs zhib 'jug〉〉 ces pa'i 'dzin grwar zhugs te kha byang la mdo smad dge lugs pa'i grwa btsun gyi 'tsho ba'i 'gyur ldog ces pa'i dpyad rtsom zhig bris pa las tshan pa zhig 'dir bod yig tu bsgyur pa dang / bod mi'i rus rgyud kyi ming gi gnad don 'ga' gleng ba zhes pa ni nyis stong bcu lo'i zla brgyad par khā na ta'i ban kho bur bsdus pa'i rgyal spyi'i bod rig pa'i gros tshogs thengs bcu gnyis pa'i thog 'chad ston byas pa'i dpyad rtsom dang / bsdus gzhung la 'jug — 1 —
tshul las 'phros pa'i bsam gzhigs zhes pa ni nyis stong bcu gcig lo'i zla bcu bar lho nub mi rigs slob chen du bsdus pa'i rgyal yongs skabs bdun pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i bgro gleng tshogs 'du'i thog 'chad ston byas/ jo mo dam chos pad mas brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas lha sar gnas mjal du phebs tshul skor gleng ba zhes pa ni h+phin lan he 'od gser mkhar slob grwa chen mo'i zhib 'jug gi las gzhi (tsamatsho sngon sa cha'i mi rigs bar gyi 'brel 'dris/〉〉 (ji beb/0 /nga cang yo/07 7778779181/0'a /nga 8770 'a/nga657/) zhes par zhugs nas bris pa'i dpyad rtsom zhig yin la/ phyis su mjal ba dang lta skor ba'i 'tshol nyul/ (9//thang 45777ga46ca//cang5 /0 528705 0(456 50/sto ) zhes par bkod zin pa 'dir bod yig tu bsgyur pa yin/rtsom yig gzhan rnams kyang 〈krung go'i bod rig pa/〉 dang / 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉 sogs su spel zin pa'i ma yig la bzo bcos nyung tsam byas te 'dir bkod pa yin/ dpe deb 'di'i nang du col chung kho bos bod kyi tshad ma rig pa dang / chos lugs rig gnas/ dgon sde'i slob gso bcas kyi thad nas gnad don 'gar dpyad pa gtong khul re byas pa dang / rtsom gyi 'bri stangs dang]lung khungs 'dren tshul/ zur lta'i dpyad yig 'god tshul sogs la mi 'dra sa cung zad yod na yang ma phyi ltar sor bzhag byas yod/ bdag lta bu la brjod bya rjod byed gang thad nas mkhas pa mgu ba'i gsar bshad cig ngom rgyu med mod/ rang dang skal ba mnyam pa 'ga' la phan pa cung zad re 'byung srid snyam te dpe deb 'di nyid par du bskrun pa yin/zhes deb 'di'i rtsom pa po lhun grub rdo rje nas nyis stong gnyis lo'i zla bzhi ba'i tshes lnga nyin zi ling du bris/

mdo smad dhī ཿtsha dgon pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs thad kyi 'gyur ldog skor rags tsam gleng pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 143slob grwa chen mo'i bsdus grwa'i slob khrid thad kyi bsam tshul thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 161mi rigs slob grwa'i slob khrid thad kyi gnad don 'ga' gleng pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 172phyi gling gi slob grwa chen mo'i slob khrid byed thabs dang de'i dge mtshan skor cung zad gleng pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 183bod kyi skad yig slob gso la nye bar mkho ba'i phyi gling gi slob khrid byed sgo gal chen 'ga' blosang pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 199rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod la rags tsam dpyad pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 215bod mi'i rus rgyud kyi ming gi gnad don 'ga' gleng pa/ ༷ ༷ ༷ 230bod yig dus deb kyi dpyad rtsom tshad ldan du gtong ba'i gnad don 'gar dpyad pa/ ༷ 245mjug gi gtam/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 261
rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ba'i skor cung zad gleng pa/de yang spyi lo sngon gyi lo ngo stong phrag gcig gi yar sngon du rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du phyi nang gi grub mtha' mang po dar ba la brten nas tshad ma rig pa byung zhing / tshad ma'i bstan bcos rnams kyi thog ma ni rtsod pa grub pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos de yin par grags/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma phyogs kyi glang bo dang de'i slob ma dbang phyug sde/ dbang phyug sde'i slob ma chos kyi grags pa bcas kyis tshad ma kun btus dang rigs pa la 'jug pa'i sgo/ tshad ma sde bdun sogs mdzad pa nas bzung rgya gar du rim bzhin tshad ma rig pa dar zhing 'phel bar gyur la/bod yul du bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang zhang ye shes sde/ be+e ro tsa na bcas kyis rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i gzhung 'ga' zhig bsgyur kyang 'chad mnyan gyi srol med pas spel ma thub pa dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su zha ma seng rgyal dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po rma dge ba'i blo gros dang rngog blo ldan shes rab sogs kyis rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i bstan bcos mang po bod du bsgyur nas spel pa dang / de rnams la brten nas cha ba chos kyi seng ges tshad ma kun btus dang de'i dgongs 'grel tshad ma sde bdun gyi gnad thams cad phyogs gcig tu dril pa'i bsdus gzhung dang gzhung 'grel gsar du mdzad cing / 'chad mnyan gyi grwa btsugs nas spel te rgya cher dar bar byas pa yin/ rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i bstan bcos bod du 'gyur ba des bod gangs can gyi yul du tshad ma rig pa byung ba dang 'phel rgyas su phyin pa la nus pa chen po zhig thon yod/— 1 —
dngayo/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa rnams dngade dag gis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos/1 slob dpon phyogs glang dang khong gi tshad ma'i bstan bcos/slob dpon phyogs glang ni rgya gar lho phyogs kyi grong khyer seṅga pak+ta zhes bya bar bram ze'i rigs su 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas bram ze'i rig byed dang mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' la dpyis phyin par sbyangs/ gnas ma bu ba'i sde ba'i mkhan po nā ga dat+ta ste glang bo byin zhes pa las rab tu byung zhing mtshan la phyogs kyi glang bo zhes gsol/ sgra sogs rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs shing /mkhan po'i lta ba dang ma mthun pas gnas las bskrad/ de nas slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du byon nas theg pa che chung gi sde snod mtha' dag legs par gsan/ khyad par du tshad ma'i gzhung lugs la mkhas par sbyangs nas mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po rtsod pas pham par byas te nang bar bcug mdzod kyi 'grel ba dang / yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i 'grel ba/ dmigs pa brtag pa sogs bstan bcos brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad par grags/ phyis su rang gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos thor bur gnas pa rnams phyogs gcig tu dril te tshad ma'i bstan bcos chen po mdo kun las btus pa mdzad cing spel pas skye bo rnams kyi rigs pa'i sgo mo che cher phye/2 slob dpon chos grags dang khong gi tshad ma'i bstan bcos/slob dpon chos grags ni dus rabs bdun pa'i stod du rgya gar lho phyogs tri ma la ya'i yul du yab bram ze'i rigs kyi mu stegs kun tu rgyu sa ri khya naṇ+ḍa zhes bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs shing / chung dus nas blo rig shin tu mdzangs pas bzo rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ sgra rig pa sogs rig pa'i gnas kun la dpyis phyin par sbyangs pas lo ngo bcu phrag tsam gyis mu stegs pa'i gzhung lugs —2—
thams cad la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ mthar mu stegs pa'i gzhung lugs rnams kyi lta ba mtha' cadag phyin ci log tu mthong nas yul dbus su byon te slob dpon chos skyong las rab tu byung zhing /slob dpon phyogs glang gi dngos slob dbang phyug sde las tshad ma kun btus lan gsum gsan pas de'i dgongs pa ji bzhin du rtogs par gyur nas rigs pa'i stobs kyis phyi rol mu stegs pa'i mkhas pa mang po rtsod pas pham par byas te nang bar bcug slob dpon gyi bka' bzhin tshad ma kun btus kyi dgongs 'grel du rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ cung zad bsdus pa tshad ma rnam nges/ shin tu bsdus pa tshad ma rigs thigs te gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum dang / gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rgyud gzhan sgrub pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste 'phros pa yan lag lta bu'i bstan bcos bzhi ste tshad ma sde bdun mdzad de rgya cher spel/3 slob dpon lha dbang blo sogs dang khong tsho'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos/lha dbang blo ni slob dpon chos grags kyi dngos slob yin zhing / des slob dpon chos grags las tshad ma sde bdun rdzogs par gsan te slob dpon gyi bka' bzhin chos grags khong gis mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i rang 'grel la kha skong gi tshul du le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel ba mdzad/slob dpon gyi le'u dang po'i rang 'grel dang lha dbang blo'i le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel ba bcas la tshad ma stong phrag bcu gnyis par grags/ lha dbang blo'i slob ma shākya blos slob dpon chos grags las tshad ma sde bdun gsan cing / gtso bo lha dbang blo las tshad ma rig pa la thos gsan mdzad de mkhas par gyur/ des rnam 'grel gyi le'u bzhi dang tshad ma stong phrag bcu gnyis la 'grel ba shin tu rgya chen po mdzad/ shākya blo'i slob ma shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pas tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel ba rnam 'gre la gyi rgyan dang / lhan cig dmigs pa nges par grub pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa'i slob ma paṇa chen chos mchog gis tshad ma rnam — 3 —
nges kyi 'grel ba 'thad ldan che chung gnyis dang / tshad ma rnam nges kyi 'grel bshad le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel ba/ rigs pa'i thigs pa'i rab tu byed pa rgya cher 'grel ba/ tshad ma brtag pa che chung gnyis/ gzhan sel ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa/ 'jig rten pha rol grub pa/ skad cig ma 'jig pa grub pa bcas mdzad pa dang / de'i slob ma dza ma ris tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi 'grel bshad shin tu yongs su dag pa dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi mngon sum le'u'i 'grel ba/ rnam 'grel rgyan gyi le'u bzhi ba'i 'grel ba bcas mdzad pa dang / dza ma ri'i slob ma dul ba lhas rigs pa'i thigs pa'i rgya cher 'grel ba slob ma la phan pa zhes bya ba dang / gtan tshigs thigs pa'i rgya cher 'grel ba/ 'brel ba brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa/ rgyud gzhan grub pa'i 'grel bshad/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa'i 'grel ba/ dmigs pa brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa bcas mdzad/ dul ba lha'i slob ma shaṅka rā nan+da ste bram ze bde byed dga' bas tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bshad rnam 'grel gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i 'phro ji snyed pa dang / 'brel ba brtag pa'i rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba/ sel ba grub pa zhes bya ba/ 'brel ba grub pa bcas mdzad pa dang / yang dul ba lha'i slob ma shān+ta rak+ṣi ste zhi ba 'tshos tshud pa'i rigs pa'i 'grel ba don rnam par 'apyed 5 zhes khya ba dang / de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba mdzad/ zhi ba 'tsho'i slob ma ka ma la shi la ste pad+ma'i ngang tshul gyis rigs pa'i thigs pa'i phyogs snga ma mdor bsdus pa dang / de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i dka' 'grel ṭīk+ka tshad chen du grags pa mdzad/ bram ze bde byed dga' ba'i slob ma waṃ gu paṇ+ḍi ta dang / de'i slob ma kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shri yin/ gzhan yang slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa'i slob ma nyi ma sbas pas tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel ba dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi le'u gsum pa'i 'grel bshad bcas mdzad pa dang / slob dpon dz+nyā na shrī mi tra ste ye shes dpal bzang gis tshad ma rnam nges pa'i 'grel bshad dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngo bo grub pa/ rigs pa'i thigs pa'i don bsdus pa bcas mdzad/ slob dpon a tsa ṭas gtan tshigs thigs pa'i 'grel ba —4—
dang / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis rtsod pa grub pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba mdzad/ slob dpon dge srungs kyis thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang / phyi rol gyi don grub pa zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ thos pa brtag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ gzhan sel brtag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ dbang phyug 'jig pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa bcas mdzad pa dang / slob dpon bram ze mu tig bum pas skad cig ma 'jig pa grub pa'i rnam par 'grel ba mdzad/ slob dpon shan+ti pa ste rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas nang ba'i khyab pa dang / rnam par rig pa tsam nyid du grub pa sogs mdzad pa dang / dzi tā ri ste dgra las rgyal bas gtan tshigs kyi de kho na nyid bstan pa dang / chos dang chos can gtan la phab pa/ byis pa 'jug pa'i rtog ge sogs mdzad/ slob dpon thar ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pas rtog ge'i skad la 'jug pa zhes bya ba dang / slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes rigs pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba mdzad/ slob dpon rgyal ba can gyis tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi 'grel bshad dang / slob dpon rgyal ba'i dbang bo blo gros kyis tshad ma kun btus kyi 'grel ba yangs pa dang dri ma med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba mdzad pa yin/gnyis pa/ rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i bstan bcos bod du 'gyur tshul/1 bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su tshad ma'i bstan bcos bod du 'gyur tshul/bod kyi rgyal po thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas bod kyi rgyal rabs so gsum pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bar du bod du gcig gyur gyi yi ge ma byung la/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus su slob dpon thon mi sam bho ṭas legs sbyar gyi yi ge la dper blangs nas bod yig gsar bcos mdzad par ma zad/ nang ba'i chos gzhung las mdo sde dkon mchog sprin sogs mdo rgyud nyer gcig tu grags pa sogs gzhung lugs mang po bsgyur pa dang / rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang mu tig btsan —5 —
po sogs kyi skabs su/ bod du lo tsā ba mang po byon zhing rgya gar gyi mkhas pa mi nyung ba zhig spyan drangs te rgya gar gyi gzhung lugs mang po bod du bsgyur na yang / rgyal rabs zhe gcig pa mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyis rgyal srid skyong ba'i bar du bod yul du tshad ma'i bstan bcos nyung tsam las ma 'gyur bar mngon/ mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyis dgung lo bco brgyad par chab srid skyong ba'i dus su/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+t+ra bodhi/ shī lan+d+ra bornyi/ dā na shī la sogs spyan drangs shing / bod kyi lo tsā ba chen po ska ba dpal brtsegs dang / be+e ro tsā na/ zhang ye shes sde sogs gdan 'dzoms par rgya gar gyi bstan bcos mang po bsgyur du bcug pa las/0 slob dpon chos grags dang tsan+d+ra go mi/ slob dpon dul ba lha sogs kyis tshad ma'i bstan bcos skor zhig bod yig tu bsgyur pa yin te/ lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs kyis rgya gar gyi mkhan po dang paṇ+ḍi ta rnams la brten nas dpal ldan chos grags kyi gtan tshigs thigs pa dang / 'brel ba brtag pa'i 'grel ba/ rgyud gzhan grub pa bcas dang / slob dpon ka ma la shi la'i rigs pa'i thigs pa'i phyogs snga ma mdor bsdus pa dang / slob dpon dul ba lha'i gtan tshigs thogs pa'i rgya cher 'grel ba/ dmigs pa brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa bcas dang / slob dpon dge srungs kyi thams cad mkhyen pa grub pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa dang / phyi rol gyi don grub pa zhes bya ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa rnams bod yig tu bsgyur pa dang / lo tsā ba be+e ro tsā na dang paṇ+ḍi ta shrī sirnya pra bha gnyis kyis slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i rigs pa grub pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba bsgyur/ lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sde dang rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo rnyi gnyis kyis slob dpon dzi na mi tra'i rigs pa'i thigs pa'i don bsdus pa bsgyur pa dang / de dang rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra gnyis kyis slob dpon dul ba lha'i rigs pa'i thigs pa'i rgya cher 'grel ba slob ma la phan pa zhes bya ba bsgyur cing / dgon sde so sor rtsod grwa dang bshad grwa sogs btsugs te 'chad mnyan gyi srol thog mar phye zhing de la brten nas bod yul du tshad ma'i gzhung lugs thog mar byung mgo tshugs na yang / yun ring ma 'gor bar khri —6—
ral ba can gyi spun rgyal po 'u dum btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung ste bstan pa bsnubs/ de ltar khri ral ba can gyi dus su rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i bstan bcos thog mar bod du bsgyur na yang / rig gnas 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis rgya cher dar ma thub pa kun gyis mkhyen gsal ltar yin no/ /2 bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su tshad ma'i bstan bcos bod du 'gyur tshul/lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus su khong gis khye'u rigs bzang ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rgya gar dang kha che sogs su slob gnyer du mngags shing / de rnams thog mar kha che'i yul du phyin pa la lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang legs pa'i shes ra ba gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams tshad dug gis shi lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos kha che'i paṇa grub du ma bsten nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs la mkhas par sbyangs shing / phyir bod du byon nas tshad ma dang phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs mang po bsgyur/ de la slob ma'i 'khor mang du 'dus pa las khyad par du 'phags pa rma dge ba'i blo gros dang rngog blo ldan shes rab gnyis byon/ de gnyis gtso byas pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis rgya gar dang kha che sogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta mang po dang mnyam 'brel sgos tshad ma'i bstan bcos mang po bod du bsgyur pa yin te/ de yang rgya gar gyi mkhan po su bhu ti shrī shān+ti dang dge slong rma dge ba'i blo gros gnyis kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi tshig le'ur byas pa dang / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi le'u phyi ma gsum gyi 'grel ba/rtsod pa'i rigs pa/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bshad stong phyed dang phrag bzhi ba sogs bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan phan bzang po dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab rnam gnyis kyis tshad ma rnam nges/ tshad ma rigs thigs/ tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i ṭīk+ka 'thad ldan bcas bsgyur/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta skal ldan rgyal po dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab rnam gnyis kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel le'u gnyis pa man chad kyi 'grel ba rnam 'grel gyi rgyan dang / gzhan sel ba/ skad cig ma 'jig pa grub pa/ 'grel ba grub pa bcas bsgyur/ yang paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes — 1 —
rab rnam gnyis kyis rnam 'grel rgyan gyi le'u bzhi ba'i 'grel ba bsgyur/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ma no rā tha dang lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab rnam gnyis kyis sel ba grub pa zhes bya ba bsgyur cing / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab rang nyid kyis thos pa brtag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ gzhan sel brtag pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ dbang phyug 'jig pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ tshad ma brtag pa che ba dang / tshad ma brtag pa chung ba sogs bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su da na rak+ṣi ta dang / dge bsnyen zha ma seng rgyal rnam gnyis kyis tshad ma kun btus dang de'i 'grel bshad gnyis bsgyur/ za hor gyi mkhan po bo blu sa twa dang dge slong dharma lo ka rnam gnyis kyis phyogs chos dgu'i 'khor lo bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nya na garba dang lo tsā ba nam mkha' gnyis kyis 'brel ba brtag pa'i rab tu byed pa/'brel ba brtag pa'i rgya cher bshad pa bcas bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhas pa shrī bhā pi ka ra rak+ṣi ta dang zhang zhung gi lo tsā ba mang 'or byang chub shes rab rnam gnyis kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi rgyan gyi 'grel bshad bsgyur/ gnas brtan mkhas pa chen po dz+nya na shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi brtson 'grus rnam gnyis kyis tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i 'grel bshad bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po pa ra haṃ ta dang lo tsā ba dge slong dga' ba rdo rje rnam gnyis kyis 'brel ba brtag pa'i rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po ku mā ra shrī bha dra dang lo tsā ba dge slong 'phags pa shes rab/ 'bro seng dkar shākya 'od bcas kyis rtsod pa'i rigs pa'i 'grel ba don rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba bsgyur/ bal yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta tsa hang du shān+ti bha dra dang / lo tsā ba 'bro seng dkar dge slong shākya 'od rnam gnyis kyis lhan cig dmigs pa nges par grub pa zhes bya ba bsgyur/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta skal ldan rgyal po dang / dge slong pa tshab nyi ma grags rnam gnyis kyis 'jig rten pha rol grub pa zhes bya ba bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi nā ya ka ra dang lo tsā ba dge slong grags 'byor rnam gnyis kyis skad cig ma 'jig pa grub pa'i rnam par 'grel ba bsgyur/ yang rgya gar gyi mkhan po de wen+t+ra bha dra dang lo tsā ba dge slong grags 'byor shes rab rnam gnyis kyis de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i —8—
dka' 'grel zhes bya ba bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ku mā ra ka lā shu dang / lo tsā ba shākya 'od rnam gnyis kyis rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngo bo grub pa/ nang gi khyab pa/ gtan tshigs kyi de kho na nyid ba stan pa ba cas bsgyur/ yang bal yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shān+ti bha dra dang lo tsā ba 'bro dge slong shākya 'od rnam gnyis kyis rnam par rig pa tsam nyid du grub pa zhes bya ba bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po nā ga rak+ṣi ta dang sum pa lo tsā ba dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje rnam gnyis kyis chos dang chos can gtan la phab pa/ byis pa 'jug pa'i rtog ge gnyis bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpas gu ṇa ā ka ra shī bha dra dang lo tsā ba dge slong lha bla ma zhi ba 'od rnam gnyis kyis de kho na nyid bsdus pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa bsgyur/ rngog blo ldan shes rab kyis tshad ma kun btus dang tshad ma sde bdun cha tshang bskyar du bsgyur/ dge slong dpal ldan blo gros brtan pas rtog ge'i skad la 'jug pa dang / yangs pa dang dri ma med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i tshad ma kun btus kyi 'grel ba bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal rab 'byor zhi ba dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ting nge 'dzin bzang po rnam gnyis kyis rigs pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba bsgyur pa yin/gsum pa/ rgya gar gyi tshan ma'i bstan bcos bod du 'gyur nas bod yul du tshad ma rig pa byung zhing 'phel ba/bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang zhang ye shes sde/ be+e ro tsa na bcas kyis rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i gzhung lugs 'ga' zhig bod yig tu bsgyur pa la brten nas bod gangs can gyi yul du tshad ma'i gzhung lugs thog mar byung mgo tshugs kyang 'chad mnyan gyi srol chen po med pas rgya cher spel ma thub/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su zha ma seng rgyal gyis tshad ma kun btus bsgyur pa dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i slob ma rma dge ba'i blo gros kyis tshad ma rnam 'grel dang de'i 'grel bshad/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa sogs bsgyur cing 'chad mnyan gyis gtan la —9—
phab pa dang / khyung bo grags seng sogs kyis 'chad mnyan bgyis pa de rnams la tshad ma rnying ba zhes grags shing cung zad dar thub pa byung / de'i rjes su rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis jo bo rje'i bka' bzhin gsang phu ne'u thog tu gsang phu dgon pa thog mar btab/ de'i dbon po dang slob mar gyur pa blo ldan shes rab kyis gnas der bshad grwa thog mar btsugs te tshad ma'i bstan bcos snga ma rnams la 'gyur bcos mdzad cing / tshad ma rnam nges dang tshad ma rigs thigs gnyis rdzogs par bsgyur par ma zad/ slob dpon chos mchog dang dge srungs/ bde byed dga' ba sogs kyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos skor zhig bod yig tu bsgyur te 'chad mnyan rgya cher spel pas slob ma'i 'khor nyis khri lhag 'dus shing / rgyan mkhan po dang chos mchog gi lugs gtso bor bzung nas tshad ma gsar pa spel/ rngog blo ldan shes rab la slob ma'i 'khor mang du 'dus pa las rig pa'i rtsal mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i rigs pa smra ba mang du byon/ de dag las ches khyad par du 'phags pa smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po cha ba chos kyi seng ges tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung lugs la 4dpyis phyin par sbyangs nas nges pa zab mo rnyed de/ dpal ldan chos grags kyi tshad ma rnam nges la 'grel ba dang / tshad ma'i bsdus pa yid kyi mun sel bcas mdzad de bod rang gi khyad chos dang ldan pa'i 'chad mnyan gyi 'dzin grwa btsugs nas bsdus grwa'i srol legs par phye/ khong gis rang nyid kyi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal dang rig pa'i mthu la brten nas tshad ma'i gzhung dang gzhung 'grel mang du mdzad pa nas bzung / bod mkhas pa rang nyid kyis mdzad pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung lugs thog mar byung ba yin/ de ltar cha ba chos kyi seng ges tshad ma'i gzhung 'grel mang du mdzad nas 'chad mnyan rgya cher spel par brten gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ges tshad ma rnam nges ṭīka chen mdzad/dan bag pa smra ba'i seng ges tshad ma'i bsdus pa yid kyi mun sel gyi 'grel ba mdzad de 'chad mnyan spel/ phyis su sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis waṃ ku paṇ+ḍi ta dang kha che paṇa chen bla slob gnyis las tshad ma rnam 'grel legs par gsan nas de'i 'gyur snga ma rnams la zhu dag mdzad — 10—
de gtan la phab cing / tshad ma rigs gter rang 'grel dang bcas pa mdzad/ de'i rgyun 'dzin pa shar ba rin chen 'byung gnas dang / nub pa 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng de gung ba skyo ston dri med gsum gyis 'chad mnyan rgya cher spel pa las rigs pa smra ba'i slob ma mang po byon/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ges rnam 'grel rigs mdzod chen mo zhes bya ba sogs brtsams shing 'chad mnyan yun ring mdzad/ de'i rgyun 'dzin pa nya dbon kun dga' dpal pa yin la/ de'i slob ma g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla mas tshad ma rigs gter gyi 'grel ba mdzad/ de'i rjes rong ston shes bya kun gzigs dang byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel gnyis byon/ rong ston gyi slob ma shākya mchog ldan gyis thub bstan gser mdog can btab pa dang / sangs rgyas 'phel gyi slob ma go rams pa bsod nams seng ges thub bstan rnam rgyal dang / sde bdun pa bstan pa rab gsal gyis rwa ba smad btab ste slob ma mang po bskyangs shing / slob ma dang yang slob mang pos mtshan nyid kyi 'chad mnyan spel pas rigs pa smra ba'i mkhas pa mu tig gi phreng ba bltar la brgyus pa lta bu byung / de ltar rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i bstan bcos bod du bsgyur pa dang / de rnams la 'grel ba rabs dang rim par mdzad de 'chad mnyan gyis spel pa dang / khyad par du cha ba chos kyi seng ges tshad ma'i bsdus pa yid kyi mun sel zhes bya ba mdzad de bsdus grwa'i srol btod cing 'chad mnyan gyi 'dzin grwa btsugs pa nas bzung / bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i tshad ma'i gzhung lugs thog mar byung zhing / de gzhir byas nas 'chad mnyan gyis slob bu mang po bskyangs pa dang / slob ma dang yang slob rim byon gyis tshad ma'i bstan bcos snga ma rnams la 'grel ba dang / rang nyid kyis tshad ma'i bstan bcos mdzad de 'chad mnyan rgyun ma chad par rgya cher spel pas bod gangs can gyi yul du tshad ma rig pa byung zhing rim bzhin sa khyab rdo khyab tu gyur to/ /
bsdus grwa'i lan rnam bzhi ji ltar gdab tshul skor bshad pa/de yang slob grwa chen mo'i bod rig pa'i slob gling dang bod yig sde khag dag tu slob ma rnams la bsdus grwa dang / nang rig spyi bshad/ grub mtha'/ rim byung rtsom rig rtsom 'bri rig pa sogs bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom rig ched las la nye bar mkho ba'i bslab bya mang po zhig 'khrid bzhin yod/ 'on kyang slob ma phal mo cher mtshon na bslab bya de rnams las ches go dka' zhing spro ba med pa'i bslab bya ni bsdus grwa red ces bshad chog snyam/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug ce na/ bod rigs slob ma rnams bsdus grwa'i gzhung la 'jug skabs rtsod pa byed pa'i sbyong brdar gyi slob thun logs su med pas tshad ma'i brda chad rnams blo la ma nges pa dang / bsdus grwa'i rigs lam gyi 'gro stangs la blo ma goms pa bcas kyis bsdus grwa sbyong ba la spro ba chen po 'byung gin med/ da dung slob ma kha cig gis bsdus grwa ni dgon sde'i grwa btsun rnams kyi sbyang bya zhig yin pa las slob chen pa rnams kyi bslab bya ma red snyam bzhin 'dug yin na yang bod kyi mkhas dbang snga ma thams cad kyis dgon pa nas rig gzhung la sbyangs te mkhas par gyur pa dang / khong tshos bod kyi rig gnas che chung thams cad 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pa yin pas nang bstan chos lugs kyi gzhung phal mo che'i brjod bya'i don yang tshad ma rig pa'i lam nas gtan la phab pa red/ de'i rkyen gyis nang bstan chos lugs dang sngon byon mkhas pa ris med kyis mdzad pa'i ljags rtsom rnams kyi gzhung don rtogs par byed pa la bsdus grwa'i rigs lam nī med du mi rung ste/ rje dmu dka bsam gtan rgya mtshos ( 1990 thu 200) 29gtan tshigs rig pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa la phyogs mthong tsam re med — 17—
na sum rtags tsam gyi kur sgra des gar yang mi phyin 'dug la/〉〉 zhes bslab bya nan mo gnang yod pas bod kyi slob grwa chen mo ba rnams kyis nges par bsdus grwa'i gzhu nga la sbyang dgos/ gzhung der blo 'jug par thog mar rtsod pa'i spyi 'gros te/ rtags gsal rtsod gzhi rnams ngos ji ltar 'dzin pa dang / de nas thal 'gyur rnams la lan rnam bzhi ji ltar gdab tshul shes dgos pas 'dir de'i skor cung zad gleng bar 'dod/dang po/ rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ngos 'dzin tshul/bsdus grwa'i lan rnam bzhi ji ltar gdab tshul 'chad pa la thog mar rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum gang yin re re bzhin nges dgos te/ dper na/ bum pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'i thal 'gyur la mtshon na/ bum pa ni rtsod gzhi yin te/ bum pa chos can zhes pas bum pa rtsod gzhir bzung ba yin la/ chos can dang rtsod gzhi gnyis don gcig yin/ dngos po yin par thal ces pa ni gsal ba yin te/ de'i don ni dngos po yin par 'gyur zhes pa'am dngos po yin dgos par gyur ces pa'i don yin zhing / gzugs yin pa'i phyir zhes pa ni rtags sam rgyu mtshan yin la/ de'i don ni gzugs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis sam gzugs yin pa'i stabs kyis zhes pa'i don yin/ de ltar na gong gi thal 'gyur de'i don ni/ bum pa dngos po yin dgos par 'gyur te/ (bum pa ) gzugs yin pa'i stabs kyis so zhes pa'i don yin/ thal 'gyur de'i rtags sam rgyu mtshan sngon du bkod nas phal skad ltar bshad na 'di ltar 'gyur te/ bum pa gzugs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ( bum pa ) dngos po yin dgos par gyur/des na rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga tshang ba'i thal 'gyur zhig yin tshe/ cig chos can zhes pa ni rtsod gzhir bzung ba dang / cig yin par thal zhes pa ni ga sal ba dang /cig yin pa'i phyir zhes pa ni rtags yin pa shes par bya/ yin yang thal 'gyur zhig yin na rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga tshang dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ bum pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ zhes brjod tshe de — 13 —
ni rtsod gzhi dang gsal ba gnyis las grub pa'i thal 'gyur zhig yin pa dang / rtag pa yin par thal/ yod pa gang zhig dngos po ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni gsal ba dang rtags gnyis las grub pa'i thal 'gyur zhig yin/ chos can dang rtags gnyis las grub pa'i thal 'gyur 'god srol med de/ dper na/ bum pa chos can/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu/dgon pa'i chos grwar rtsod pa byed skabs rtags gsal 'phen mkhan la rigs slong ba'am snga rgol pa zhes 'bod la/ dris lan 'debs mkhan la dam bca' ba'am phyi rgol pa zhes zer/ rigs slong bas rigs lam rnon po rnams la brten nas rtags gsal 'phangs te dam bca' ba'i khas blangs pa rnams bshig ci thub byed pa dang / dam bca' bas lan rnam bzhi gtso byas nas thal 'gyur rnams la gang 'tsham gyis dris lan gdab dgos pa yin te/ sa paṇa gyi tshad ma rigs gter las/ 66des na mkhas pa'i thal 'gyur lan/ / rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhis gdab/ / lan gyis bzlog par mi nus na/ / de yi rjes 'brang dam pa'i lugs/ /〉〉 ( 1991 thu 295) zhes gsungs pa dang /yang klo bo bsod nams lhun grub lags kyis ( 1991 thu 257 ) 99rang gi lugs ni/ des na zhes sogs te/ thal 'gyur gyi lan 'gal/ ma nges/ ma grub/ 'dod thog bcas bzhir nges te〉〉zhes bkral pa ltar thal 'gyur gyi lan rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi ni lan rnam bzhi ste 'dod dang rtags ma grub/ma khyab/ 'gal khyab bcas yin la/ gsham du lan de re re bzhin ji ltar gdab tshul cung zad brjod par bya/gnyis pa/ lan rnam bzhi gdab tshul/ku 'dod lan 'debs tshul/lan rnam bzhi las 'dod ces pa'i don ni 'thad pa yin zhes pa'am red ces pa'i don yin te/ rigs slong bas/ bum pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ gzugs yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'i thal 'gyur zhig 'phangs tshe/ de'i don ni bum pa dngos po yin dgos par 'gyur te/— 14—
( bum pa ) gzugs yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so zhes pa'i don yin la/ bum pa ni dngos po la dbye na gzugs/ shes pa/ ldan min 'du byed gsum du phye ba'i gzugs yin zhing / gzugs shes ldan min 'du byed gsum po gang yin yang dngos po yin pas/ bum pa gzugs yin pa sgrub byed du bkod nas de dngos po yin par bsgrubs pa yin te/ brjod tshul de yang dag pa yin pas thal 'gyur 'di la 'dod lan thebs pa yin te/ brtsi ba'i tshe na bum pa gzugs yin par 'dod ces brjod dgos pa dang / de'i don ni bum pa dngos po yin par 'thad dang bum pa dngos po yin par khas len zhes pa'i don yin/ rje dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis ( 1998 sha 340 ) 99'dod ces pa ni/ rang gis de ltar 'dod ces pa yin te/ pha rol pos/ bum pa mi rtag pa yin par thal/zhes 'phangs na/ 'dod ces lan 'debs/ de la 'dod lan thobs zer na/ bum pa mi rtag pa yin par 'dod/ ces lan thebs pa yin pa'i phyir/〉〉 zhes gsungs/ 'dod lan ni dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i nang du mi rnams kyis phan tshun la kha brda byed pa dang dri ba bya ba'i skabs su pha rol pos red dang yang na bden zhes bshad pa dang 'dra/ de bzhin du ba lang chos can/ dud 'gro yin par thal/ sgo zog yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu la mtshon na rtsod gzhi ba lang de dud 'gro yin par 'gyur dgos te/ de sgo zog yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so zhes pa'i don yin zhing / ba lang yin tshad sgo zog yin la/ sgo zog yin tshad dud 'gro yin pas ba lang dud 'gro yin dgos pas thal 'gyur 'di la 'dod lan thebs pa yin te/ 'dod lan brtsi ba'i tshe na ba lang dud 'gro yin par 'dod ces brtsi dgos pa las ba lang sgo zog yin par 'dod ces gtan nas brtsi mi rigs so/ /gong du bkod pa ni rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga tshang ba'i thal 'gyur zhig yin la/ rtsod gzhi dang gsal ba gnyis ldan gyi thal 'gyur la'ang 'dod lan dang ci'i phyir gnyis gang rung zhig btab chog pa dang / 'dod lan thebs pa'i thal 'gyur ni dper na/ gong du bkod pa ltar/ ba lang chos can/ dud 'gro yin par thal/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur zhig 'phangs tshe/ 'dod ces lan — 15 —
'debs rigs pa yin te/ 'dod lan brtsi ba'i tshe na gong ltar ba lang dud 'gro yin par 'dod ces brtsi dgos/ 'di lta bu'i thal 'gyur la rtags sam rgyu mtshan bkod med pas rtsod gzhi de gsal ba de yin min la bsam blo btang bas chog ste/ rtsod gzhi de gsal ba de yin na 'dod lan thebs pa dang min tshe ci'i phyir zer dgos/ ci'i phyir gyi don ni rtsod gzhi de gsal ba de yin par 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan ci zhes dris pa yin te/ dper na/ mi chos can/ gcan gzan yin par thal/zhes pa lta bu'i rtags gsal zhig 'phangs tshe / ci'i phyir zer dgos te/ mi gcan gzan yin par 'gyur dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhes dris pa red/ des na rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga tshang ba'i thal 'gyur zhig yin tshe/rtsod gzhi de rtags de yin la rtags de yin tshad gsal ba yang yin pa'i thal 'gyur zhig yin tshe de la 'dod lan btab chog pa dang / rtsod gzhi dang gsal ba gnyis las grub pa'i thal 'gyur zhig yin tshe/ rtsod gzhi de gsal ba de yin tshe 'dod lan thebs pa dang min tshe ci'i phyir zer dgos/ 'on kyang lan rnam pa lnga ru thal bar mi 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir zhes pa ni pha rol po 0la dri ba tsam bton pa las lan ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kha rtags ma grub kyi lan 'debs tshul/lan rnam bzhi las rtags ma grub kyi don ni rgyu mtshan de gnas lugs su ma grub ces pa'am rgyu mtshan bkod pa rgyu mtshan yang dag tu song mi 'dug ces pa'i don yin te/ dper na rigs slong bas/ rta dkar po chos can/ kha dog yin par thal/ dkar po yin pa'i phyir zhes rtags gsal 'phangs tshe/ de'i don ni rta dkar po kha dog yin par 'gyur dgos te/ ( rta dkar po) dkar po yin pa'i stabs kyis so zhes pa'i don yin zhing / rta dkar po dkar po yin pa sgrub byed du bkod nas de kha dog yin par 'gyur dgos tshul bstan pa yin yang / dkar po yin tshad kha dog yin dgos kyang rta dkar po dkar po ma yin pas rtags sam rgyu mtshan de grub med pa dang / 'di lta — 16—
bu'i thal 'gyur la rtags ma grub kyi lan thebs/ rtags lan brtsi ba'i tshe na rta dkar po dkar po yin pa rtags ma grub ces lan gdab dgos pa dang / de'i don ni rta dkar po dkar po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ( de kha dog yin dgos ) zhes pa rgyu mtshan du grub med pa'i don yin/ rje dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis ( 1998 sha 339 ) 92rtags grub ma grub ni/ rtsod gzhi de rtags de yin min la go dgos pas/ bum pa chos can/ med par thal/ tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur 'di'i rtags ma grub ste/ bum pa tshad mas ma dmigs pa min pas so/ /〉〉 zhes gsungs/yang rtags ma grub kyi lan 'debs skabs nges par rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga tshang ba'i thal 'gyur zhig yin mi dgos te/ dper na/ kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rtags tsam bkod pa'i thal 'gyur la'ang rtags ma grub ces lan btab chog pa dang / de'i rtags lan brtsi ba'i tshe na kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas khyab pa rtags ma grub ces lan gdab dgos/ dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i nang du kha brda dang rtsod gleng byed skabs rtags ma grub kyi lan don gyis 'debs kyin yod de/ dper na mi zhig gis dga' ldan dgon pa dang 'bras spungs dgon pa gnyis ka lha sa grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs su chags yod pa'i rkyen gyis de gnyis kyi bar thag ha cang nye/zhes bshad pa na pha rol pos dgon pa de gnyis ka lha sa grong khyer gyi nye 'dabs su chags yod pa ma red ces rgyu mtshan bkod pa yang dag pa min par brjod pa dang 'dra/ des na lan rnam bzhi'i rtags ma grub kyi don ni rgyu mtshan bkod pa de rgyu mtshan yang dag tu song med pa'am rtags sam rgyu mtshan yang dag pa min zhes pa'i don yin/ga ma khyab kyi lan 'debs tshul/ma khyab ces pa'i don ni rtags de yin na gsal ba de yin pa'i nges pa med ces pa'i don yin te/ dper na chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin — 11 —
pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'i thal 'gyur la mtshon na/ de'i don ni chos dung dkar po'i kha dog dmar po yin par 'gyur dgos te/ de kha dog yin pa'i stabs kyis so zhes pa'i don yin la/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog kha dog yin yang / kha dog yin tshad dmar po yin dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ma khyab bam khyab pa ma byung gi lan thebs pa yin te/ ma khyab kyi lan brtsi ba'i tshe na/ kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas ma khyab ces brtsi dgos/ yang dper na/ mi chos can/ gcan gzan yin par thal/ sha za ba'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur lta bu la mtshon na/ mis sha za ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi gcan gzan yin par 'gyur mi dgos pas/ thal 'gyur de lta bu la ma khyab bam khyab pa ma byung gi lan thebs pa yin te/ ma khyab kyi lan brtsi ba'i tshe na sha za na gcan gzan yin pas ma khyab ces brtsi dgos shing / de'i don ni sha za ba thams cad gcan gzan yin pa'i nges pa med ces pa'i don yin/ rje dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis ( 1998 sha342) 99ma khyab ces pa ni/ khyab pa ma grub ces pa'i don te/dper na/ gser gyi kha dog chos can/ dkar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'phangs na/ ma khyab ces lan 'debs dgos te/ kha dog yin na dkar po yin pas ma khyab pas so/ /〉〉 zhes gsungs pa dang / rigs slong ba dang dam bca' ba gnyis rtsod pa byed skabs dam bca' bas thal 'gyur la ma khyab ces lan gnad du 'khel ba zhig btab nas rigs slong bar dri ba 'don rgyu med par kha rog ger 'dug dgos pa'i skabs kyang yod/ dus rgyun gyi kha brda'i nang du'ang bshad tshul 'di dang 'dra ba yod de/ dper na mi ka bas tshe ring gis bod skad bshad shes sam zhes dris pa la/ kha bas tshe ring bod rigs yin pas bod skad bshad shes nges yin zhes pa la/ yang mi ka bas bod rigs yin na bod skad bshad shes pa'i nges pa med de/ deng skabs bod skad bshad mi shes pa'i bod rigs mang po yod ces bshad pa lta bu la mtshon na/ bod rigs yin na bod skad bshad shes pa'i nges pa med ces pa ni ma khyab kyi lan dang don 'dra zhing /dper brjod 'di dag las nga tshos ma khyab kyi lan 'debs tshul shes thub/— 18—
nga 'gal khyab kyi lan ji ltar 'debs tshul/'gal khyab ces pa ni rtags de yin tshad gsal ba de ma yin pa'i nges pa yod ces pa'i don yin te/ dper na/ ba lang chos can/ mi yin par thal/ dud 'gro yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'i thal 'gyur la mtshon na 'gal khyab kyi lan thebs pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan ni ba lang dud 'gro yin pa rgyu mtshan du bkod nas de mi yin par 'gyur dgos zhes brjod tshe/ dud 'gro yin tshad mi ma yin pa'i nges pa yod pas 'gal khyab kyi lan gdab dgos/ 'gal khyab brtsi ba'i tshe na dud 'gro yin na mi ma yin pas khyab ces brjod dgos te/ rje dmu dge bsam gtan gyis ( 1998 sha 340) 99'gal khyab ces pa ni/ thal 'gyur de'i rtags de yin na/ gsal ba de ma yin pas khyab na 'gal khyab yin te/ dper na/ bum pa chos can/ rtag pa yin par thal/ don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir/zhes pa'i thal 'gyur 'di 'gal khyab yin te/ don byed nus pa yin na/ rtag pa ma yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/〉〉 zhes gsungs pa ltar rtsod gzhi de rtags de yin zhing / rtags de yin tshad gsal ba de min pa'i skabs su 'gal khyab kyi lan gdab dgos/ des na ma khyab dang 'gal khyab gnyis kyi khyad par ni ma khyab ni rtags de yin tshad gsal ba de yin pa'i nges pa med ces pa'i don yin pas/chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal/ kha dog yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la ma khyab ces lan btab nas brtsi ba'i tshe na kha dog yin na dmar po yin pas ma khyab ces zer dgos/ de'i don ni kha dog yin tshad dmar po yin pa'i nges pa med ces pa'i don yin/de la 'gal khyab kyi lan mi thebs te/ 'gal khyab kyi lan btab pas kha dog yin na dmar po ma yin pas khyab ces brjod dgos la/ de ltar na kha dog yin tshad dmar po min dgos zhes pas don yin pas 'gal khyab kyi lan mi thebs/ 'gal khyab ni rtags de yin na gsal ba de ma yin pa zhi ga yin dgos te/ dper na/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog chos can/ dmar po yin par thal/— 19 —
dkar po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la mtshon na 'gal khyab kyi lan thebs pa yin te dkar po yin na dmar po ma yin pas khyab ste/ dkar po yin tshad dmar po ma yin pa'i nges pa yod pas 'gal khyab la rtags de yin na gsal ba de ma yin pa zhig yin dgos/mdor na/ thal 'gyur zhig la 'dod lan btab pas thal 'gyur de'i rtsod gzhi de gsal ba de yin par 'thad pa'am 'dod par bstan pa dang / rtags ma grub ces pas rtsod gzhi de rtags de ma yin zhes pa'i don dang / ma khyab ces pas rtags de yin na gsal ba de yin pa'i nges pa med pa dang / 'gal khyab ces pas rtags de yin na gsal ba de ma yin pas khyab ces pas don yin la/lan rnam bzhi ni thal 'gyur rnams kyi don la brtags nas gang 'os kyis gdab dgos pa las gang dran dran ltar 'debs mi rigs so/ /zur lta'i dpyad yig/ 1/ rje dmu dge bsam gtan/ shes bya'i rnam grangs blo gsal rigs sgo/khukhu zi ling / mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1990 6(21 sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ tshad ma rigs gter/ tshad ma rigs gter gyi 'grel ba/khukhu pe cin/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang / 1991 7 sha 165—296/31 klo bo bsod nams lhun grub/ tshad ma rigs gter gyi 'grel pa/ pe cin/ krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /khukhu 1991 7(41 rje dmu dge bsam gtan/ dris lan gter gyi kha byang / tshad ma'i dgongs don rtsa 'grel mkhas pa'i mgul rgyanakhuyo pe cin/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1998 3 sha337—374—20—
bsdus gzhung la 'jug tshul las 'phros pa'i bsam gzhigrtsom 'di'i nang du dgon par bsdus gzhung la 'jug tshul re re bzhin gsal por gleng khul byas pa la brten nas slob grwa chen mo'i bod rig pa'i slob gling spyi dang sgos su bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom rig sde khag gi slob ma rnams kyis bsdus grwa'i gzhung legs par sbyang ba la gnad don 'ga' yod pa ji ltar bsal ba'i tshul la col chung kho bor bsam tshul re gnyis yod pa gsham du cung zad gleng bar 'dod/dang po/ 'os shing 'tsham pa'i bsdus grwa'i slob deb cig gtan la phab dgos/bod kyi mtshan nyid rtsod pa'i dgon sde dag tu grwa btsun rnams kyi sbyang bya gtso bo ni gzhung pod lnga dang rgyud sde bzhi yin la/ de rnams las thog mar tshad ma rig pa la 'jug dgos pa dang / de la bsdus grwa dang rtags rigs dang blo rig bcas sngon du song ste rnam 'grel rtsod pa yin/ de las thog mar bsdus grwa'i gzhung la sbyang dgos pa dang / dgon pa gang yin yang gzhung gang gi thog nas bsdus grwa la sbyong ba gtan la phab yod de/ mdo smad kyi dgon par dper mtshon na/ bla brang dgon pa dang sku 'bum dgon pa/ klu tshang dgon pa sogs su bse bsdus kyi steng nas bsdus grwa'i gzhung la sbyong bzhin yod pa dang / rong bo dgon par mkhan chen bsdus grwa dang / ldi tsha dgon par rwa bsdus sbyang bya'i slob deb tu spyod kyin 'dug de bzhin du slob grwa chen mo'i bod kyi skad — 21 —
yig dang rtsom rig gi ched las dang bod rig pa'i ched las gang yin yang gzhung gang gi steng nas bsdus grwar 'jug rgyu gtan la dbab dgos snyam/ slob chen so so'i bod rig pa'i slob gling dang bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom rig sde khag rnams kyis 'os 'tsham gyi bsdus grwa'i bslab gzhi zhig gtan la phab na shin tu legs par sems te/ gtan 'khel gyi bsdus grwa'i slob deb cig yod tshe/ dge rgan gyis slob deb de gtso bor bzung nas slob khrid la gra sgrig byas na/ khrid bya'i zin bris lo rer je legs nas je legs su 'gyur bar ma zad/ bsdus grwa'i gzhung gi go ba sngar las cher bskyed de slob khrid kyi grub 'bras je bzang nas je bzang du 'gro bar phan thogs yod pa 'chad khrid kyi nyams myong las shes thub la/ slob ma rnams la mtshon na yang gtan la phab pa'i slob deb de gtso bor bzung nas bsdus grwa'i gzhung la sbyang chog pa dang / sbyang 'dod kyi 'dun pa shin tu drags pa'i slob ma rnams kyis slob grur bsdus grwa la cha tshang zhing yid tshim pa zhig sbyangs ma thub tshe/ dbyar dgun gnang gi skabs dang gza' spen pa dang nyi ma'i skabs su sbyangs zin pa'i bsdus grwa'i gzhung der mu mthud du sbyang chog de ltar ma yin par bsdus grwa'i slob deb btsong rgyu med pa dang rgyu rkyen gzhan pa'i dbang gis lo rer slob deb re brjes nas slob khrid byas tshe sbyang bya'i slob tshan gyi go rim 'chol ba dang / de dang lhan cig gzhung don gyi mtshan nyid dang bshad tshul mi 'dra ba re 'gar 'phrad pa/ de la brten nas dge rgan gyis slob skabs rer slob khrid la gsar du gra sgrig bya dgos pa dang slob ma rnams kyis bsdus grwa'i gzhung gang gtso bor bzung nas sbyang dgos pa mi shes par 'gyur bas dge slob gnyis kur dka' tshegs dang mgo nyog pa'i ngan cha cung zad yod snyam/col chung kho bo'i bsam tshul ltar na slob chen du gzhung gang gi steng nas bsdus grwa'i gzhung la sbyang na legs she na/ deng gi dus 'dir slob chen gyi bsdus grwa'i slob deb bsgrigs yod pa skor zhig yod de/ dper na/ mtsho sngon mi rigs slob chen gyi dge rgan chen mo blo bzang chos grags lags kyi tshad ma rig pa'i spyi don dang / nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan chen mo chu — 27 —
skyes dge 'dun bsam gtan lags kyi rigs lam 'jug bde'i lam bu dang tshad ma'i dgongs don gsal bar byed pa gtan tshigs dus kyi sgron me sogs mang na yang / slob chen du bod yig ched gnyer gyi slob ma rnams kyi bsdus grwa'i slob deb la bse bsdus ha cang 'tsham snyam ste/ bse bsdus grwa ni bsdus gzhung gzhan dang bsdur na cung go sla zhing rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa/ bsdus tshan re re'i don dril zhing rno ba/ bod kyi dgon sde mang po zhig tu mtshan nyid pa rnams kyis bse bsdus kyi steng nas bsdus grwa'i gzhung la 'jug bzhin yod pa dang / bse ngag dbang bkra shis lags kyis lo ngo du mang ring bsags pa'i nyams myong dang rigs 'phrul rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas brtsams pa yin pas slob chen pa rnams kyi slob deb tu 'os pa red snyam/gnyis pa/ sbyang bya'i bsdus tshan gtan la phab dgos/bod kyi mtshan nyid kyi dgon sde'i rnams su grwa btsun rnams kyi sbyang bya gtso bo ni gzhung pod lnga dang rgyud sde bzhi yin la/ der 'jug tshul gyi go rim ni rje tsong kha pa yab sras kyi rjes nas thog mar tshad ma rig pa dang / de nas phar phyin dang dbu ma/ mngon pa/ 'dul ba bcas yin la/ tshad ma rig pa las thog mar bsdus grwa chung 'bring che gsum dang de nas rtags rigs dang blo rig la sbyang dgos/ dgon sde'i phal mo cher bsdus grwa lo ngo gsum dang blo rtags gnyis po lo ngo gnyis te bsdoms pas lo ngo lnga'i ring la tshad ma rig pa mjug rdzogs par byed/ der ma zad 'dzin grwa re res chos thog re re'i nang du bsdus tshan gang dag la sbyang dgos pa rang rang dgon pa'i rtsod yig nang du gsal por gsungs yod de/ mdo smad ldi tsha dgon pa lta bur mtshon na de'i dpal ldan bkra shis chos sdings kyi rtsod yig las 92dgun chos chen mor bsdus chung du gsar du zhugs pa rnams kyis kha dog dkar dmar rtsod cing mgo nas mjug bar du cha tshang rgyugs sprod byed/ hor zla dang po'i tshes brgyad nas gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi bar phyi dror rdo bcal gyi dam bca' yod pas/— 23 —
rdo bcal la/ yod rtogs med rtogs/ yin log min log ldog pa ngos 'dzin/ rgyu 'bras chung ba tshugs/ dpyid chos chen mor/ rgyu 'bras chung ba/ gcig dang tha dad/ khyab mtha' 'god tshul bcas/ dbyar chos chen mor/ yul dang yul can/11 ①zhes gsungs yod pa nang bzhin bsdus chung gi dpe cha ba rnams kyi lo gcig ring gi sbyang bya'i bsdus tshan rnams gsal por gtan la phab yod pas slob gnyer pa rnams kyis rtsod yig gzhir bzung nas rang rang gi skabs su bab pa'i bsdus tshan rnams la sbyang bar byed pa dang / de bzhin du slob chen so so'i bod yig ched gnyer gyi slob ma rnams kyis bsdus grwa'i bsdus tshan gang dag la sbyang dgos pa gtan la phab na shin tu legs te/ dge rgan dang slob ma su yin yang rang rang gi khrid bya dang sbyang bya'i bsdus tshan gang dag yin pa nges nas de la snga mo nas gra sgrig legs po zhig byas chog pa sogs kyi dge mtshan mang la/bslab bya'i nang don dang dmigs yul yang ha cang gsal po yin/ gong du slob chen la 'os 'tsham gyi bsdus grwa'i slob deb cig gtan la dbab dgos tshul bshad pa 'di la'ang thug yod/bod yig ched gnyer gyi dngos gzhi'i slob ma dang zhib 'jug slob ma rnams la bsdus grwa'i sbyang tshan gtan la ji ltar dbab dgos she na/ kho bo'i bsam tshul ltar na dngos gzhi'i slob ma rnams kyis bsdus grwa'i phyed ka bslab tshar dgos pa dang / bse bsdus lta bur mtshon na bsdus chung gi bsdus tshan yongs rdzogs dang bsdus 'bring las bsdus tshan bzhi tsam ste/ 'gal 'brel chung ba/mtshan mtshon/ cha ba'i lugs kyi rdzas ldog rang lugs kyi rdzas ldog bcas bslabs tshar dgos/zhib 'jug slob ma'i skabs su bsdus grwa'i phyed phyi ma'i bsdus tshan rnams la sbyangs nas bsdus grwa'i bsdus tshan yongs su rdzogs par byas na shin tu legs snyam ste/ slob ma rnams mthar phyin te dge rgan gyi las shig gnyer tshe mtho 'bring gi slob deb tu bsdus grwa'i skor bkod yod pa rnams 'khrid thub pa dang / zhib 'jug slob ma rnams kyis dgon pa'i 'dzin grwa ches dma' shos te bsdus chung bsdus 'bring bsdus chen gsum gyi sbyang bya ste bsdus grwa yongs su rdzogs pa bslabs tshar na 'os shi nga — 24—

rigs pa zhig yin/ tshad ma rig pa ched gnyer gyi zhib 'jug slob ma rnams kyis de'i khar rtags rigs dang blo rig rgya nag dang phyi gling gi gtan tshigs rig pa sogs sbyangs na tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung la go ba cung gting zab pa zhig lon thub pa dang / mthar phyin 'bras rtags su de'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom cung legs po zhig 'bri thub snyam/gsum pa/ rtsod pa ni bsdus grwa'i khrid thabs ches legs shos yin/nga tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar bod kyi mtshan nyid kyi dgon par dpe khrid byed pa'i skabs su/dge rgan gyis snga phyi rgol gnyis rtsod pa'i tshul gyis slob khrid byed pa yin te/ dge rgan gyis slob khrid byed skabs rtags gsal 'phangs te slob ma rnams la lan gdab tu 'jug pa dang / slob gnyer ba rnams kyis rtags gsal rnams la lan re re bzhin btab nas rigs lam la blo goms par byed/ yin na yang dge rgan gyis rtsod pa 'phangs nas slob ma'i blo sgo 'byed pa dang dogs gnas mang po bslangs pa las khas len 'dzin tshul mi gsungs pa dang / slob gnyer pa rnams kyis chos grur rtsod pa byas pa la brten nas lan ji ltar gdab tshul dang khas len ji ltar 'dzin tshul blo la nges par byed pa yin/ slob thun rjes ma'i dpe khrid kyi skabs su dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la bslabs zin pa'i dogs gnas de rnams la chos grwar rtsod pa byed skabs gzhan pas lan ji ltar btab tshul dris te bskyar sbyong byed pa dang / rtags gsal de dag gi yang dag pa'i khas len 'dzin tshul yang gsungs nges red/ yin na yang bsdus chung du gsar du zhugs pa'i las dang po ba rnams la thog mar slob khrid byed skabs/ dge rgan gyis bsdus grwa'i brda chad dang / rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ngos 'dzin tshul/ rigs lam gyi 'gros rim sogs re re bzhin gsal por gsungs te rigs lam gyi 'gro stangs cung zad nges rjes rtsod pa dang sbrags nas slob khrid byed pa red/ dgon pa'i slob gnyer pa rnams kyis dge rgan gyi dpe khrid dang / chos grwa'i rtsod par dngos — 25 —

slob chen so so'i bod rig pa'i slob gling dang sgos su bod kyi skad yig dang rtsom yig ched gnyer gyi slob ma rnams la'ang 'os shing 'tsham pa'i bsdus grwa'i slob deb cig gtan la dbab dgos pa dang /dngos gzhi'i slob ma dang zhib 'jug slob ma rnams kyis bsdus tshan gang dag sbyang dgos pa gtan la phab ste/ dge rgan gyis 'khrid bya'i nang don go rim bzhin khrid ston byed pa dang slob mas kyang rang nyid kyi sbyang byar gyur pa'i bsdus tshan rnams la 'bad pas sbyangs na shin tu legs/ der ma zad dge rgan gyis dang thog phal skad dang sbyar nas 'khrid de slob ma rnams rigs lam la blo cung zad goms pa na 'chad rtsod gnyis zung 'brel sgos 'khrid na slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang bsdus grwa'i gzhung la go ba mi dman pa zhig lon thub snyam du bdag gis sems so/ /mchan 'grel/④ rje btsun ye shes rgya mtsho/ dpal ldan bkra shis chos sdongs kyi rtsod yig ye shes rgya mtsho'i gsung pod lnga ba/khuyo nang khul gyi dpe cha/ sha375—376① bse ngag dbang bkra shis/ tshad ma'i dgongs don rtsa 'grel mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan/[lo] pe cin/mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1998 3 sha10— 27—
chos grwa'i rtsod pa byed lugs dang de'i mdze+es rgyan skor rags tsam gleng pa/da lta'i dus 'dir dgon sde so so'i nang gzhung bka' pod lnga la 'chad mnyan dang rtsod pa bgyid bzhin pa ma zad/ mtho rim slob grwa so so'i bod yig ched las kyi slob gnyer pa rnams la'ang bsdus grwa dang grub mtha' sogs mtshams sbyor gyi tshul du khrid ston byed bzhin mchis/ yin na yang slob gnyer pa mang che shos kyis chos grwar rtags gsal 'phen pa mthong myong ba ma gtogs/rtsod pa byed lugs dang rtsod pa'i cho ga de'i mdzes rgyan dang spang blang sogs la 'dris zhan pa'am mi shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi mtshon don gang yin la cha rgyus cung tsam yang med pas/col chung kho bos rang gi shes tshod kyis de'i skor gleng khul re byas na/ rang dang rang 'dra ba'i slob gnyer pa rnams la cung zad phan nges snyam pa'i kun slong gtsang mas yid kun nas bslangs te dpyad rtsom 'di 'bri mgo brtsams pa yin/dang po/ rtsod pa'i gang zag dang rtsod pacud lugs/rtsod pa byed pa'i gang zag la snga rgol pa dang phyi rgol pa gnyis yod la/ snga rgol pa zhes pa ni lung dang rigs pa gang rung la brten nas rang gis gang sgrub byed du bkod pa'i rtags gsal de phyi rgol pa la sun 'byin du ma bcug par gang nus kyis rigs pa'i gnod byed 'phangs nas de'i khas len bshig ci thub la 'bad pa'i gang zag de yin la/ de la rigs slong ba'am bgro gleng — 28—
ba'ang zer/ phyi rgol pa zhes pa ni snga rgol pa'i lung rigs dang ltag sprod du khas blangs nas des bkod pa'i sgrub byed dang 'phangs pa'i rtags gsal la bsam blo btang nas phyir lan 'debs par byed pa'i gang zag de yin la/ de la dam bca' ba'ang zer/ rtsod pa'i dpang bo zhes pa ni snga ro la pas 'phrangs pa'i rtags gsal dang phyi rgol pas khas/ glangs pa'i dam bca' gnyis yang dag yin min brtag pa'i gang zag de la zer zhing / de ni rtsod pa'i shan 'byed pa po yin no/ /thog mar rtsod pa byed dus rigs slong bas thal mo brdabs nas lag mthil gnyis bskor te g.yas pa'i sor rtse g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang mnyam pa na thal skad btang nas ((ṣ+ṭhaḥgoji ltar chos can〉〉 zer bzhin lag g.yas yar 'degs pa dang / g.yon pa'i lag mthil sa la gtod par byed cing / 22zla ཿ 〉〉 skad ni rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sa bon dhī ཿ yig la skad blangs nas 99zla ཿ 〉〉 zhes brjod pa dang / 29ji ltar chos can〉〉 zhes pa ni rtsod gzhi ji ltar len dang chos ji ltar 'chad ces pa'i don yin pas 99zla ཿr+shaji ltar chos 'chad zer pa'ang yod/ de'i mjug tu rtags gsal gang 'phen la bsam blo gtong ba'i ched du yā ring bo zhig bzhag chog pa dang / kha rog ger yun ring bor mi 'dug par (9yabartag pa yin par thal/ yod pa gang zhig dngos po ma yin pa'i phyir〉〉 zhes 'phen bzhin lag g.yas kyis phreng ba'i khugs nas bzung ste g.yon pa'i steng du bskon cing / rkang ba g.yon pa cung zad yar bkyags nas thal rdeb dang rkang rdeb rtags kyi phyir sgra dang mnyam par byas te thal mo brdabs nas lag g.yas thur du phab ma thag phyir 'then nas yar 'degs la g.yon pa'i kha thur du gtod par byed pa dang / rnam 'gyur gyi mjug tu rkang ba g.yas pa'i phyi rting cung zad re yar 'degs pa red/ de9 la dam bca' bas lus drang bo'i bzo lta dang bcas te (tsa'adod〉〉 ces lan btab nas spyir rtag pa yin par khas len pa dang / de nas rigs slong bas g.yon pa'i lag ngar gyi phreng ba phyir blangs nas (4rtag pa ma yin par thal/dngos po yin pa'i phyirasna zhes 'phen pa dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur gong dang 'dra/ de la dam bca' — 29 —
bas 99rtags ma grubaje ces lan btab nas spyir dngos po ma yin par khas len pa dang / de nas yang rigs slong bas 2dzodangos po yin par thal/ kha dog yin na dmar bo yin pas khyab pa'i phyir rgyuzhes pa lta bu 'phen dgos shing / 64dngos po yin par thal〉〉 zhes pa'i bar du bsdus grwa'i rtsod pa'i sngon 'gro lta bu yin pa dang / de'i rjes nas bzung rtsod pa'i gzhung dngos la zhugs pa red/ khyab mtha' 'god pa'i tshe na yang / gzhi grub na yod pa yin pas khyab/ yod pa yin na rtag dngos gang rung yin pas khyab/ gzugs yin na dngos po yin pas khyab/ chos dang skad cig ma ma yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa yin na rtag pa yin pas khyab/ ces khas len rgyu yin par thal/ mi len pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu bkod pa la/ de re re'i mjug tu 'di khyab ces khas len/ de ma khyab ces khas len/ 'di 'dod kyang de mi 'dod ces khas len rgyu yin lta bu mi rigs pa dang / rigs slong bas kyang gang 'phen rgyu'i rigs lam de nyid rtags gsal dang sbyar nas 'phen pa ma gtogs e yin dang e khyab/ ji ltar khas len rgyu dang de ltar khas e len sogs dri ba'ang mi rigs te/gzhung dngos kyi brda chad ma gtogs grong tshig dang lung skad mi bsre ba yin/ de bzhin du dam bca' bas kyang rigs slong ba la gang zer ci zer sogs mi 'dri bar (9rtags gsal gsal por thongs 1 92ma go thal11 99'or gi phongs〉〉 zer pa dang / 'phangs pa'i rtags gsal la dam bca' bas lan gnad du 'khel pa zhig btab nas rigs slong ba la sgrub byed ci yang 'god rgyu med par kha rog ger sdod pa'i skabs su/ dam bca' bas 24rtags gsal myur du thongs shog〉〉 dang / de bsdus nas 99thongs shog thongs shog 〉 ces skad brgyab ste rigs slong bar dka' las la gtod par byed pa yin/ rigs slong bas phyi rgol pas khas blangs pa'i dam bca' snga ma dri dgos tshe/lag pa gnyis pus mo re re'i steng du bzhag ste cung zad bsgur nas dri ba dang / khas len ji ltar yin pa nges rjes mu mthud du rtsod par byed/ rigs slong bas rigs lam je rno dang lung je rgyas su btang ba dang bstun nas dam bca' bas kyang ngar cha dang bcas te skad je mtho dang lan yang — 30 —
myur bar btab nas/ 'dod/ shin tu 'dod/ shin tu nas kyang 'dod/ rtags ma grub/ rtags lo dgu la ma grub/ rtags bskal ba'i bar du ma grub/ ci'i phyir/ khyab pa ma byung / ma khyab/ khyab pa ma grub/ khyab pa gtan nas med/ 'gal khyab/ 'gal khyab la 'phud sog sa kyi lan ngar bo btab ste rigs slong bar cung tsam yang mi brtsi ba'i nyams ston par byed pa dang / sna gnyer gnyer dang ske gcu ba sogs ma zhum pa'i rnam 'gyur sto/na par ma zad/ skabs 'gar dam bca' bas lag g.yas phyir phyungs nas se gol gtog zhor rigs slong ba'i sgrub byed dang khyab pa nas bzung ste phyir rtags gsal 'phen pa'ang yod/ de bzhin du dam bca' bas phyin ci log tu khas blangs tshe/ rigs slong bas ngar che zhing skad mthon pos gnod byed 'phen pa dang / rtsod pa'i rnam 'gyur yang rim bzhin je drag dang je myur du song bas phrag g.yon gyi gzan lag ngar gyi steng du yang yang lhung zhing / skabs der rigs slong bas gzan myur du skyed par dkris te rtsod pa byed par stabs bde byas nas rtags gsal 'phen pa dang / dam bca' ba'i khas len snga phyi gnyis 'gal bar gyur tshe/ rigs slong bas lag g.yas kyi phyi ngos g.yon pa'i phyi ngos la rdeg bzhin 29tsha batsha ba tsha〉〉 zer pa dang / de'i don smru gong du khas blangs pa dang mjug tu khas blangs pa gnyis nang 'gal lam dam bca' snga/ ma shor song ba red ces pa'i brda yin/ skabs 'gar dam bca' bas thal 'gyur la lan 'debs par bsam blo btang nas cung tsam 'gor tshe/ rigs slong bas 99'char/'char/ 'char〉〉 zer pa dang / de'i don ni lan myur du thobs zhes pa dang / rtags gsal la bsam blo btang nas yid la 'char ba myur du shod ces pa'i brda yin/ yang rigs slong bas rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ga dang ldan pa'i thal 'gyur yang dag cig 'phangs pa la/ dam bca' bas rtags dang gsal ba gnyis chos can gyi steng du grub pa khas blangs nas/ rtags de yin na gsal ba de yin pas ma khyab ces khas blangs pa la/ rigs slong bas de ltar khyab pa rigs pas bsgrubs te khas len du bcug pa na rtags gsal khyab gsum re re nas khas blangs song bas dam bca' ba — 31 —
la 'khor gsum bskor par byed pa dang / 'khor gsum bskor tshul smru/ rigs slong bas phreng ba lag g.yas kyi spar bar bzung nas dam bca' ba'i mgor bskor pa'am phur phur sogs byed pa dang / de la yang 'khor gsum g.yas su bskor pa dang 'khor gsum g.yon du bskor pa gnyis yod/dam bca' bas khas len ma shor bar du 'khor gsum mi bskor pa dang / khas len gtan nas ma shor na yang shor khul gyis 'khor gsum bskor pa'ang yod/ dam bca' bas khas len shor tshabs che ba dang rigs slong bas rigs lam glod pa sogs kyi skabs su/ 99o/ ha/ ha/ ha/ hā11 zhes au mtho zhing ring bar byas nas hab cha byed pa dang / ha rnams kher chod byas nas mjug ring bo byas te/ ha re dang thal mo re rdeb pa mnyam par byed/ rtsod pa'i skabs su rigs slong ba dam bca' ba'i nye sar btud drags na/ dam bca' ba'i khas len ci shor gang shor gzhan gyis mi thos pas cung rgyang ring bo nas rtags gsal 'phen pa red/ bsdus grwa'i rtsod gzhi thung bas de chos can gcig pu zer rgyu ma yin par rtsod gzhi dngos su sbyar nas 'phen pa dang / don la dpyad pa gtong bar sman zhing khas len la gnod tshabs che bar dmigs nas de ltar 'phen pa ma gtogs/dmigs bsal gyi skabs su rtsod gzhi mi sbyor ba'ang yod/ cig chos can zhes brjod pa'i rjes su mig 'dzum gnyis gsum tsam gyi yun la kha rog ger bsdad nas rtsod gzhi gang yin gzhan la tshor bar byed pa dang / rtags dang gsal ba gnyis bar du'ang mtshams gsal por phye nas 'phen pa ma gtogs ngag ldab ldib dang lus 'tshab 'tshub mi byed/ rtags 'god mi bde ba'i skabs su/99'dod pa'i phyir22 66khas len 'thad pa'i phyir17 99khyod kyis dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir〉〉 46de ltar yin pa khyod kyis khas blangs pa'i phyir〉〉 zhes pa lta bu rtags su bkod pa dang / lung 'dren pa'i tshe na yang 99khams gsum bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i bzhed pa gang zhig khyod kyis khas len dgos pa'i phyir〉〉 (tsamakhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa yin pa gang zhig khyod kyis khas blangs na skal ba dang ldan pa'i phyir 1 99kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i dgongs pa yin pa —32 —
gang zhig khyod kyis khas blangs chog pa'i phyir〉〉 ((bse ngag dbang bkra shis kyi bzhed pa gang zhigkhyod kyis khas blangs na bzo lta mi 'chor ba'i phyir11 99de ltar yin pa rwa bsod nams dbang rgyal gyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir〉〉 zhes pa lta bu kha shom dang bcas te rtags gsal 'phen par byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa/ rtsod pa'i mdzes rgyan dang lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi mtshonagon/thog mar thal skad gtong ba'i dus su thal mo brdabs nas lag mthil gnyis bskor te yar 'then pa'i g.yas pa'i sor rtse g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang mnyam pa na thal skad gtong ba mdzes pa'i rgyan yin la/ lag g.yas yar btegs pas ngan song thams cad bde 'gro la 'god pa dang / g.yon pa'i lag mthil zil gnon gyi tshul du thur du gtad pas ngan song thams cad kyi skye sgo gcod pa mtshon/ rtsod pa'i skabs su lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcings pa dang / g.yas pa'i sor mo thar bcad de yar bkyags rjes khu tshur kha phye nas thal mo brdabs te lag g.yas thur du phab pa dang mnyam du phyir 'then nas snyan gong du slebs pa tsam gyis chog la/ ha cang mtho drags pa dang / ha cang dma' drags pa/ mdun dang rgyab tu 'khyog che ba sogs mi mdzes/ rkang ba g.yon pa sa la rdeb pa'i tshe na'ang / yar btegs pa ha cang dma' drags na sa la rdeb tshe yan lag thar sha chod pa'i chos rtsod kyi rnam pa mi thon par bag 'khums pa'i nyams rang shugs kyis thon pa dang / rkang ba thad sor ma btegs pa dang btegs pa ha cang mtho drags na sham thabs dang smad g.yogs la gnod par ma zad/ dam bca' ba la ma gus pa'i tshu la yang bstan pas rkang g.yon tshad dang ldan pa zhig yar btegs nas sa la brdabs pa ni mdzes shing brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur yin pa dang /g.yas pa sa la brdabs pa dang mnyam du rigs slong ba yang dam bca' ba'i nye sar cung zad btud pa yin la/ rnam 'gyur gyi mjug tu rkang ba g.yas pa'i phyi rting cung zad re yar 'degs pa —33 —
mdzes pa dang / btegs pa mtho drags pa dang rkang ba g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis 'degs 'jog sna tshogs bsgyur pa ni rtsod pa'i mdzes rgyan min/ thal mo rdeb pa'i skabs su/ lag pa gnyis ring du brkyangs nas lus phung dang ha cang ring ba lta bu ma yin pa dang / bskums drags pa ha cang brang dang nye ba ma yin pa/ mtho drags pa dang dma' drags pa/ nu ma g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs su yo ba sogs ma yin par 'phen rgyu'i rtags gsal gyi phyir sgra dang dus mnyam par thal mo rdeb cing /lag g.yas gyen du 'phyar bas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ral gri mtshon pa dang / g.yon pa yar btegs pas pad sdong steng gi glegs bam mtshon/ lag mthil gnyis phrad pas shes rab sgos gzhung sher phyin sogs la thos bsam byed pa mtshon pa dang / lag mthil pha mthar bskyal bas de 'dra'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa mtshon pa red/ thal rdeb kyi mjug tu kha ltag ger 'khor ba lta bu byas chog pa dang / dam bca' bas lan 'debs pa'i skabs su rigs slong ba cung zad bsgur nas lag pa gnyis ltag ger btsugs te re re thar chod pa'am g.yas pas phreng ba nas 'then zhing g.yon pa thar bcad nas 'dug pa ni pha rol bo zil gyis gnon pa'i rnam 'gyur yin pa ma gtogs/ khog stod 'khyog cing bsgur nas 'dug pa dang / thal mo brdabs pa'i mjug tu lag pa gnyis brkyangs nas ldem ldem byed pa sogs mi mdzes/ 'khor gsum bskor pa'i dus su yang / rigs slong bas 'khor gsum g.yas su bskor rjes kha g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba dang / 'khor gsum g.yon du bskor rjes kha g.yon du 'khor ba las 'khor gsum g.yas su bskor nas kha g.yon du 'khor ba sogs mi mdzes/ 'khor gsum g.yas su bskor pa ni rigs slong bas 'phangs pa'i rigs lam yang dag de la dam bca' bas lan gnad la 'khel zhing don dang mthun pa zhig 'debs ma thub par khas blang snga phyi 'gal nas rtags gsal khyab gsum khas blangs tshe/ rigs slong bas phreng ba spar bar bzung ba'i lag g.yas rang nyid kyi brang nas bsrings te dam bca' ba'i mgo'i steng du g.yas su bskor cing / des rigs slong ba ngas rtogs zin pa'i rigs pa dang lung 'di dag dam — 34—
ca' ba khyod kyis kyang rtogs par gyur cig ces pa mtshon pa dang / 'khor gsum g.yon du bskor ni rigs slong bas 'phangs pa'i rtags gsal la dam bca' bas gnad la 'khel zhing don dang thun pa'i lan tag tag btab nas rigs slong bar dka' las la gtad pa dang / rigs slong khus dam bca' bshig ci thub byas nas mtha' mar 'khor gsum bskor tshe/ rigs slong bas phreng kyu bzung ba'i lag g.yas kyis dam bca' ba'i mgo'i steng du g.yon du bskor nas mthar phyir rang brang khar 'then pa dang / des dam bca' ba khyod rgyud kyi lung dang rigs pa de dag rigs slong kyu ngas kyang rtogs par gyur cig ces pa mtshon pa red/ rtags gsal rjes ma la bsam blo gtong ba'i ched du 99'khor ro ro tis 〉 zhes yun ring bor bskor chog pa dang / 99nyis 〉 zhes pa don 5 66dhiḥ 〉〉 zer pa yin yang mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis de ltar smras pa yin/ rtsod pa lung dang rigs pa'i gzhung la bab tshe/ rigs slong ba ngar langs pa'i tshod kyis lung rigs je dar du btang nas rtags gsal 'phen pa dang / dam bca' bas lan btab ste 99gnod byed yod na thongs shog〉〉 zer bzhin khas len ma shor ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan te mgo gzengs su bstod pa ma gtogs/ yul skad dang grong gtam sna tshogs bsres te lan 'debs pa dang ngar bo mi byed par bag 'khums nas 'dug pa sogs ni mdzes shing brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur min la/ rigs slong bas gzan sked par dkri dus su yang ska rags ltar bcings pa dang smad g.yogs ltar dkri ba/ dam por ma dkris par lag pa brkyang skum 'ga'i rjes 'phral du zhig 'gro ba dang dpung mgo btums pa sogs kyang mi mdzes pas spang bya yin/ rtsod pa'i dus su sems kyi kun slong chos dang mthun pa gal che ste/ pha rol dam bca' ba zil gyis mnan par 'dod pa dang / rigs slong ba rang nyid rgyal bar 'dod pa/ pha rol rigs slong ba rang gi rtsod zla min par sems pa dang / dam bca' ba rang nyid mtho bar 'dod pa/ rtsod pa'i dpang bos kyang rtsod gleng byas pa'i don de nyid yang dag par bden rdzun gyi shan phyed de skyes bu'i rgyud kyi log rtog sel ba la mi 'bad par nye ring chags sdang gi phyogs su — 35 —
lhung nas phyin ci log tu smra ba sogs ni ha cang mi legs pas spang bya'i gnad dam pa yin yang /lus kyi rnam 'gyur la ngar che ba dang yan lag thar sha chod pa nges par dgos te/ de phan tshun la 'gran sems bcangs nas dpe klog la 'bad par phan pas so/ / hab cha byed pa'i skabs su/ a ha ha/ a ha ha mi zer bar au ha/ ha/ ha/ hā zhes e sgra mtho zhing ring ba dang / ha re dang thal mo re dus mnyam par byed pa mdzes rgyan yin/ rtsod pa byed dus dam bca' ba lus drang bor bsdad de rtags gsal dang yig cha la bsam blo gtong ba dang / blo rtse rnyed pa na rim gyis lan myur zhing gnad la 'khel ba tag tag 'debs pa legs shing / rigs slong ba yar 'gro mar 'gro ring bo byed bzhin rigs pa gtsor byas nas ngar cha dang bcas te rtags gsal 'phangs nas dam bca' bshig ci thub la 'bad pa mdzes shing brjid pa'i rnam 'gyur yin/ mdor na/ rigs slong ba'i yan lag thar chod pa dang / skad kyi gzengs mtho ba/ rgyab rten gyi lung btsan zhing sgrub byed kyi rigs pa rno ba/ lus ngag grim cha dang ngar cha che ba/ dam bca' ba yang lus drang bor 'dug pa/skad mtho zhing lan gnad la 'khel ba dang rigs lam mi mnyam pa la khyab mtha' gcod pa/ rtsod pa'i dbang po nyid kyang sems phyogs su ma lhung bar rtsod pa'i shan yang dag par phye ste rigs slong ba dang dam bca' ba'i rgyud kyi log rtog sel ba sogs ni chos grwa'i rtsod pa'i mdzes rgyan yin no/ /—36—

ratan tshigs rig pa dang phyi tshul gtan tshigs rig pa gnyis kyi rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa phan tshun bsdur nas dpyad pa/gleng slong ba'i gzhi/de yang bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring nas bzung ste dar ba'i mgo tshugs shing / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang mnga' bdag khri ral ba can sa kyi dus su rim bzhin rig gnas 'phel rgyas su phyin pa la brten nas bod yul du nang da chos lugs dang bzo ba rig pa/ gso ba rig pa/ skar rtsis dang rtsom rig sogs phun sum /sa pa zhig byung ba dang / dus der tshad ma rig pa yang bod gangs can gyi ljongs su thog mar ri ba yin te/ de'i dus su lo tsā ba chen po ska ba dpal brtsegs dang zhang ye shes sde/ be+e ro tsa na ’ sa kyis dpal ldan chos grags dang slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi/ slob dpon dul ba lha sogs kyis /da pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhig bod yig tu bsgyur mod/ 'chad mnyan gyi srol med sra spel ma nus/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su lo tsā ba rin chen bzang bam̐ dang de'i dngos slob rma ge ba'i blo gros dang rngog blo lda/na shes rab yab sras la sogs pas rgya gar gyi tshad ma'i bsta/na cos mang bo zhig bod du bsgyur te 'chad mnyan gyis gtan la phab pa dang / phyis su jo bo rje'i ngos slob rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu dgon pa thog mar btab ste mtshan nyid kyi 〈chad mnyan rgya cher spel bar brten slob ma'i 'khor mang du 'dus/ de rnams las rang gī dngon — 37 —
por gyur pa rngog blo ldan shes rab kyis slob dpon phyogs glang gi tshad ma kun btus dang dpal ldan chos grags kyi tshad ma sde bdun gnyis bskyar du rdzogs par bsgyur nas mtshan nyid kyi 'chad mnyan mu mthud du spel pa dang / sgos su rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi dngos slob cha ba chos kyi seng ges tshad ma'i gzhung dang gzhung 'grel mdzad nas mtshan nyid kyi 'chad mnyan rgya cher spel ba la brten nas bod gangs can gyi yul du tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung lugs rgya cher dar ba yin/dus mtshungs su nang bstan chos lugs kyang rgya cher dar zhing 'phel rgyas su song ba yin phyin de gnyis bar la rim bzhin 'brel ba dam po zhig chags te tshad ma rig pa ni nang bstan chos lugs la 'jug pa'i sgo dang rmang gzhi'i gzhung lugs shig tu gyur pa red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ sngon chad bod khams spyi la dgon sde ma gtogs slob gnyer byed sa med la/ bod kyi mkhas dbang thams cad kyis dgon pa nas rig gzhung la sbyangs te mkhas par gyur pa dang / de rnams kyis bod kyi rig gnas che chung thams cad 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas pa yin pas nang bstan chos lugs kyi gzhung phal cher gyi brjod bya'i ngon rnams gtan tshigs kyi lam nas gtan la phab pa red/de'i rkyen gyis nang bstan chos lugs dang sngon byon mkhas dbang ris med kyis mdzad pa'i ljags rtsom rnams bklag pa dang de rnams la phyogs so so nas zhib 'jug mi dman pa zhig bya dgos na nges par gtan tshigs rig pa'i rigs lam la mtha' 'khyol pa zhig sbyang dgos te/ yab rje bla ma skal ldan rgya mtshos/ phra zhing mdzangs la zhib mo'i rnam dpyod kyis/ / thub pa'i gsung gi dka' ba'i gnad dag la/ / rigs pa'i lam nas sgro 'dogs ma bcad na/ / 'di don 'di zhes smra ba shab shob yin/ / zhes dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bos/ rigs pas brdar sha ma bcad gzhung don la/ / tshig spyi'i ko ba lam tsam yod na yang / / brgal zhing brtags na bye ma'i mching bu ltar/ / 'gyur phyir rigs pa'i gnad gsang zhib tu slobs/ / zhes dang / rje dmu dge bsam gtan gyis/ gtan tshigs rig pa dang mtshan nyid rig pa la phyogs mthong tsam re med na sum — 38—
