phyogs 'bring ba de sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che chung gnyis ku'i nang du mjug tu yod pa dang / de'i grub tshul gyi rnam pa ni 94lo bya lo 8—2 lta bu dang / de'i gsum pa ni phyogs 'bring ba de sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che chung gnyis ku'i nang du sngon du bkod yod la/ de'i grub tshul gyi rnam pa nilo47 lo bya 8—2 lta bu/ de'i sbyor tshul gyi rnam pa bzhi ba ni phyogs 'bring ba de sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba'i nang du mjug tu bkod cing / sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen chung ba'i nang du sngon du bkod yod pa zhig yin te/ de'i grub tshul gyi rnam pa ni 74lo lo45 8—2 lta bu rnams te/ sbyor tshul gyi rnam pa rigs gsum po 'di ni bod kyi sgrub ngag la med pa'i tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sbyor tshul zhig yin/ gzhan don rjes dpag dang tshan gsum sgrub ngag gnyis la rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos re yod pas nga tshos phyi tshul gtan tshigs rig pa'i tshan gsum sgrub ngag tshad gzhir bzung nas gzhan don rjes dpag sogs la skyon brjod par mi rigs la/ gzhan don rjes dpag gi sgrub ngag thams cad tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi rnam pa can du bsgyur pa ni de bas kyang mi rigs so/ /gnyis pa/ rtagasaskyor dang tshan gsum sgrub ngagrtags sbyor zhes pa ni bod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i brjod bya brgyad kyi ya gyal rjes dpag tshad ma'i rten yin la/ rjes dpag yang dag cig skyes pa la de'i rten yang dag cig la brten dgos/ de'i phyir rtags sbyor gyis bod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i khrod du ches gal che ba'i go gnas bzung yod cing / sgrub ngag kyang 'di la brten nas 'god dgos pas de dang tshan gsum sgrub ngag gnyis gshib bsdur byas na dgos gal shin tu che bar mthong /2 1 rtags sbyor spyir bshad pa/bod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba la sbyor ba yang dag dang sbyor ba ltar snang gnyis yod pa —58—
las 'dir sbyor ba yang dag gtsor byas nas cung zad 'chad pa la/ tshad ma rigs sgo las/ gtan tshigs ni tshul gsum mo/ / tshul gsum gang zhe na/ phyogs kyi chos nyid dang / mthun pa'i phyogs nyid la yod par nges pa dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs nyid la med pa nyid du nges pa yang ngo / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs chos/ rjes khyab/ ldog khyab ste tshul gsum yin pa ni gtan tshigs yang dag gi mtshan nyid yin/ de rnams so so'i mtshan nyid yod de/ de sgrub kyi shes 'dod chos can skyon med kyi steng du 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa/ de sgrub kyi phyogs chos kyi mtshan nyid/ de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs kho na la 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa/ de sgrub kyi rjes khyab kyi mtshan nyid/ de sgrub kyi dngos kyi bsgrub bya'i chos kyi don ldog dang 'brel stobs kyis de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs la 'god tshul dang mthun par med pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa/ de sgrub kyi ldog khyab kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi la sbyar te cung zad brjod na/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par bsgrub pa'i sbyor ba lta bu la mtshon na/ byas pa de sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos/ rjes khyab/ ldog khyab gsum ga yin/ byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i phyogs chos yin te/ sgra de byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i shes 'dod chos can skyon med kyang yin/ byas pa sgra dang phan tshun tha dad pa'i tshul gyis sgra'i steng du 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa de sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rjes khyab kyang yin te/byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags chos gnyis ldan gyi mthun dpe yang dag yod / byas pa mi rtag pa la 'brel/ byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i mthun phyogs kho na la 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa de sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i ldog khyab kyang yin te/ byas pa'i rtags kyis sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags chos gnyis dang mi ldan pa'i mi mthun dpe yang dag yod/ byas pa mi rtag pa la 'brel/ byas pa de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs la med pa kho nar tshad mas nges pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhib tu re re bzhin rtags rigs kyi gzhung — 59 —
rnams las shes par bya/ gong du byas pa de sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags kyi tshul gsum yin pa mtshon tsam bkod pa yin la/ byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum yin pas byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa dang / sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag 'god pa skabs su bab pa'i chol ba la/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa'i sbyor ba ni sbyor ba yang dag yin/ yin yang sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag la byas pa kho nar nges pa ma yin no/ /2 2 yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba dang tshan gsum sgrub ngagbod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba ni tshul gsum yin pa gzhir byas nas bsgrub bya de nyid sgrub par byed pa'i yan lag gnyis ldan gyi rnam pa can zhig yin la/ de ni gna' dus rgya gar gyi gtan tshigs kyi sbyor ba'i grub cha zor yang bar bzos te srol rgyun gyi yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba las yan lag gcig dor nas yan lag gnyis ldan du bcos pa yin zhing / des gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba'i rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa zor yang zhing rigs lam gsar pa zhig tu bsgyur pa yin pas/ bod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba ma bshad pa'i sngon du/ thog mar rgya gar gyi yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba dang tshan gsum sgrub ngag gnyis bsdur te cung zad gleng par bya/yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba ni rgya gar gyi slob dpon phyogs glang dang chos grags la sogs pas tshad ma rnying ba'i yan lag lnga ldan gyi sbyor ba zor yang bar bzos pa las byung ba'i rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa gsar pa zhig yin la/ rgya gar gyi tshad ma gsar pa'i rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa gtso bo zhig kyang yin/ de ni bsgrub bya dang rtags dang dpe gsum gyis grub pa yin pas yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba zhes brjod pa yin te/ dper na/ 2———mi rtag ste ——byas pa'i phyir/ dper na bum pa bzhin zhes pa lta bu ste/ de'i bsgrub bya ni rigs 'ded kyi sdom tshig yin la/ rtags ni — 60—
sgrub byed de rigs 'ded kyi rgyu mtshan nam sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin/ rtags la don du phyogs chos brjod pa'i yan lag dang rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag gnyis kyi gtan tshigs kyi 'brel ba zhig 'dus yod pa des bcad rtog gi tshig gsum grub pa yin zhing / de ni tshul gsum ste sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin/ sbyor ba'i rigs 'ded kyi go rim dang nges srol rnams nges par tshul gsum dang bstun dgos shing / tshul gsum yin pa la brten nas bsgrub bya gang yin pa de sgrub par byed pa yin pas rtags yang dag cig yin na nges par phyogs chos/ rjes khyab/ ldog khyab gsum ga grub yod pa zhig yin dgos/ sgra byas pa yin zhes pa ni phyogs chos brjod pa'i yan lag dang / byas na mi rtag pas khyab pa ni rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag yin la/ de dang rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag gnyis kyi bar du thad kur pa'i rigs 'ded kyi 'brel ba zhig grub yod/ de ltar na bsgrub bya sgra mi rtag pa yin zhes pa ni tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi sdom tshig dang 'dra zhing / phyogs chos brjod pa'i yan lag ni de'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen chung ba dang mtshungs/ rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag dang ldog khyab brjod pa'i yan lag gnyis ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba dang mnyam pas de gnyis gang yin yang rtags sam sgrub byed la brten nas bsgrub bya'am sdom tshig gang yin pa de sgrub par byed pa yin phyir don du de gnyis kyi rigs 'ded byed tshul 'dra ba yin/ yin na yang yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba de bkod rim gyi thad nas tshan gsum sgrub ngag dang khyad par che ste/ tshan gsum sgrub ngag ni ngo bo'i bcad rtog gi tshig gsum gyis grub pa yin la/ de las gnyis ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen dang / gcig ni sdom tshig yin par ma zad/ sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gnyis po sngon du bkod cing /sdom tshig de mtha' mar bkod pa zhig yin/ yin yang yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba'i bkod rim gyi rnam pa ni bsgrub bya ( sdom tshig ) sngon du bkod cing rtags dang sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba dang cha 'dra ba'i dpe gnyis mjug tu bkod yod la/ rtsod gzhi dang bsgrub bya'i chos/ rtags dang dpe rnams re re nas bcad rtog gi tshig ma yin par tha snyad tsam gyis mtshon par byas yod par ma zad/— 61 —
rigs 'ded byed stangs ni tshul gsum yin pa gzhir byas nas bsgrub bya de nyid sgrub par byed pa zhig yin/ rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa'i thad nas yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba'i dpe la mu mthud du rjes khyab sgrub par byed pa'i nus pa ldan zhing / des phyogs bsdus rigs 'ded kyi thabs spyad nas bsgrub bya sgrub par byed pa yin gshis/ de smru tshan gsum sgrub ngag la med pa'i khyad chos shig red/rgya gar gyi gtan tshigs rig par zhib 'jug byed mkhan 'ga' res sbyor ba'i dpe ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba yin zhes brjod pa ni 'thad par mi sems te/ tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba ni phyogs che ba 'dus pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen de la bya zhing / yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba'i dpe'i nang du phyogs che ba mi 'dus pa dang / rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag gi nang du da gzod phyogs che ba 'dus pa yin pas/ dpe bum pas phyogs bsdus rigs 'ded kyi thabs spyad nas rjes khyab ste sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba sgrub par byed pa yin pas/ de nyid sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba yin zhes brjod mi rigs shing / des rjes khyab grub par ston pa yin pas rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag gi khongs su 'dus pas na sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba dang cha 'dra ba red/de'i phyir rgya gar gyi yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba ni rnam 'byed rigs 'ded kyi nang du phyogs bsdus kyi thabs 'dus pa'i rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa zhig yin zhing / tshan gsum sgrub ngag gis rnam 'byed thabs bkol nas rigs 'ded byed pa yin pas de ni yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba'i rigs 'ded kyi thabs gtso bo zhig yin/ yan lag gsum ldan gyi sbyor ba'i nang du tshan gsum sgrub ngag 'dus pas na de gnyis gcig mtshungs ma yin no/ /2 3 rtags sbyor dang tshan gsum sgrub ngagbod kyi rtags sbyor ni rjod byed kyi tshig nyung zhing don 'dus la/ sgrub rim thung zhing 'god — 62 —
bde ba'i rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa zhig yin pas de ni bod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i sgrub thabs gtso bo zhig yin/ de dang tshan gsum sgrub ngag gnyis grub cha'i thad nas bltas na/ rtags sbyor ni yan lag gnyis kyis grub pa yin te/ dper na/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu la mtshon na/ bsgrub par bya ba sgra mi rtag pa yin zhes pa de yan lag gcig dang / byas pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so zhes pa de yang yan lag gcig ste yan lag gnyis kyis grub pa zhig yin/tshan gsum sgrub ngag la grub cha gsum yod pa gong du smras zin/ de ga nyis phan tshun bsdur nas brtags na/ sgra mi rtag pa yin zhes pa ni tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi sdom tshig dang 'dra zhing / byas pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa ni sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen chung ba dang mtshungs/ de lta na rtags sbyor la tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba med pas de gnyis khyad par che'o zer na mi 'thad de/rgya gar gyi gtan tshigs rig pa bod du dar rjes/ de la sbyangs pa dpyis phyin pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis rgya gar gyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i sbyor ba la bzo bcos dang de nyid zor yang bar bzos te/yan lag gsum las dpe dor nas tshig zin la dngos su snang ba sdom tshig dang sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen chung ba gnyis ma gtogs med pa'i yan lag gnyis ldan du bcos zhing / dpe bkod pa des rjes khyab grub par ston pa yin pa gong du gleng zin la/ de lta na bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis dpe dor ba des bsgrub bya sgrub par byed pa la gnod pa med dam zhe na med de/ rtags sbyor yang dag gang yin yang rtags de de sgrub kyi tshul gsum yin pa gzhir byas nas bsgrub bya de sgrub par byed pa yin pas rtags sbyor la yang phyogs chos/ rjes khyab/ ldog khyab gsum ga grub dgos/ gong du bkod pa'i sbyor ba de ko rim bzhin bkod na 'di ltar 'gyur te/ sgra byas pa yin/ ( phyogs chos brjod pa'i yan lag ) byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ ( rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag ) rtag na ma byas pa'i khyab/( ldog khyab brjod pa'i yan lag ) de'i phyir sgra mi rtag pa yin/ ( bsgrub bya ) zhes pa lta bu/ bod kyi rtags sbyor gyis rjes khyab gtso bor bzung zhing ldog khyab phal bar brtsis pa ni gtan tshigs rig — 63 —
pa'i chos nyid dang mthun pa zhig yin la/ sbyor ba zhig gi nang du rjes khyab grub yod na ldog khyab kyang grub yod de/ mkhas grub rje'i tshad ma sde bdun gyi rgyan yid kyi mun sel las/ rjes su 'gro ldog gi khyab pa ni sbyor ba skor gcig gi steng du gcig yod na gcig yod pas khyab pa yin la zhes gsungs pa ltar ldog khyab ma bkod na/ sgra byas pa yin/ ( sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen chung ba ) byas na mi rtag pa'i khyab/ ( sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba ) sgra mi rtag pa yin/ ( sdom tshig ) zhes par ltar 'gyur bas rtags sbyor gyi tshig zin la sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba dngos su mi snang yang don du tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi yan lag gsum po tshang bas de gnyis kyi grub cha la khyad par chen po med snyam/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba 'di yang tshul gsum yin pa gzhir byas nas bsgrub bya sgrub par byed pa yin/ rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa 'di deng rabs kyi phyi tshul gtan tshigs rig pa'i rigs 'ded kyi thabs spyad nas brtags na/ de ni ngo bo'i bcad rtog gi tshig thung ba gsum gyis grub pa mngon gsal yin te/ bcad rtog gi tshig snga ma gnyis ni rigs 'ded kyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin zhing / bcad rtog gi tshig phyi ma gcig pu de ni rigs 'ded brgyud nas byung ba'i sdom tshig yin par ma zad/ bcad rtog gi tshig snga ma gnyis kyi nang du thun mong gi chos 99byas pa〉〉 zhes pa 'dus yod pa dang / bcad rtog gi tshig ste sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen de gnyis la brten nas ngo bo'i bcad rtog gsar pa 2 (sgra mi rtag pa yin/〉〉 zhes pa rigs 'ded brgyud nas thon pa red/rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa 'di la phyogs yongs nas bltas na 'byed pa'i rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa zhig yin la/ grub tshul gyi rnam pa dang rigs 'ded byed thabs kyi cha nas brtags na dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i tshan gsum sgrub ngag cig yin te/ sgra byas pa yin/ ( sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen chung ba )byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ ( sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba ) de'i phyir sgra mi rtag pa yin/ ( sdom tshig ) zhes pa lta bu/ de las nga tshos shes thub pa ni rtags sbyor dang tshan gsum sgrub ngag gnyis rigs 'ded byed thabs kyi cha nas gcig mtshungs yin zhing / de ni rtags sbyor kha shas min par — 64—
spyir sbyor ba thams cad kyi rigs 'ded byed thabs de 'dra zhig yin/nga tshos deng skabs kyi dpe brjod bkod nas de la mu mthud du cung zad brtags na/ 99steng gi bkod pa thams cad kyis dpal 'byor rmang gzhir zhabs 'degs zhu ba yin/ ( sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen che ba ) rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni steng gi bkod pa zhig yin/ ( sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen chung ba ) de'i phyir rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis dpal 'byor rmang gzhir zhabs 'degs zhu ba yin/ ( sdom tshig ) 11 zhes pa nī dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpe brjod cig yin zhing / tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi spyi lugs dang rigs 'ded kyi nges srol dang yongs su mthun pa dang / rigs 'ded byed tshul bod kyi sbyor ba dang mthun pas rtags sbyor ltar yang 'god rung ste/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal chos can/ khyod kyis dpal 'byor rmang gzhi la zhabs 'degs zhu ba yin te/ ( bsgrub bya ) khyod steng gi bkod pa yin pa'i phyir/ ( rtags ) zhes pa lta bu/ de bod kyi gtan tshigs rig pa'i rigs 'ded kyi nges srol te tshul gsum gyi rtsa don ltar rigs 'ded byas na/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni steng gi bkod pa zhig yin/( phyogs chos brjod pa'i yan lag ) steng gi bkod pa thams cad kyis dpal 'byor rmang gzhir zhabs 'degs zhu ba yin/ ( rjes khyab brjod pa'i yan lag ) de'i phyir rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis dpal 'byor rmang gzhir zhabs 'degs zhu ba yin/ ( bsgrub bya ) rtags sbyor 'di'i rnam pa'i thad nas bltas na/ de ni ngo bo'i bcad rtog gi tshig gnyis kyis grub pa'i yan lag gnyis ldan gyi sbyor ba zhig yin la/ de'i nang gi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dang / steng gi bkod pa/ dpal 'byor rmang gzhi la zhabs 'degs zhu ba bcas gsum gyi bar du bdag gcig 'brel gyi 'brel ba zhig grub yod la/ de la brten nas bsgrub bya rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis dpal 'byor rmang gzhir zhabs 'degs zhu ba yin zhes pa rigs 'ded brgyud nas thon pa dang / de gsum bar gyi 'brel ba de bod kyi rtags sbyor gyi tshul gsum zhes pa de yin/ de'i phyir/ rtags sbyor ni 'god tshul gyi rnam pa'i thad nas tshan gsum sgrub ngag bsdus ma can zhig yin zhing / rigs 'ded byed thabs kyi cha nas tshan gsum sgrub ngag — 65 —
gi spyi lugs dang rigs 'ded kyi gtan tshigs dang mthun/ yin na yang / de gnyis ni yig rigs dang rig gnas mi 'dra ba gnyis kyi 'phel rgyas kyi khrod du byung ba'i gtan tshigs kyi rigs 'ded kyi rnam pa gnyis yin pas de gnyis gcig mtshungs yin sa dang 'dra sa yod la/ mi mthun sa yang yod pas nga tshos de gnyis gcig mtshungs yin zhes kha tshon gcod mi rung la/ tshan gsum sgrub ngag rtags sbyor las khyad du 'phags zhes thag gcod kyang bya mi rung ste/ de gnyis la rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang bzang cha yod/de gnyis kyi mi mthun sa cung zad 'chad pa la/ ( 1 ) rtags sbyor gang dang gang yin yang thog mar bsgrub bya dang / de'i rjes sgrub byed dam rtags bkod nas bsgrub bya sgrub par byed pa ma zad/bsgrub bya de ni nges par de la shes 'dod zhugs pa'i gang zag srid pa zhig dgos te/ de ni rtags sbyor gyi 29shes 'dod chos can skyon med〉〉 ces pa de yin/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ gtan tshigs the tshom la brjod phyir/ / bsal ba gtan tshigs rten ma yin/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bsgrub bya ni shes 'dod zhugs pa'i gang zag cig la dmigs nas 'god pa dang / rgol ba'i tshad mas rtogs zin pa zhig bsgrub byar 'god mi rung / rtags sbyor gyi nges srol 'dis ci zhig bstan ce na/ mi'i rigs kyis phyi rol yul gyi dngos po ngos 'dzin pa dang / rig gnas gsar par thos pa byed pa gang yin yang dmigs yul dang shes 'dod zhugs pa'i cha rkyen la brten nas rigs 'ded brgyud de thob par byed pa ma gtogs/ dmigs yul dang shes 'dod med pa'i rigs 'ded brgyud nas bsgrub bya sgrub par mi byed pa 'di ni tshan gsum sgrub ngag la med pa'i rtags sbyor gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig yin/ (2 ) tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi rigs 'ded kyi nges srol dang 'gal ba'i nor 'khrul 'ga' ste/ dper na/ 99sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gyi nang du phyogs 'bring ba de bye brag yod tshad mi 'dus pa zhig yin pa dang / sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen gyi nang du phyogs 'bring ba dang phyogs che ba de bye brag yod tshad mi 'dus pa zhig yin yang / sdom tshig gi nang du bye brag yod tshad 'dus —66—
pa/〉〉 la sogs pa'i nges srol dang mi mthun pa rnams rtags sbyor gyi nang du tshul gsum yin pa des tshod 'dzin byas yod pas gtan nas 'byung mi srid pa dang / de bzhin du rtags sbyor gyi rtsod gzhi skyon can dang dus sbyar ma sogs kyi nor 'khrul rnams kyang tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi nang du gtan nas 'byung mi srid/ rgyu mtshan ni tshan gsum sgrub ngag gi rtsod gzhi ( phyogs chung ba ) de yan gar ba'i tshul gyis mi bkod par nges par rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos gnyis sbrel nas ngo bo'i bcad rtog gi tshig grub par byed pa yin gshis 94rtsod gzhi skyon can 〉 gyi nor 'khrul de 'byung mi srid/(3 ) rtags sbyor la sgrub tshul gyi thad nas yin 'god dang yod 'god gnyis yod la/ rtags yang dag la rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag 'bras rtags yang dag ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gsum du dbye yod/ rtags kyi ngo bo dang rtags sbyor gyi 'god tshul mi 'dra bas de'i rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba'ang mi 'dra/ nga tshos gong du bkod pa'i dper brjod ni 'god tshul yin sgrub yin pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag bkod pa'i sbyor ba zhig yin la/ de'i rtags dang bsgrub bya'i chos gnyis bar gyi 'brel ba ni khyab bya khyab byed kyi 'brel ba yin pas de'i gtan tshigs kyi grub tshul de brnyes pa dang sku zhabs mu ler ni de'i srol 'byed mkhan yin par bzhed/ bang zho khro yi (1ṣ+ṭhatsho 2003 2—3) lta tshul gzhir byas na sku zhabs mu ler gyi brtsams chos kyi rin thang gtso bo gsham gyi phyogs gsum du 'dus te/ gcig tu na de'i nang du rtsom pa pos chos lugs rig pa (153 30/074 05kha'/19/0pa) zhes pa'i ming brda de thog mar bkol nas gsar du byung ba'i mi chos rig pa 'di la ming 'os 'tsham zhig btags pa dang / khong gis rang nyid kyi gtam bshad dang brtsams chos nang du chos lugs zhib 'jug gi lo rgyus thog thengs dang por chos lugs rig pa zhes pa'i ming brda de bkol spyod byas pas rgyal spyi'i chos lugs rig pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis 〈chos lugs rig pa'i ngo sprod〉 ni chos lugs rig pa dngos su byung ba'i mtshon byed du 'dod kyin yod/ gnyis su na des chos lugs zhib 'jug la rang tshugs thub pa'i rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi go gnas shig bskrun pa dang / de'i yar sngon du bye brag gi chos lugs zhib 'jug ni ye shu'i chos lugs kyi lha'i rig pa'i nang tshan zhig yin par 'dod kyin yod/ sku zhabs mu ler gyis khong gi brtsams chos nang du 'di ltar gsungs yod de/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i chos lugs zhib 'jug gi khrod du chos lugs gang yin yang zhib 'jug bya yul yin pa 'dra mnyam yin te/ chos lugs gang yin yang de la chos lugs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags 'dod kyi dbang cha med la/ ye shu'i chos lugs kyang de las ma 'das/ khong gi rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi legs bshad ni 99tshan rig la chos lugs kyi grub mtha' mi dgos〉〉 (tshomagi ṣ+ṭha7 9040 48) zhes pa de yin/ chos lugs phan tshun bar gshib bsdur byed pa'i go rim khrod du ye shu'i chos lugs kyi go gnas je mthor btang nas chos lugs gzhan la dma' 'beb byed pa dang / yang na ye shu'i chos lugs la dma' 'beb byas nas chos lugs gzhan rnams kyi go gnas je mthor gtong ba mi rigs te/ de ni chos lugs kyi phyogs ris shig yin pa las tshan rig dang mthun pa'i lta tshul min/ chos lugs kyi zhib 'jug de dad mos ring lugs dang kha bral tshe da gzod lha sgrung rig pa'i bkag rgya las thar te rang tshugs thub pa'i —96—
'phel rgyas kyi lam chen du bkrod thub la/ grub mtha' ring lugs dang kha bral tshe da gzod chos lugs zhib 'jug pa rnams kyi mig rgya cher bskyed de ye shu'i chos lugs las brgal nas 'dzam gling gi chos lugs sna tshogs la kha phyogs thub/ der ma zad da dung sku zhabs mu ler gyis gal te mi zhig gis chos lugs sna gcig ma gtogs mi shes tshe/ mi des chos lugs de nyid ches bla na med pa zhig tu brtsi zhing / de ltar na tshan rig dang mthun pa'i chos lugs zhib 'jug kyang yod mi srid ces gsungs/ gsum du na khong gis chos lugs zhib 'jug gi byed thabs gtso bor bstan pa yin te/chos lugs rig pa'i zhib 'jug bya yul ni ye shu'i chos lugs dang bcas pa'i chos lugs sna tshogs pa rnams yin pas de'i zhib 'jug byed thabs ni phan tshun gshib bsdur gyi thabs lam yin dgos pa dang / gshib bsdur byed thabs spyad nas chos lugs kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed pa ni gshib bsdur gyi chos lugs rig pa dang / de'i gshib bsdur ni rigs sam dbye ba dgar pa yin te/'dzam gling gi chos lugs sna tshogs kyi lo rgyus la rigs sam dbye ba phye ste chos lugs 'phel rgyas kyi go rim dang chos nyid btsal pa red/sku zhabs mu ler ni yon tan gyis rgyud gtams shing brtsams chos shin tu mang ba'i mkhas pa zhig yin pa dang / khos lo ngo mang po'i ring la gna' rabs kyi skad brda rig pa dang rtsom rig lo rgyus dang lha sgrung / mtshan nyid rig pa dang shar phyogs rig pa sogs rig gzhung tshan khag mang por slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byas te grub 'bras 'bur du thon pa zhig blangs yod pas khong la chos lugs skor gyi brtsams chos kyang shin tu mang ste/ 〈'od dpag med kyi mdo〉 dang 〈tshe dpag med kyi mdo〉 dang 〈rdo rje gcod pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo〉 dang 〈shes rab snying po'i mdo〉 sogs shar gling gi gna' rabs kyi dpe cha sgyur sgrig byas pa pod du yod pa'i 〈shar gling gi chos dpe〉 (loca 32094 7754 0( (56 7764) dang / 〈rgya gar gyi mtshan nyid rig pa'i grub mtha' drug bshad pa〉 dang 〈rang byung gi chos lugs〉 〈krung ko'i chos lugs〉 〈nang bstan chos —91—
lugs〉 〈gshib bsdur gyi lha sgrung〉 〈skad brda dang lha sgrung rig pa/ chos lugs gsum gleng pa〉 〈chos lugs kyi 'byung khungs dang 'phel rgyas〉 〈dngos po'i chos lugs/〉 〈mi'i rigs kyi chos lugs〉 〈sems khams kyi chos lugs〉 sogs bsgyur rtsom yang ha cang mang / chos lugs skor gyi sgyur rtsom de dag gis chos lugs rig pa byung bar mthun rkyen legs po zhig bskrun par ma zad/chos lugs rig pa ji ltar 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i lam zhig kyang bstan/ de ltar sku zhabs mu ler gyis 〈chos lugs rig pa'i ngo sprod〉 ces pa brtsams te chos lugs rig pa zhes pa'i ming brda de thog mar bkol pa nas bzung chos lugs rig pa dngos su byung mgo tshugs pa red/gnyis pa/ tshos lugs rig pa byung ba'i rgyu rkyenabashad pa/rtsom pa po tshe mkhar rgyal rgyal (208 73) lags kyis chos lugs rig pa byung ba'i lo rgyus dang spyi tshogs kyi rgyu rkyen dang po ni rtogs sad bsam blo la 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba dang] gnyis pa ni dus rabs bcu drug par skam sa chen po gsar pa rnyed pas yo rob pas sa cha dang mi rigs gzhan pa'i rig gnas dang chos lugs skor gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mang po gsog nyar byed thub par gyur pa/ gsum pa ni ta dben gyi skye dngos 'phel 'gyur smra bas yo rob dang 'gro ba mi'i bsam blo la shan shugs chen po thebs te chos lugs 'phel rgyas kyi lta bar tshan rig gi sgrub byed yod par gyur ces gsungs pa ltar/ dus rabs 3pa'i mjug tu dbyi ta le( /6/5)rgyal khab tu byung zhing rjes su yo rob gling nub ma'i rgyal khab rnams su dar ba 'i rig rtsal bskyar dar gyi rjes su/ rang byung tshan rig dang rtogs sad kyi lta ba/ dngos gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa/ lha med smra ba'i chos lugs kyi lta ba sogs la 'phel rgyas chen po byung bas chos lugs dang chos lugs mthun tshogs rnams la phyogs so so nas phog thug btang zhing phan tshun bar 'gal 'du mang bo byung ba dang / ye shu'i chos lugs dang de'i chos lugs mthun tshogs rnams kyis dbang sgyur byed pa'i gnas bab la 'gyur —98—
ldog byung ste/ rim bzhin shes yon can rnams lha'i byin rlabs la yid mi ches par gyur nas chos lugs dad mos ni ma rig pa'i rmongs dad cig tu 'dod cing / des chos lugs la zhib 'jug byed mkhan tshor chos lugs ni ma shes ma rtogs par dad pa bya yul zhig ma yin par don dngos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas dpyad pa gtong yul zhig yin snyam du bcug ste bsam pa'i thad nas kho tshor mthun rkyen zhig bskrun pa dang / chos lugs zhib 'jug pa rnams kyis ye shu'i chos lugs kyang 'dzam gling steng gi chos lugs gzhan dang 'dra mnyam gyi lta tshul bzung ste chos lugs rnams phan tshun gshib bsdur byas nas zhib 'jug byed mgo brtsams pa red/ gal te rtogs sad kyi lta bas chos lugs dad mos kyi rang lugs dang ye shu'i chos lugs gzhan las mtho ba'i rang lugs la ngo rgol ma byas tshe chos lugs la don dngos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas zhib 'jug bya rgyu gtan nas mi srid pas nye rabs nub gling gi gshib bsdur gyi chos lugs rig pa ni rtogs sad bsam blo la brten nas byung ba ni de'i rgyu rkyen dang po yin/chos lugs kyi zhib 'jug de nyid ye shu'i chos lugs gtso bor 'dzin pa'i gnas bab de las 'da' dgos na ched las mkhas pa rnams kyi zhib 'jug bya yul gyi khyab khongs ni yo rob nub ma'i sa khul las brgal te nges par 'dzam bu'i gling gi chos lugs sna tshogs la rgyus lon bya dgos/gal te de'i thad kyi shes bya dang rgyu cha med na 'dzam bu'i gling gi chos lugs sna tshogs la gzhib bsdur gyi sgo nas zhib 'jug bya rgyu zer ba gtan nas mi srid pa zhig red/ dus rabs 6 par skam sa chen po rnams rnyed pa dang bstun nas yo rob gling gi mi rnams kyi mig gi sgo mo phye zhing / 'dzam gling steng gi sa khul gzhan pa dang de'i mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang chos lugs la 'brel 'dris byed tshad je mang nas je mang rdu gyur pa dang / de'i skor gyi shes bya dang rgyu cha mang po 'tshol sdud byas te dus rabs 9 par slebs pa na da gzod ched las mkhas pa rnams kyis 'dzam gling gi chos lugs sna tshogs phan tshun gshib bsdur byas te phyogs yongs nas zhib 'jug byed thub par gyur —99—

lugs dang thabs lam du gyur/ de bas gshib bsdur gyi chos lugs rig pa ni ta dben gyi skye dngos 'phel 'gyur smra ba la brten nas byung zhing / los ta ci (༅(caḥ 1998 99) yis ta dben rang lugs de tshan rig khrod du rgyal kha thob pa dang bstun nas 'phel rgyas su phyin pas yun ring ma 'gor bar rang tshugs thub pa'i spyi tshogs tshan rig gi rig tshan zhig tu gyur pa red/ de'i mtshon rtags ni yo rob gling dang a me ri kha'i gling gi ming grags che ba'i slob grwa chen mo 'ga' zhig tu rim bzhin gshib bsdur gyi chos lugs rig pa'i slob khrid byed mgo brtsams pa dang / skabs der bslab bya'i ming la chos lugs lo rgyus zhes btags yod/ da dung de 'chad khrid byed mkhan gyi dge rgan bskos par ma zad ched las kyi dus deb par skrun byas/ spyi lo 1900 lor h+pha ran si'i phad re sir skabs dang po'i chos lugs lo rgyus kyi rgyal spyi'i tshogs 'du 'tshogs par ma zad/ rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin gyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi rtsa 'dzugs kyang btsugs pa red ces gsungs/ gong du bshad pa ni chos lugs rig pa byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gsum yin la/ rgyu rkyen de dag 'dzoms pa la brten nas chos lugs rig pa zhes pa'i spyi tshogs tshan rig gi rig tshan de byung ba red/gsum pa/ chos lugs rig pa'i 'phel rim bshad pa/los ta ci (ṭha〉tshi 19yo 528—529) yis a me ri khar gzhi chags pa'i 'jar man gyi chos lugs rig pa ba bo chim (3 gi705 1898—1955) gyis khong gi 〈gshib bsdur gyi chos lugs rig pa〉 zhes pa'i nang du chos lugs rig pa'i 'phel rim dus skabs gsum du bgos yod na'ang nga tshos de'i 'phel rim dus skabs gnyis su bgos na lo rgyus kyi don dngos dang mthun tshabs che zhes gsungs pa ltar sku zhabs mu ler lags kyis chos lugs rig pa zhes pa'i tha snyad de bkol pa nas bzung / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po dbye mtshams byas na chos lugs rig pa'i 'phel rim dus skabs gtso bo gnyis su 'dus te/ dus skabs dang po ni dus rabs 9 pa'i lo rabs 70 nas dus —101—

2 sna mang du 'phel ba'i dus skabs/dus skabs gnyis pa ni dus rabs 20pa'i stod kyi cha nas dus rabs 20pa'i lo rabs60nas70bar yin la/ dus skabs der chos lugs rig pa'i mkhas pa dang zhib 'jug pa mang che shos kyis chos lugs la don dngos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas sdom tshig 'god par mthong chen mi byed par mi sger gyi chos lugs kyi nyams myong dang / chos lugs kyis spyi tshogs la thon pa'i nus pa/ chos lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos sogs kyi gnad don brjod pa gtsor byas pas rim bzhin chos lugs kyi sems khams rig pa dang chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs rig pa/ chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa sogs byung / 'dzam gling 'khrug chen thengs dang po'i rjes su/ chos lugs la zhib 'jug byed pa'i kha phyogs 'gyur te chos lugs kyi snang tshul sna tshogs dang chos lugs kyis spyi tshogs la thon pa'i nus par don dngos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas gsal bshad dang zhib brjod byas pa gtsor bzung ba la brten nas chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa dang chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs rig pa gnyis byung ba red/chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa ni gdod ma'i chos lugs kyi ngo gdong gi snang tshul la zhib 'jug dang rgyus lon byed pa zhig yin la/ dus rabs 19 pa'i mjug tu hu lan rgyal khab kyi mkhas pa so sa ye (58455750) yis brtsams chos 〈chos lugs lo rgyus kyi deb chung〉 (77757/0845050 'amang 0lta56/ 6 07) nang du chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa zhes pa'i ming brda de thog mar bkol pa dang / de rjes dus rabs 20 pa'i lo rabs 30 pa'i nang du hu lan gyi slob gso rig pa ba le bo (799 6065lta18941950) yis 〈chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa〉 zhes pa'i brtsams chos mdzad pa des rig tshan 'di'i rmang btings shing de la brten nas chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa byung ste/ de nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su phyin pa red/ chos lugs rig pa ba so sa ye dang le bo sogs kyis chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa thog mar gsar gtod mdzad de/ de la dpyad brjod byas pas hu lan rgyal —104—
khab ni chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur/ (4phyogo 1992 81)chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs rig pas gtso bo chos lugs kyis spyi tshogs la thon pa'i byed nus dang nus pa brjod pa yin te/ chos lugs dad mos tshodang spyi tshogs nang gi mi'i bya spyod bar gyi 'brel ba dang / chos lugs dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i ( dpal 'byor/ chab srid/ spyi tshogs kyi gral rim/gnyen sgrig dang khyim tshang sogs/) bar gyi 'brel ba/ chos lugs kyi rtsa 'dzugs/ chos lugs byed sgo'i 'phel rgyas dang nyams rgud/ spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba bcas la zhib 'jug byed pa yin la/ rig tshan 'di'i srol 'byed mkhan ni h+pha ran si'i spyi tshogs rig pa ba tar khan dang 'jar man gyi bsam blo ba mad khu si bed pur ( lo47cang rta18yo 1920) gnyis yin/gong du chos lugs zhib 'jug gi kha phyogs gzhan du 'gyur ba'i phyogs gcig bshad zin la/phyogs gnyis pa ni mi rnams kyis chos lugs dad mos las byung ba'i myong ba khyad par can rnams gtsor bzung ste gsal bshad byas pa la brten nas chos lugs kyi sems khams rig pa byung mgo brtsams/ des mi sger gyi nyams myong dang sems khams gtso bor bzung ste mi sger gyi bsam pa'i myong ba'i skor brjod pa yin la/ mi'i sems khams kyi thad nas chos lugs la zhib 'jug byed pa'i kha phyogs gsar pa zhig gi lam yang bstan pa red/ chos lugs kyi sems khams rig pa'i zhib 'jug bya yul ni mi sger dang tshogs pa rnams kyi chos lugs byed sgo'i thad kyi sems khams kyi snang tshul khyad par can dang / mi rnams kyi sems khams kyi chos nyid de chos lugs dang spyi tshogs gnyis kyis phan tshun la nus pa thon pa'i go rim las 'gyur ldog byung ba dang / chos lugs kyis mi sger gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rang gshis grub par shan shugs thebs/ des sems khams rig pa'i zhib 'jug byed thabs spyad nas chos lugs kyi 'byung khungs dang byed nus/ chos lugs kyi 'du shes dang ngo bo/ byung rkyen dang 'phel rgyas/ chos lugs kyi nyams myong dang chos lugs kyi gsol 'debs sogs kyi khyad chos bcas la zhib 'jug byed pa yin/ de ni chos lugs rig pa dang sems — 105—
khams rig pa gnyis 'dres pa'i rig tshan zhig yin la/ de'i srol 'byed mkhan ni yongs grags ltar na/ 'jar man gyi sems khams rig pa ba bun thi (gi /be /kho gi57749 1837—1920) dang a me ri kha'i mtshan nyid rig pa ba be rin jam si (7////'kho 'kho4 142—1910) gnyis yin par 'dod/ rig tshan 'di'i 'byung khungs ni yo rob gling yin na yang / de nyid a me ri khar rang tshugs thub pa'i rig tshan zhig tu grub pa red/ gong gsal las nga tshos shes thub pa ni/ chos lugs rig par 'phel rgyas kyi go rim nges can zhig yod par ma zad/ de ni bye brag gi rig tshan mang po yod pa'i spyi tshogs tshan rig gi ya gyal zhig yin/ de'i bye brag gi rig tshan phan tshun bar dang de rnams kyi 'phel rgyas kyi dus skabs ni bar chod pa zhig min par phan tshun bsnol cing gcig la gcig brten gyis 'phel rgyas su phyin pa zhig red/ 'das zin pa'i lo ngo brgya lhag gi dus yun nang du chos lugs rig pa ni rim bzhin zhib 'jug bya yul zhig nas rig tshan zhig 4gyur pa dang de'i dmigs yul ni mi'i rigs kyi chos lugs kyi bya spyod la rgyus lon bya thub pa'i ched du yin/ (ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha 2004 96)mdor na/ sku zhabs mu ler gyis 〈chos lugs rig pa'i ngo sprod〉 ces pa brtsams te chos lugs rig pa'i srol thog mar phye ba nas bzung rig tshan de nyid dngos su byung mgo tshugs shing /de nas 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i bar du gtso bo gshib bsdur gyi chos lugs rig pa dar pa dang / zhib 'jug byed thabs cung ma 'dra bas rim bzhin chos lugs kyi lo rgyus rig pa dang chos lugs kyi mi'i rigs rig pa gnyis byung ba ni chos lugs rig pa'i 'phel rim gyi dus skabs dang po yin/ 'dzam gling 'khrug chen dang po'i rjes su phyi gling gi mkhas pa rnams kyis mi sger gyi chos lugs kyi nyams myong dang / chos lugs kyis spyi tshogs la thon pa'i nus pa/ chos lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos sogs kyi gnad don la zhib 'jug byas pas rim bzhin chos lugs kyi sems khams rig pa dang chos lugs kyi spyi tshogs rig pa/ chos lugs kyi snang tshul rig pa sogs byung ba ni de'i 'phel rim gyi dus skabs gnyis pa yin no/ /—106

mu stegs rgyang 'phen pas lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig tu 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang nang bstan pas de nyid tshul ji ltar bkag pa la dpyad pa/dang po/ gleng bslangs te rdzas gcig gi don phyir bshad pa/phyi rol rgyang 'phen pa ni gna' bo'i rgya gar du dar ba'i grub mtha' zhig ste/ kho'i lugs la lkog gyur dang rjes dpag tshad ma khas mi len pas kho las gzhan pa'i phyi nang gi grub mtha' phal mo ches 'dod pa'i skye ba snga phyi de gtan nas mi 'dod par ma zad/ nyi shar chu bo thur du 'bab pa dang / /sran zlum tsher ma gzeng ring rno ba dang / / rma bya'i mdongs la sogs pa'i chos rnams kun/ / sus kyang ma byas ngo bo nyid las byung / / zhes pa ltar rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag kyang khas mi len pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod tshul mang du snang zhing / khyad par du de nyid deng gi nub gling mtshan nyid rig pa'i mes po mar le'i ring lugs dngos gtso smra ba dag gis kyang de ltar mi'i rigs kyi thun mong gi mthong thos reg gsum gyi dngos po tsam las las 'bras dang thar pa/ lha dang dkon mchog sogs lkog gyur gyi dngos po khas mi len pa'i lta ba rlabs chen dang yang phal cher nye ba'am mthun par gyur 'dug pas dus 'dir yang dpyod ldan mang bo zhig ri bong cal 'drog gi brtul zhugs blangs te rang nyid kyi bsam blo la ras yug snum gyis zin pa ltar shan shugs zab mo zhig thebs bzhin pa mngon gsal yin pa yid la bzhag ste/ 'dir de'i lugs kyi skye ba phyi ma'am rnam — 108—
shes phyi mar nying mtshams mi sbyor ba'i sgrub byed du lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig tu 'dod pa'i lta bar cung zad dpyad par 'dod do/ /de la thog mar rdzas gcig ces pa de ga 'dra zhig yin pa gsal bor nges dgos pas de'i don mdo tsam brjod pa la/ de yang bse bsdus las/ rdzas gcig gi mtshan nyid yod de/ rdzas kyi sgo nas so so ba ma yin par skye ba'i chos de yin pa'i phyir/ mtshan gzhi ni yod de/ byas pa dang mi rtag pa gnyis de yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdzas gcig ces pa ni dngos po yin par gyur pa'i don gcig pa la bya ste/ tha dad pa'i dngos po de nyid dngos po dang don gcig gnyis pa'i gzhi mthun yin tshe/ de nyid rdzas gcig pa yang yin no/ / byas pa dang mi rtag gnyis kyang rdzas gcig yin te/ byas pa'i rdzas de nyid mi rtag pa'i rdzas su grub/ mi rtag pa'i rdzas de nyid kyang byas pa'i rdzas su grub pa'i phyir/ de gnyis dngos po yang yin la don gcig kyang yin te/ dngos po yin pa gang zhig don gcig kyang yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang bo sla/ gnyis pa ma grub na/ byas pa dang mi rtag pa gnyis chos can/ don gcig yin par thal/ phan tshun don gyi sgo nas so so ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byas pa mi rtag pa dang ngo bo gcig yin pa gang zhig mi rtag pa byas pa dang ngo bo gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtags re re nas grub ste/ de gnyis don gcig yin pa'i phyir/ des na rdzas gcig ces pa ni dngos po yin par gyur pa'i don gcig pa la ko dgos snyam/ des na tshad ma rig pa'i spyi don las/ rdzas kyi sgo nas so so ba ma yin par skye ba'i chos de rdzas gcig gi mtshan nyid/ de dang 'dus byas su gyur pa'i bdag nyid gcig pa gnyis don gcig ces gsungs pa'ang dngos po yin par gyur pa'i don gcig pa la dgongs par sems so/ / gzhan du na bum pa dang gser bum gnyis kyang rdzas gcig tu 'dod dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bum pa dngos po dang bdag nyid gcig yin pa'i phyir ro/ / khyab ste/ 'dus byas su gyur pa'i bdag nyid gcig pa la/ 'dus byas dang don gcig yin khyab mnyam yin mi dgos pa'i phyir/— 109 —
gnyis pa/ mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i lugs la lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig tu ji ltar 'dod tshul/gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs sogs sngon gyi grub mtha'i gzhung rnams las rgyang 'phen pa'i 'dod pa 'chad pa'i skabs ltar/ chos srid grub mtha' las kyang lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig pa yin te/blo ni lus la 'bras bu dang yin tan gyi tshul gyis brten pas so/ / lus grub na blo yang glo bur du skye la lus zhig na blo yang glo bur du 'jig ko / de'i phyir skye ba snga phyi yang med de/ sus kyang mig gis ma mthong ba'i phyir/ tshe snga ma nas 'dir 'ongs pa yang med la/ tshe 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba yang med do/ / lus nyid las blo skye ba 'thad par rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa lwa ba can dang rta mchog gnyis kyis smra/ zhes 'byung ba ltar rgyang 'phen pas lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig pa dang sems ni lus la khyad par gsum gyi sgo nas brten par 'dod de/ chang dang myos byed kyi nus pa bzhin lus kyi bdag nyid du gyur pa dang / mar me dang de'i 'od bzhin lus kyi 'bras bur gyur pa dang / rtsig pa dang de'i ri mo bzhin du lus kyi yin tan du gyur pa'i sgo nas brten pa'o/0 / des na mar me glo bur ba las 'od glo bur du grub pa bzhin/ lus glo bur ba las sems glo bur du grub pa yin pas/skye ba snga ma nas 'dir 'ongs pa med/ 'dir skye ba nas phyi mar 'gro ba yang med par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'chi ba'i tshe lus ni 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang dbang bo ni nam mkha'i bag la zha bar gyur te 'jig la/ lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig pas rtsig pa 'jig na ri mo yang 'jig pa bzhin/ lus 'jig na blo yang 'jig par 'gyur bas tshe 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba yang med do zhes skye ba snga phyi med par 'dod pa dang / de ltar 'dod pa la rgyu mtshan nges can zhig 'god rgyu yod dam zhe na/ yod par mi bsams te/ grub mtha' 'di'i srol 'byed mkhan drang srong 'jig rten drag nas rang nyid — 110 —
'dod pas gdung ba sel ched byung rgyal du smras pa yin pa'i phyir/ des rang gi sring mo la 'dod pa longs su spyod 'dod nas lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig pa dang skye ba snga phyi med par ston pa sogs kyi gzhung lugs 'bum phrag gcig brtsams pa dang / khos smras pa/ mdzes ma legs par spyod cing za bar gyis/ / lus mchog 'di gang de khyod la mi 'byung / / lus 'di 'tsho bar gyur pa tsam zhig ste/ /'jig ma song ba ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ / zhes dang / ma shi bar du bde bar 'tsho/ / shi nas de yi spyod yul med/ / lus kyang thal ba bzhin song nas/ / slar 'tsho bar lta ga la 'gyur/ / de phyir snga phyi yod ma yin/ / zhes bshad pa ltar lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig pas lus glo bur ba las sems glo bur du grub pa yin pas skye ba snga ma nas 'dir 'ongs pa med la/ lus 'jig na sems kyang 'jig par 'gyur bas tshe 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba yang med do zhes skye ba snga phyi med par 'dod cing / des na skye ba du mar lam goms par byed pa med pas thams cad mkhyen pa med pa dang /sdug bsngal sogs rgyu med pas de las grol byed kyi lam dang grol ba yang med par 'dod do/ / rgyang 'phen pas lus sems ga nyis rdzas gcig dang / skye ba snga phyi dang las 'bras dang thar ba sogs mi 'dod pas nang bstan pa phar zad/ gzhan sde mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' gzhan thams cad kyis kyang ches shin tu tha chad par brtsi ba yin no/ /gsum pa/ mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig tu 'dod tshul la nang bstan pas ji ltar dpyad tshul/ rgyang 'phen pas lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig tu 'dod tshul gong du gleng zin la/ 'dir re zhig de la nang ba'i grub mtha'i rjes 'brang gi 'dod pa ltar cung zad dpyad par bya ste/ lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig yin na/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig yin par thal bar 'gyur te/ rdzas gcig yin na ngo bo gcig yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzugs kyi bye brag lus dbang dang rnam — 111 —
shes gnyis ngo bo gcig yin par thal bar 'gyur te/ lus sems gnyis rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir/'dod na/ lus dbang dang rnam shes gnyis tha dad pa gang las tha dad pa gcig de log na tha dad zla cig shos de ldog par nges pa can du grub pa yin par 'gyur te/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ lus dbang log na rnam shes de yang nges par ldog dgos pa dang / rnam shes log na lus dbang de yang nges par ldog dgos pa gang rung yin par 'gyur te/ de gnyis tha dad pa gcig de log na tha dad zla cig shos de ldog par nges pa can du grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/lus dbang log na rnam shes de yang nges par ldog dgos pa dang / rnam shes log na lus dbang de yang nges par ldog dgos pa gang rung ma yin par thal/ lus dbang log na rnam shes de nges par ldog dgos pa ma yin pa gang zhig rnam shes log na lus dbang de nges par ldog dgos pa yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang bo ma grub na/ lus log na rnam shes de nges par ldog dgos pa ma yin te/ rnam shes des skye ba phyogs gcig dam pa dang phyi ma len pa'i phyir/ der thal/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos/ 'chi kha'i skad cig rnam shes ni/ / rang gi nyer blang skyed nus te/ji / zhes dang / slob dpon dpa' bos/ snga ma'i blo las phyi ma'i blo grub na/ / 'jig rten pha rol yod par de las mngon/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / lus log na rnam shes de yang nges par ldog dgos la/ des na/ gzugs med khams kyi sems can la'ang rnam shes med par 'gyur te/ lus med pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ rnam shes log na lus de nges par ldog dgos pa yang ma yin te/ shi ma thag pa'i bem po la lus yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de la lus yod pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i phyir/ ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal/ mthong ba'i phyir na med mi zer ba'i phyir/ des na blo ni lus la khyad par gsum gyi sgo nas brten par 'dod pa la'ang dpyad par bya ba 'di yod de/ sgron me la sgron 'od ltar 'bras bu'i tshul du brten na sgron 'od kyi 'phel 'grib sgron me'i rjes su byed pa dang 'dra bar blo'i 'phel 'grib lus kyi rjes su byed par khas len dgos pas mi 'thad pa dang / chang la myos — 112 —
byed kyi nus pa ltar bdag nyid kyi tshul du brten na myos byed kyi nus pa chang dang 'bral mi rung gi bdag nyid yin pa ltar/ sems lus dang 'bral mi rung gi bdag nyid du gyur cing / de lta na shi ba'i lus la'ang sems mi ldog par khas len dgos pas mi 'thad/ rtsig pa la ri mo ltar yon tan gyi tshul du brten na rtsig pa mthong ba na ri mo yang mthong ba de ltar du lus mthong na sems kyang mthong bar khas len dgos pas mi 'thad la/ de'i phyir blo lus la brten par mi 'thad de/ brten na brten tshul 'di gsum las mi 'da' zhing / gsum po gang ltar kyang mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ de bas skye ba snga phyi yang re zhig yod par snyam ste/ tshe snga ma nas 'dir 'ongs pa yod la/ tshe 'di nas phyi mar 'gro ba yang yod do/ / de shes byed kyi khungs ci yod ce na/ rjod byed gsung rab thams cad kyi gnad bsdus na brjod bya mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi thabs ston pa gnyis su 'dus shing /gal te skye ba snga phyi med na de gnyis kyi gzhi med pas don thob kyi dbang du byas na'ang rgyal ba'i gsung rab yod do cog tshe snga phyi yod pa'i rgyab rten gyi khungs su 'dzin chog pa yin no/ / byis pa skyes ma thag pa'i dbugs 'byin rngub sogs rang rang gi rigs 'dra sngon du song ba la ltos pa med par de dag lus 'ba' zhig las skye ba yin na/ mi mthun pa'i rgyu las skye bar 'gyur bas/ skye ba sogs ha cang thal ba du ma zhig khas len dgos par 'gyur ro/ / de'i phyir de dag rang rang gi rigs 'dra'i rgyu las skye bar 'os med kyis grub pas/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis tshe rabs snga ma yod par dpog nus te/ tshe 'dir skyes ma thag pa'i dbugs 'byin rngub sogs kyi rigs 'dra snga ma zhig yod na de tshe rabs snga ma'i gang zag gi rgyud la bzhag dgos pa'i gnad kyis so/ / rigs pa 'dis phyi rol pa la dngos su cung za da gnod par sems/ de yang slob dpon dpa' bos/ mngal na 'dug pa'i sngon rol blo de ni/ / de ma thag pa'i tshe rabs snga ma'i blo/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / yang nas kyi myu gu'i nyer len la nas kyi sa bon zhig nges par dgos pa ltar rnam shes kyi rgyun snga ma zhig kyang nges par yod dgos te/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos/ de phyir thog ma'i rnam shes ni/ / rang gi — 113 —
nyer len stobs las byung / / zhes gsungs pa ltararo/ / gzhan yang blo thams cad goms pa'i rjes su 'gro bar gsungs pa ltar/ skyes ma thag pa'i byis pas nu zho 'thung shes pa sogs tshe 'dir gsar du bslab mi dgos par rang gis shes pa'i rigs mtha' dag tshe rabs snga ma'i goms shugs su shes par bya bar gsungs te/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ blo yi mthu stobs gsal ba med pa dang / /dbang bo rnams kyang blun po'i rang bzhin can/ / btsas ma thag tu sus kyang ma bstan par/ / kha zas za bar rtsol ba byed pa dang / / nu zho 'thung bar rtsol ba byed pa yang / / de dag tshe rabs gzhan la goms pa'i mthu/ / zhes dang / slob dpon legs ldan gyis/ be'u yang sngon chad goms byas pas/ / byung ma thag tu zas 'tshol byed/ / zas kyi don du bskyod pa'i phyir/ / dper na dbang po smin pa bzhin/ / zhes gsungs pa las kyang shes nus so/ / mdor na bdag lta bu'i skye bo tha mal pa rnams la dad sogs dge ba'i bsam pa ni 'bad kyang mi skye/ chags sdang sogs mi dge ba'i bsam pa ni bkag kyang ma khegs par ngam ngam shugs kyis skye bzhin pa 'di las kyang tshe rabs snga ma rnams su chags sogs nyon mongs la goms shugs che ba dang cig shos la goms 'dris med pa gsal bar mtshon pa dang / gong gi sgrub byed de dag la brten nas tshe snga ma yod par dngos su grub cing / des na tshe phyi ma yod par yang don gyis grub pa ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na snga ma'i gang zag 'dir 'ongs pa yod na/ 'di'i gang zag phyi mar 'gro ba yang yod dgos te/ phyi mar mi 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan bshad du med pa'i gnad kyis so/ / ston pa shākya thub pa rang nyid kyis sngon slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su dag ma dag gi sku'i skye ba ji ltar bzhes pa dang / sngon gyi skyes chen du mas tshe rabs snga phyi gsal bar dran pa'i lo rgyus ji snyed cig mchis pa rnams dang / gang zag che ge mo shi nas lhar skyes so 'drer skyes so zhes pa la sogs pa'i gtam rgyud dge lugs pa'i grwa btsun gyi rtsed chas 66sa lam rnam gzhaganya dang de'i dge mtshan skor cung zad gleng pa/nga tsho bod kyi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa rnams la mjal skor du song tshe rgyun du mthong ba ni grwa mang rnams tshogs chen 'du khang du 'tshogs nas chos gsungs pa dang / grol chung dang chos mtshams kyi skabs su dpe khrid la phebs pa/ tshogs grol rjes chos grwar rtsod pa byed pa bcas yin la/ de las gzhan pa'i grwa btsun gyi 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs dang dgon sde'i rig gnas rnams la cha rgyus de 'dra med pas dge lugs pa'i dgon sde'i grwa btsun rnams la khom skabs su spro skyid gtong byed kyi rtsed chas shig yod par gtan nas mi 'dod cing / dge lugs pa'i grwa btsun khrod du'ang rtsed chas de'i ming yang thos ma myong zer mkhan cung mang / de bas 'dir mdo smad dhī ཿtsha dgon pa gzhir byas nas dge lugs pa'i grwa btsun rnams la'ang nang chos kyi gzhung dang mthun zhing / grwa btsun gyi 'tsho bar 'tsham pa/ kha ton dge sbyor la skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon pa'i rtsed chas thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par (sa lam rnam gzhag ces 'bod pa dang / gsham du de dang de'i dge mtshan skor cung zad gleng par 'dod/dang po/ 2 sa lam rnam gzhag sus mdzad tshul/spyi lo nyis sto/nga dgu lo'i dbyar khar nga rang bod kyi dgon sde'i dpal 'byor skor la zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa'i dbyin ji'i 'bum rams pa'i slob ma zhig dang mnyam du mtsho sngon dpa' — 111—
lung rdzong gi dgon sde 'gar song nas skad sgyur gyi bya ba bsgrubs khul byas/ thog mar bkra shis rtse dgon par song nas nyin gsum ring la grwa btsun 'gar dgon pa'i dpal 'byor skor gyi bcar 'dri byas①/ nyin gsum pa'i phyi dor skad sgyur byas tshar nas a khu bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho lags kyi grwa shag tu kha brda byed skabs/ a khu bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos grwa btsun rnams la 6sa lam rnam gzhaganya ces pa'i rtsed chas shig yod tshul dang / de ni grwa btsun gyi 'tsho bar shin tu 'tsham zhing rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan pa sogs gleng byung / skabs der nga tshos rtsed chas de la blta 'dod pa'i re ba bshad par a khus cang ma 'gor bar sa lam rnam gzhag ces pa'i rtsed chas shig khyer yong nas nged gnyis la mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus shig byas pa dang lhan du nga'i sems la de ni dngos gnas rtsed chas thun mong ma yin pa zhig red snyam ste rtsed gdan la 'dra par zhig blangs rjes phyir logde'i rjes grwa btsun re gnyis dang 'phrad dus kho tsho dang mnyam du (tsas lam rnam gzhag gi skor kha brda cung zad re byas pa dang / de'i mdzad pa po su yin dang de ji ltar rtse tshul sogs dris pa yin/ de'i rjes dpa' lung bkra shis rtse dgon pa'i a khu bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gnyis dang yang bskyar thug nas khong gnyis kyis nga la 64sa lam rnam gzhag gi 'dra par steng du re re bzhin bstan nas de ji ltar rtse dgos tshul gsal bo zhig bshad pa dang / de mdzad pa po su yin skor dris pa na a khu sangs rgyas rgya mtshos 66dgon pa'i grwa btsun rgan pa rnams kyi bshad rgyun ltar na lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje mchog ( gong ma chan lung gi bka' bzhin ) rgya nag tu phebs nas gong ma'i dbu blar bzhugs dus/ khong gi grwa btsun zhabs zhu ba rnams sun snang skyes te nyi ma ma 'khyol par dmigs nas khong gis 9sa lam rnam gzhag gi rtsed chas 'di gsar bzo mdzad pa red zer/nas lam rnam gzhag 'di brtse tshe gcig tu na khom skabs su nyi ma 'khyol pa dang / ga nyis su na lus sems kyi khams la snyoms sgrig byas te kha ton dge sbyor gyi grogs byed pa yin pas 'di nyid — 118 —
rtsed chas khyad par can zhig yin zer/ dhī ཿtsha dkon par sngon chad ri khrod pa rnams kyis lo gsar tshes gcig nyin tshogs grol te shag tu phebs rjes bzang kha mthun phyogs rnams mnyam gcig tu 'tshogs nas rten 'brel gyis rgyas lam rnam gzhag rtse ba yin zhes rgan pa rnams kyi zhal las thos ②zhes bshad pa dang / de'i rjes ngas lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje mchog gi rnam thar du de'i skor cung zad yod snyam nas zhib tu btsal kyang rnyed ma byung / spyi lo nyis stong bcu lo'i zla gsum par ( sa lam rnam gzhag gi mdzad pa po lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje mchog yin min shes 'dod de dhī ཿtsha dgon pa'i dge rgan chen mo lung rigs lags la de'i skor dris pa la/ khong gis nus lam rnam gzhag gi rtsed chas kyi mdzad pa po ni lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje mchog yin zhes pa'i bshad rgyun zhig yod pa de bden tshod 'dug nga tsho'i dgon pa'i nang du dgon lung nas yong ba'i grwa ba zhig yod pa des shog bu'i ngos su dmyal khams bco brgyad dang sa lam gyi rim pa gsal por bkod yod pa'i ri mo zhig dgon lung dgon pa nas khyer yong ba de'i bzo bkod ni ((sa lam rnam gzhag rgyu dang 'dra zhing /der bltas na rtsed chas 88sa lam rnam gzhag : de lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje mchog gis mdzad pa red zer pa ni bden pa'i gtam zhig red snyam/ha ①zhes gsungs/ gong gi bcar 'dri dang rtsad gcod byas pa de rnams las nga tshos khus lam rnam gzhag sus mdzad tshul shes thub la/ gzhan pa'i bshad rgyun dang khungs 'dra yod na 'dir kha gsab gnang rogs/gnyis pa/ 2 sa lam rnam gzhag gi rtsed gdan dang rtsed rje'udu/46sa lam rnam gzhag ces pa'i rtsed chas la rtsed gdan ( ras kyis bzos pa ) dang rtsed rde'u gnyis ma gtogs med la/ rtsed gdan gyi ngos su sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum gyi dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams dang / lho 'dzam bu gling sogs gling bzhi dang / rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum/ bsam gtan dang po nas srid rtse/ nyan thos tshogs lam nas rdzogs rim/ sa bcu nas — 119 —
chos kyi dbyings bcas bsdoms pas rim pa dgu bcu yod pa re re bzhin ri mo zlum po re'i dbus su yang zlum gzugs re bris nas de'i nang du ming re re bzhin bkod de mtshon yod pa dang / zlum gzugs che ba dang chung ba'i bar stong de khrag drug tu bkos nas de'i re re'i nang du ma ṇi yig drug re re bzhin so sor bkod yod par ma zad/ rang sa dang gong 'og gi sa lam gyi rim pa/ gling bzhi dang de'i gong 'og gi rim pa/ dmyal khams rnams bkod yod la/ rtsed rde'u'i ngos drug por ma ṇi yig drug re re bzhin bris yod/ gsham gyi ri mo las nga tshos rtsed gdan gsal por mthong thub/āts+tsha/snyi/ /] // ||smo] / tram̐/ / ra(lha/ ༵༵/ ( rtsed gdan ngos kyi ri mo rnams tshon mdangs dang ldan pa'ang yod de/ dhī ཿ tsha dgon pa'i a khu rgyal mtshan gyis rtsed gdan gyi ri mo rnams gor gor yin la tshon mdangs sna tshogs yod de/dmyal ba sogs tshon mdangs dmar ser dang nag pos bris yod pa dang / sa dang po sogs tshon dkar po dang dmar po/ ser po bcas kyis bris yod par ma zad/ rtsed gdan gyi gru kha bzhi bor stag seng khyung 'brug bzhi bo bris yod pa'ang yod/ ji ①ces gsungs pa dang / da dung rtsed gdan gyi gong du rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dang 'od dpag med sogs kyi khang bzang legs par bris yod pa'i rtsed chas bzo bkod legs po can yang yod ces bkra shis rtse dgon pa'i a khu sangs rgyas rgya mtsho lags kyis gsungs pa dang / rtsed gdan ngos kyi ri mo gru bzhi can yang yod ces a khu bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho lags kyis gsungs/bu de las nga tshos sa lam rnam gzhag la ri mo dang bzo bkod mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa'ang shes thub/— 120 —
tsa sa lam rnam gzhag gi rtsed chas ni sngon chad nas da lta'i bar dgon pa'i nang gi lag bde can dang ri mo dang yig gzugs la dga' ba'i grwa btsun rnams kyis las bzhin yod pa las tshong khang sogs su btsong rgyu med pa dang / rang nyid la (8sa lam rnam gzhag cig dgos tshe de bzo byed kyi rgyu cha'i ras nyos te rtsed rde'u las byed kyi shing dang bcas ri mo bri bar byang cha che ba'i grwa btsun rnams la las su 'jug pa red/ sngon chad dang bsdur na dgon pa'i nang gi rtsed chas 'di nyid je nyung du song yod pa dang / rtsed mkhan yang sngon chad ltar mang po mi 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan ni da lta dgon par lag khyer kha par dang glog klad la sogs pa'i deng rabs kyi 'phrul chas je mang du song ba'i rkyen yin snyam/gsum pa/ rgya sa lam rnam gzhag ji ltar rtse tshul/66sa lam rnam gzhag ni phal cher dge lugs pa'i grwa btsun ma gtogs grub mtha' gzhan pa'i grwa btsun rnams mi rtse ba dang / dge lugs pa'i dgon pa las kyang mtshan nyid 'chad mnyan byed pa'i dgon pa ma gtogs sgrub dgon rnams su mi rtse ba dang rtses kyang de 'dra rgyugs mi che ba red/ nang bstan chos lugs ltar na nga tsho lho 'dzam bu gling du 'tsho bzhin yod pa'i rkyen gyis rtse ba'i skabs su thog mar lho 'dzam bu gling nas mgo bzung ste rtse dgos pa dang / rtsed rde'u lho 'dzam bu gling gi steng du 'phangs nas ma ṇi yig drug las gang 'khel la lta bar byed pa dang / oṃ la 'khel tshe bde ba can dang / ma ni rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ ṇi ni lha ma yin/ pad ni dud 'gro/ me smru yi dwags/ r+yaṃ ni dmyal ba bsdus 'joms la 'khel yod pas thengs rjes mar gnas gang du 'khel pa de'i steng du rtsed rde'u 'phangs nas gang 'khel la blta dgos/ rim bzhin yar 'phar nas sa dang por slebs rjes gang la 'khel na'ang mar 'grib rgyu med de/ oṃ la 'khel na sa gnyis par 'phar dgos la/ gzhan lnga bor 'khel na rang sa ste sa dang po'i steng du sdod dgos/ yin yang rim — 121 —
bzhin mar 'grib nas dmyal ba rdo rje gdan sogs su lhung tshe gtan nas yar 'phar mi thub pa zhig ma yin te/ gong gi (nus lam rnam gzhag gi rtsed gdan ltar na/ dmyal ba rdo rje gdan thog tu rtsed rde'u 'phangs nas oṃ la 'khel na tsha dmyal brgyad kyi nang gses rab tu tsha ba dang / de nas yang oṃ la 'khel na yi dwags dang ma la 'khel na dud 'gror 'phar thub pa dang / dud 'gro'i steng du thengs rjes mar yang oṃ la 'khel na rgya nag yul du 'phar thub/ de ltar rim bzhin yar 'phar nas chos kyi dbyings la slebs srid/ ces lam rnam gzhag nya ni grwa btsun gnyis nas bdun brgyad lhan du rtse chog pa dang / de las kyang mang ba mnyam du rtse yang chog rtses nas sa bcu sogs rim bzhin yar 'phar nas chos kyi dbyings su slebs pa rnams rgyal bar gyur pa dang / dmyal ba sogs su lhung nas yar 'phar ma thub pa rnams gnas skabs su pham par gyur pa yin pas de ni nang bstan chos lugs pa'i rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed pa'i rtsed mo zhig yin/ rtse dus g.yas bskor byed pa dang / grwa ba rnams res mos kyis rtses nas rang nyid slebs pa'i gnas der dngos po re bzhag nas rtags gsal bor 'god pa dang / rgyun par rde'u dkar po legs par brtsi/ rtse ba'i skabs su yar 'phar ma thub tshe rang 'gul sgos ma ṇi brgya phrag gcig gnyis nas stong gcig gnyis 'don par khas len pa dang /rtsed rde'u 'phen skabs su mgo bo cung zad sgur zhing mig gnyis btsums nas ma ṇi 'don pa dang /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs bzhin lag pas rtsed rde'u thod pa'i mgor thengs 'gar sprugs nas rtsed gdan steng du 'phen par byed la/ rtse bzhin pa'i skabs su yar 'phar ma thub tshe grwa btsun gzhan rnams kyis 22khyod kyis ma ṇi 'don rgyu khas ma blangs na yar 'phar thub rgyu ma red/ ma ṇi 'don rgyu khas longs/ pa zhes skul ba byas nas ma ṇi 'don rgyu khas len du 'jug pa red/ 64sa lam rnam gzhag rtses nas thog mar mi gcig rgyal bar gyur tshe ngal bso zhing gzhan rnams mu mthud du rtse bar byed pa dang / ches mtho shos ni chos kyi dbyings dang de'i — 121—
nang du yang rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad/ 'od dpag med/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i zhing khams bcas drug yod/0 zhing khams de rnams la slebs tshe rang nyid kyi rde'u dkar po de rnams kyi steng du bzhag nas ngal bso ba'am yang na rtsed mo'i mjug rdzogs par byed/ gal te grwa btsun gcig rjes su lus tshe da dung rtsed mtshams mi 'jog par kho rang gcig pu yang yang du rtses nas chos kyi dbyings la slebs rag bar du rtse bar byed/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni dmyal bar lhung nas rtse mtshams bzhag tshe rten 'brel mi legs par 'dod/ yin yang skabs 'gar rtsed mo'i skabs su rjes su lus pa'am pham par gyur pa'i grwa btsun de la gzhan rnams kyis rtse rogs byed pa'ang yod la/ rtsed grogs gcig kyang med pa'i skabs su grwa ba gcig kyang rtse chog ga khu rgyal mtshan lags kyis 6zla ཿtsha dgon par mtshon na sngon chad lo sar gyi tshes nyer dgu dang yang na nam gang gi phyi dror zhwa dmar nang chen nas cong brda brgyab ste nyin gsum ring la sgrig lam btang rjes (sa lam rnam gzhag rtses nas spro skyid la rol pa las gzhan pa'i dus skabs su gtan nas mi rtse ste/ de rtse tshe dus tshod nges can zhig dgos pas dpe cha pa rnams la gnod pa 'byung bar dogs pa red/rta ①ces gsungs/bzhi ba/ 66sa lam rnam gzhag gi dge mtshan/2 sa lam rnam gzhag ni dge lugs pa'i grwa btsun gyi rtsed chas khyad par can zhig yin la/dgon sde'i mtshan nyid grwa tshang rnams su grwa ba rnams kyis gzhung pod lngar 'bad pas sbyong bzhin yod pas khom skabs kyi dus cung nyung ba dang / grwa btsun gyi 'tsho ba'i nang du rtsed 'jo'i byed sgo'i rigs ha cang nyung bas rtsed chas 'dis dgon sde'i bar gseng gi 'tsho bar spro snang sbyin par byed pa yin te/ lo gsar gyi nyin gsum po'i ring la grwa btsun grogs po rnams mnyam du 'tshogs — 123 —
nas khus lam rnam gzhag rtses te spro skyed ngang dus 'da' bar byed pa dang / da lta dgon pa so so'i sgrig lam sngon chad dang mi 'dra bas chos mtshams sogs kyi skabs su sa lam rnam gzhag rtse ba'ang yod/ rtse ba'i skabs su sho lta bu'i 'du shes mi 'dzin par dge sems dang bcas rtse dgos zer pa dang / rtse ba'i skabs su yar 'phar ma thub pa byung tshe ma ṇi 'don pa'am 'don rgyu khas len par byed pas 28sa lam rnam gzhag ni rnam pa'i thad nas rtsed chas shig yin yang des grwa btsun gyi kha ton dge sbyor la skul 'ded kyi nus pa khyad par can zhig thon yod/de las gzhan da dung 46sa lam rnam gzhag gi rtsed chas la dge mtshan zhig yod pa ni rtsed mo'i skabs su nang don rig pa'i tha snyad skor zhig dang sa lam gyi spyi khog tsam yang blo la nges 'gro ba yin te/ gzhung pod lnga la slob gnyer mi byed pa'i grwa btsun zhig la mtshon na yang / 64sa lam rnam gzhag rtses pa la brten nas tsha dmyal brgyad dang grang dmyal brgyad/ nyi tshe ba dang nye 'khor ba bcas dmyal khams bco brgyad po'i ming rnams dang / de bzhin du bsam gtan bzhi sogs gzugs khams dang / nam mkha' mtha' yas dang rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci yang med dang srid rtse sogs gzugs med khams kyi tha snyad rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang du bgrod par byed pa'i nyan thos dang rang rgyal/ theg chen bcas theg pa gsum gyi lam rnams dang sa dang bo rab tu dga' ba dang sa bcu ba chos kyi sprin sogs sa bcu bo rnams kyi go rim spyi bam pa zhig blor nges 'gro/de ltar 66sa lam rnam gzhagag gi rtsed chas steng du nang rig gzhung gi sa lam gyi rim pa'i spyi khog tsam bstan yod pas dpe cha pa zhig la mtshon na gzhung pod lnga'i slob gnyer la phan thogs nges can zhig yod/rtsed chas (6sa lam rnam gzhag nya la dge mtshan du ma yod pa mdor dril na/ des grwa btsun rnams spro skyid kyi rtsed 'jo la rol tu bcug ste kho tsho'i bshad sgrub las kyi bar gseng gi 'tsho ba phun sum je tshogs su btang ba dang gcig rtsed mo'i khrod du pham par gyur pa rnams kyis ma ṇi 'don — 124—

④ spyi lo nyis stong bcu lo'i zla dang po'i tshes bcu dgu nyin kha par gyi lam nas bcar 'dri byas pa 'dir bkod pa yin/① cas lam rnam gzhaganya gi rtsed chas kyi grub cha gnyis po la bye brag gi ming med pas 'dir re zhig ras las grub pa la rtsed gdan dang shing las grub pa'i rtsed chas la rtsed rde'u zhes ming btags pa yin/④ spyi lo nyis stong dgu lo'i zla bcu gnyis kyi tshes gnyis nyin gyi dgung mor zi ling du dus tshod gcig lhag la bcar 'dri byas te sgrar phab pa yin/① gong gi mchan gangadudang 'dra/① sa lam rnam gzhag gzhan pa'i steng du de rnams khang bzang dang bcas pa rtsed gdan gyi gong du legs par bris yod pa'ang yod zer/① gong gi mchan angabu'adra/— 126—
dzo mo dam chos pad mas brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas lha sar gnas mjal du phebs tshul skor gleng pa/bdag gis mtsho sngon 'ba' gzhung gi jo mo dam chos pad ma zhes pas ( spyi lo 2005—2006 ) spyi le stong tsho nyis tsam la brkyangs phyag 'tshal te mtsho sngon brag dkar rdzong nas lha sar phebs tshul thos pas ha las shing / kho mo dang mnyam du de'i skor gyi gnas tshul lab gleng byed pa'i go skabs shig ldan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam tshul zhig kyang skyes byung / kho mor spobs pa dang sdug rus de lta bu ldan pa ni ngo ma bsam yul las 'das pa zhig red/ des bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi rjes 'jug pa zhig gi 'gyur ba med pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po de gsal bor mtshon thub/ kho bos jo mo dam chos pad mar dad pa dang spobs pa/ snying stobs de lta bu zhig ji ltar skyes pa gsal bor shes ched spyi lo 2009 lo'i spyi zla dgu pa'i tshes sum cu nyin mtsho lho 'ba' gzhung gi rka mo che sde ba zhol ma'i nye 'dabs su chags yod pa'i gsang sngags bde chen mkha' 'gro gling la rtog dpyod du song nas kho mor dus tshod bzhi tsam la bcar 'dri byas te kho mo'i khyim tshang gi gnas tshul dang ji ltar rab tu byung tshul/ brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas lha sar phebs rgyu'i sems thag ji ltar bcad tshul dang lam bar gyi brgyud rim dang dka' tshegs/ brkyangs phyag bde blag ngang mjug rdzogs rjes kyi gnas tshul bcas la rgyus lon gsal bo zhig byas shing / de bod kyi nang bstan rig gnas las mjal pa dang gnas mjal skor gyi zhib 'jug la cung zad phan nges yin snyam ste sgrar phab pa'i rgyu cha las gtso bo rnams yig thog tu bkod de 'dir klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/ — 127 —
dang po/ rjo mo dam chos pad ma nar son pa'i brgyud rim/jo mo dam chos pad ma ni spyi lo 1978 lo'i zla bzhi par mtsho sngon 'ba' rdzong 'ba' lung ba zhang gi tshar nag sde ba gong mar skyes shing / kho mor a ce gnyis dang nu bo gcig yod/ a ce che bas pha yul du zhing las gnyer bzhin yod pa dang / a ce chung ba dang nu bo gnyis slob grwa chen mo nas rim bzhin mthar phyin te bya ba gnyer bzhin 'dug jo mo dam chos pad ma lo gnyis la son pa'i lo der kho mo'i pha rgan la nad cig byung ste tshe las 'das pas a ma'i gces skyong gcig pu la brten nas kho mo rim bzhin nar son/ kho mo lo bdun gyi skabs su sde ba'i slob chung du zhugs nas lo ngo gnyis ring la slob sbyong byas pa dang / de nas kha sgang sde ba'i slob chung du lo gnyis la slob gnyer byas/ bu spyi lo 1989 lo'i ston kur a ma dang a zhang gnyis kyis kho mo mtsho lho gung ho rdzong mi rigs slob chung du bskyal nas yang bskyar lo rim bzhi ba'i 'dzin grwar zhugs te lo ngo gcig ring la slob sbyong byas/dbyar gnang gi skabs su pha yul du yong rjes/ kho mos slob grwar mi 'gro zhes a ma la bshad pa na a ma dang ga/nyen nye rnams kyis slob grwar 'gro dgos tshul gyi slob gso gang mang btang /skabs der slob grur mi 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na kho mos bshad rgyur/ 99skabs der a ce dang nu bo gnyis slob grwar 'gro bzhin yod pa dang khyim du a ma dang a ce gnyis ma gtogs las ka las mkhan med pas kho mo gnyis la las rogs byed bsams pa dang / slob grwar song tshe slob yon yang sprad dgos pas a ma gcig pu la mtshon na byis pa gsum slob grwar bskyal rgyu ha cang dka' bsams nas slob grwar mi 'gro zhes bshad pa yin/〉〉 buzhes zer/ a ma dang gnyen nye rnams kyis slob grwar 'gro dgos tshul dang slob yin gyi thad nas dka' khag chen po med tshul bshad pas 'ba' rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring du rgyugs sprad pa dang / de'i skor gyi gnas tshul dris pa na kho mos 99skabs der ngas lo rim bzhi ba'i slob deb ma gtogs sbyangs med pas skar ma gsum gyis chad de slob — 128—
'bring du rgyugs ma 'phrod pas nga rang slob grwar 'gro ma thub/ skabs der nga rang lo bcu gnyis red/〉 ① ces bshad/ de'i rjes kho mos pha yul du lo ngo gsum ring la zhing las gnyer nas a ma dang a ce gnyis la rogs ram gang mang byas/spyi lo1993lor kho mo lo bco lngar bud rjes a zhang dang mnyam du zhing chen gzhan par song nas zhabs bro 'khrab ste zla 'ga' 'gor/ skabs der kho mo'i sems la a zhang dang mnyam du bro 'khyab tu song tshe rang lus skyed kyang sgor mo nyung nyung zhig ma gtogs btsal mi thub pas bro 'khrab mtshams 'jog dgos snyam nas a zhang la'ang ma bshad par phyir pha yul du log 46gal te a zhang la de ltar bshad na slob grwar yang mi 'gro/ skyed sa nas kyang mi 'dug ces sdigs mo byed nges red snyam byung /11 ① pha yul du yang bskyar lo ngo gnyis lhag la a ma dang a ce gnyis dang mnyam du zhing las gnyer/ spyi lo 1996 lor kho mos mtsho sngon zi ling gi bod mi'i khrom gyi za khang zhig tu zhabs zhu ba'i las gnyer nas phal cher zla ba brgyad tsam 'gor/ skabs der kho mo lo bco brgyad red/ zla rer zla phogs sgor 200 yod pa a mar bskur ci thub byas/ kho mos za khang du las ka gnyer skabs rab tu byung 'dod kyi blo skyes byung / de'i rgyu mtshan dris pa na kho mos ((za khang dang bod mi'i khrom du rgyun par mi sna tshogs yong ba dang / kho tshos dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal myong bzhin yod la/ las ka gnyer nas sgor mo 'tshol mkhan rnams kyis kyang dka' sdug mang bo myong bzhin yod pa mthong ba dang / sgor mo zer pa btsal dka' zhing 'dzad sla bas 'di ltar sgor mo 'tshol ba las rab tu byung ste chos shig bsgrubs na legs snyam nas bsam tshul de a zhang la bshad pa na/ a zhang gis jo mo zhig byed thub na shin tu bzang yang rab tu byung rgyu ni las sla mo zhig min/ der ma zad mtsho lho khul du jo mo'i dkon pa zhig kyang med ces bshad pas/ nga'i sems la rang nyid da dung lo na chung bas rang gi bsam tshul las rgan pa rnams kyi kha ta bden nges yin snyam byung /11 ① de nas lo gsar la nye dus pha yul du log a ma dang a zhang gnyis kyis kho mo rab tu byung bar dogs nas lo gsar gyi — 129—
rjes su phyir zi ling du 'gro ru ma bcug spyi lo1999lor kho mo lo nyer gcig la bud rjes a ma dang a zhang gnyis kyis gnyen nye'i 'brel ba cung zad yod pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu gnas la byin/ skabs der kho mo gnas la 'gro ma 'dod pa dang gnas la ma song na a zhang dang a ma gnyis kyi kha tshig ma rtsis pas mi 'grig ces the tshom gyi dra rgyar tshud bzhin bsdad/ de ltar kho mo gnas la 'gro rgyur 'thad pa ma byung bar rang khyim du bsdad nas lo gnyis tsam 'gor zhing / mjug mthar khyim las bros te rab tu byung ba red/gnyis pa/ ji ltar rab tu byung tshul/kho mo gnas la ma song bar rang khyim du lo ngo gnyis tsam bsdad pa'i mthar spyi lo2001lo'i ston khar gro shog rnams g.yul khar bsdus rjes rab tu byung rgyu'i sems thag brtan po bcad pa dang /rab tu byung ba'i gegs su 'gyur bar dogs nas kho mo'i khyim mi dang blos thub kyi grogs mo rnams la de'i skor gyi tshig gcig kyang ma bshad/ skabs der kho mos nyin rgyun ma ṇi dang sgrol ma sogs kha ton byas nas rab tu byung bar bgegs dang bar chad ci yang med par gsol ba dang smon lam yang yang btab/ der ma zad rang nyid la kha ton gyi 'gan bzhag lo de'i hor zla bdun pa'i tshes drug nyin kho mo tshang gi gro shog rnams g.yul khar bskyal te brtsigs zin pa dang / nyin der kho mo'i kha ton rnams kyang bton tshar/ dgong mo der a ce 'bring ba la sang nyine snga mor kho mo gnyid las bslang dgos tshul dang / snga mo nas snye ma 'thu ru 'gro dgos zhes bshad/ nyin 'ga'i sngon du a ma'i 'a/ga tu kho mor sgor mo 30 yod pa phyir blangs pa dang / khyim gyi sgam chung nang du btsal pas sgor200bzhag yod pa las 160 khyer/tshes bdun gyi snga mor nam ma langs gong snye ma 'thu bar kha g.yar nas kho mo gsang stabs kyis bros te sde ba'i nub phyogs kyi rma chu'i zam khar song nas rlangs 'khor zhig la bsdad de brag dkar — 130—
rdzong du song / rdzong thog tu thon pa na dus tshod dgu yas mas la slebs 'dug kho mos thog mar bod kyi tshong khang zhig btsal nas gzan sham kha tshang zhig nyo rgyu yin zhes bshad nas rin gong thag bcad pa dang / de nas skra bzhar khang zhig tu song / skra bzhar mkhan rgya mos kho mor gnas tshul zhib tu dris shing / 'di 'dra'i skra ring bo zhig bzhar na ci 'dra'i yid phangs pa la zer nas ma bzhar bar dus tshod phyed tsam 'gor/ der ma zad skra ba zhar mkhan tshos bza' zla dang ma mthun par bros yong ba zhig yin na kho mor las ka zhig btsal chog ces kha ta byas/ dam chos pad mas rab tu byung 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang / rjes phyogs su kho mo'i ched du gzhan gyis btsal nas mi 'ongs pa dang gal te yong na kho mos 'gan yod tshad khur nges yin zhes yang yang bshad mthar skra bzhar thub pa byung / skra gzhar dus kho mo'i sems khams ga 'dra zhig yin tshul dris pa na/((skra gzhar dus ngas me long nang du lta bzhin bsdad mod 'on kyang skabs der nga'i sems la ci yang dran rgyu med pa dang / yud tsam nas skra thang la lhung ba'i sgra chung ngu zhig grag pa dang mnyam du ngas phar bltas pa na skra bzhar rgya mo'i mig nang du mig chu gang 'khor 'dug skabs der mi zhig skra bzhar khang du yong yang skra bzhar rgya mos nang la yong du ma bcug pa red/11 ① de nas dam chos pad mas mgo la lag phyis shig dkris te tshong khang nang du gzan sham nyo bar song ba na/ tshong bdag mas ha las pa'i ngang nas kho mor khyim gyi bza' zla dang ma mthun par bros yong min sogs dris par ma zad/ gal te de 'dra zhig yin na khyim du bskyal chog ces dang skra bzhar yang skye rgyu yod pas skyon mi 'dug ces kha ta gang mang byas/ dam chos pad mas de 'dra zhig min tshul yang yang bshad de sgor mo 140 grad nas gzan sham kha tshang zhig nyos te tshong khang de'i nang du lus la gyon/skabs der kho mos sems khral byed pa ni rab byung gi sdom pa len rag bar du khyim mi rnams thon nas phyir 'khrid 'gro bar skrag pa de red/de nas rlangs 'khor zhig la bsdad de chab cha grong brdal du song nas ho rdog dponadugang du — 131 —
bzhugs yod tshul dris nas song / skabs der ho rdog dpon mtshams la bzhugs 'dug pa dang /thog mar khyim zhig tu gnas tshang g.yar nas bsdad pa dang / de'i phyi nyin grwa ba zhig gis dam chos pad ma khrid de ho rdog dpon la mjal du bcug nyin der tshogasanga'adon pa dang 'phrad pas rten 'brel legs zhes gsungs nas ho rdog dpon gyis kho mo mtshams 'og la chud du bcug skabs der kho mos chos kyi 'don cha rnams mi shes pa dang / yun ring bor tsog pur bsdad pas rkang pa'ang na byung / de'i phyi nyin ho rdog dpon gyi mdun sar dam chos pad ma la sngon 'gro'i lung thob/nyin gsum par a zhang gis kho mo btsal nas thon byung / a zhang mthong ma thag dam chos pad ma cung zad skrag nas kha rog ger bsdad/ a zhang gis 'dang cung zad brgyab nas yud tsam 'gor rjes 99khyod rang 'di ltar bros yong nas jo mo byas te ci zhig bya/11 zhes bshad/ dam chos pad ma dkod bzhin lan ci yang ma btab/ nyin de'i phyi dror a zhang dang mnyam du phyir chab char song /chab char nyin bcu gcig la bsdad rjes a lags yongs 'dzin lags kyi dbang lung gnang bzhin par song nas dbang la mnyan/ dbang thog tu rab byung bsgrubs pa'i go skabs ma byung / dbang grol rjes jo mo gnyis dang mnyam du mtsho sngon dpa' lung du song nas rdzogs chen gyi sprul sku pad ma skal bzang lags kyi mdun sar rab tu byung ba dang / de nas jo mo de gnyis dang mnyam du khri la'i jo khang du song nas nyin bcu lhag la bsdad/ de nas dam chos pad mas khri ku'i rong gzhis dgon par grwa shag gcig g.yar nas sngon 'gro phudapya/ skabs der a ce dang phu bo gnyis kho mor blta ru yong ba dang pha yul du a mar blta ru 'gro zhes bshad/ de nas kho mo pha yul du song nas nyin bcu la bsdad rjes phyir rong gzhis dgon par log nas sngon 'gro phud/ sngon 'gro phud par lo gcig 'gor/ de nas jo mo dam chos pad ma'i sems la brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas lha sar phebs rgyu'i bsam tshul skyes pa dang / gsham du kho mos sems thag bcad nas gros ji ltar byas tshul brjod par bya /— 132 —
gsum pa/ brkyangasaphyag 'tshalanas lha sar phebasargyu'i sems thag bcadadegrosazasatshul/de'i rjes khri lnga'i jo khang du bla brang a khu blo bzang rgya mtsho'i bka' chos la mnyan pa dang /der yod pa'i grwa ba dang jo mo cung mang zhing phal che ba rig gnas phyogs la mthong rgya cung che/ dam chos pad mar slob chung gi lo rim bzhi ba'i chu tshad ma gtogs med pa dang sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan gzhan rnams dang bsdur thabs bral/ skabs der kho mo'i sems su rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa legs po zhig byed ma thub pa dang bka' chos dang dpe khrid kyi don spyi bam pa tsam las ma rtogs pas de'i tshab tu phyag 'tshal na sgrib pa sbyang thub snyam nas brkyangs phyag 'tshal te lha sar 'gro rgyu yid la 'char/ de'i rjes hor rgya'i grwa tshang du zla ba gsum tsam la mtshams la bsdud de nyin rer phyag stong gnyis nas gsum tsam 'tshal/ skabs der dam chos pad ma'i sems la jo mo 'ag sa phyag 'tshal nas lha sar mjal du song tshe lam bar du dka' tshegs myang nges pas 'gro rogs grwa ba dge slong zhig yod na legs snyam byung / thengs shig la khri ku'i bis kya dgon pa'i grwa btsun dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang mnyam du za khang zhig tu za ma za skabs kho mos phyag 'tshal nas lha sar mjal 'dod kyi bsam tshul gleng zhing grwa btsun dkon mchog rgya mtsho la kho mo dang mnyam du phyag 'tshal thub min dris/ a khus bsam blo zhig btang rjes kho mor lan zhig ster zhes bshad/ nyin 'ga' 'gor yang a khus kho mor 'brel gtugs ma byas pas lha sar phyag 'tshal nas 'gro ma thub snyam/1de'i rjes mang rdzong chu mgo gzhung du jo mo de gnyis dang mnyam du lo gcig ring rje btsun ma'i mtshams la bsdad/ mtshams grol rjes kho tsho brag dkar sprel rdzong dgon par mjal skor du phyin/dgon pa'i phyi skor du brkyangs phyag 'tshal dus 'ba' rdzong shing khri dgon pa'i dge slong chos grags ngo shes pa dang /cung zad 'dris par gyur rjes a khu chos grags dang mnyam du brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas lha sar gnas mjal du 'gro ba'i skor la gros byas/ a khus brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas lha sar — 133—
mjal rgyu ni las sla mo zhig ma yin pas thog mar bla ma zhig la lung bstan zhig zhu zhes bshad/ de nas nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes kho tshos bla ma zhig la lung bstan zhus pa na/ rim gro ci yang mi 'dug yin yang khyim mi 'thad mi 'thad cig 'dug gal te khyim mi 'thad pa byung na lam du bgegs bar chad ci yang med par bde blag ngang phyag 'tshal nas lha sar slebs thub ces gsungs/de nas kho tshos gros byas te dus chad cig bgos nas shing khri dgon pa nas mgo brtsams te brkyangs phyag 'tshal mgo brtsam rgyu'i gros thag bcad de phyir pha yul du log dam chos pad ma'i grogs mo jo mo lung rigs sgrol mas kyang kho gnyis dang mnyam du brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas lha sar 'gro rgyu'i sems thag bcad/ de nas jo mo gnyis kyis khyim mi rnams la gsang ste shing khri dgon par song nas phyag 'tshal nas zla ba gcig tsam 'dug rgyu yin zhes bshad nas khyim nas phyag stan dang phyag mthil sogs khyer nas shing khri dgon par song / der kho gnyis kyis dge slong chos grags la bsgugs nas phal cher zla ba gcig 'gor yang dgon pas a khu chos grags la gnang ba ma byin pas phyag 'tshal ma thub/de nas jo mo dam chos pad ma dang lung rigs sgrol ma gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal rgyur gros byas pa dang / dam chos pad mas kho mo gnyis kyis lha sar phyag 'tshal nas mjal skor du song yang dka' khag chen po mi 'dug lam bar du phyag 'tshal mkhan gzhan dang 'phrad srid ces bshad pa dang /lung rigs sgrol mas lam bar du phyag 'tshal mkhan gzhan dang 'phrad mi srid pa dang / sa stong lung stong du phyag 'tshal nas 'gro dgos pas cung zad skrag zer/ gros byas mthar yul mi rnams 'thad pa byung na phyag 'tshal mgo brtsam rgyur gros 'cham byung / yul mi rnams la de'i skor bshad pas 'thad pa ma byung / khyim mi rnams kyis de ni zla thog zla dang lo thog lo bzhag nas 'tshal dgos par ma zad/ sa stong lung stong brgyud nas 'gro dgos pas ha cang dka' tshegs che ba dang / brag dkar sprel rdzong dgon du phyag skor zhig 'tshal na'ang dka' tshegs che ba shes zin pa ltar red ces —— 134—
bshad/ jo mo dam chos pad ma khong khro langs nas kha sgang du mtshams la sdod du 'gro rgyu yin zhes bshad nas lung rigs sgrol ma dang mnyam du zla ba gcig ring mtshams la bsdad pa dang skabs der lha sar phyag 'a tshal nas 'gro rgyur yang bskyar gros byas/ kho mo gnyis kyis mtsho sngon nas lha sar phyag 'tshal na lo drug nas bdun tsam dgos zhes lab gleng byas pa dang / mtshams kyi zhor du sgrol ma sogs bton nas rim gro gang mang bsgrubs/ kho mo gnyis kyis dge slong chos grags la kha par gyi lam nas 'brel gtugs byas pa na a khus brkyangs phyag 'tshal mgo brtsams zin pa shes/mtshams grol rjes brag dkar rdzong du song nas phyag stan dang phyag mthil gang mang zhig bzos pa dang dus chad ltar dge slong chos grags yod sar song /bzhi ba/ lha sar phyag 'tshal pa'i lam bar gyi brgyud rim dang myong tshor/jo mo dam chos pad mas khyim mi rnams la gsang ste dus chad nang bzhin brag dkar rdzong dang thag nye sar a khu chos grags la thug ste phyag stan dang phyag mthil/ rkang mgor bskon rgyu sogs bzos te nyin 'ga' la gra sgrig legs po zhig byas/ spyi lo 2005 lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin brag dkar rdzong dang spyi le bcu gsum tsam yod sar dam chos pad ma dang lung rigs sgrol ma/dge slong chos grags bcas kyis mnyam du phyag 'tshal mgo brtsams pa dang / dge sbyong tshul khrims kyis shing rta drud de kho tshor zhabs zhu gang legs bsgrubs/ dang thog kho tshos nyin rer le bar gnyis tsam la phyag 'tshal pa dang / skabs der rkang lag dang rked pa sogs na zhing phan tshun gcig gis gcig la rtsam phur brgyabadunas rogs ram byas/ zla ba gcig tsam 'gor rjes phyag grangs je mang du btang ste nyin rer phyag 'tshal nas le bar lnga la song / skabs der snga mor dus tshod drug yas mas su yar langs nas nangs ja nyung tsam 'thung rjes/ phyag 'tshal mkhan gsum gyis phyag 'tshal mgo brtsams pa na/ shul du dge sbyong tshul khrims kyis ras gur rnams bltabs — 135 —
shing ca lag rnams bsdu gsog byas nas shing rta'i nang du brtsigs te le bar gsum tsam la thon pa na kho tsho'i rjes chod pa dang / de nas kho tshos ngal bsos te nangs ja gnyis pa bzhes/ za ma gtso bo
