dam du bcings pas dus rgyun dang 'dra bar phyag 'tshal thub pa byung / gzhan du na lam khar rlangs 'khor kha lo ba rnams la zas nyo ru bcug chog pas zas chad byung mi dgos/23 yizhes zer/kho tshos phyag 'tshal nas na kor mor slebs dus hor zla dgu pa'i nang la thon pa dang grang ngar che bas phyag 'tshal mtshams bzhag nas phyir yul du log ste dgun khar pha yul du zla ba bzhi ring la ngal bsos nas bsdad pa dang / spyi lo 2006 lo'i hor zla dang po'i tshes nyer lnga'i nyin lam la chas nas phyir na gor mor song ba dang / hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin yang bskyar phyag 'tshal mgo brtsams/na gor mor ma thon gong du lam bar du mi rnams kyis za ma dang sgor mo re byin nas kho tsho la rogs chen po byas pa dang de'i skor dris pa na/ 29na gor mo la ma thon gong mi rnams kyis za ma dang sgor mo sogs byin nas nga tshor rogs ram chen po zhig byas song / na gor mo brgal rjes nga tshor dge bsnyen zer pa'i sbyin bdag cig yod pa des rogs ram byas/ des a mdo'i phyag 'tshal pa'i mjal pa thams cad la rogs byed kyin yod/kho'i lag rogs lha sar rdo snum skyel mkhan mi gsum yod pa des rgyun par lam bar du nga tshor kha zas sogs bskyal yong / na gor mo phar brgal pa na zas bslangs kyang mi ster mkhan yang yod/ nga tshos a mdo'i skad ma gtogs bshad mi shes pas sa de'i mi rnams kyis ha mi go ba dang brda mi 'phrod par lan yang srid/1 ⑩ces bshad/kho tshos thog mar phyag 'tshal skabs hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig yin la/ de nas hor zla dgu pa'i nang na gor mor thon rjes phyir pha yul du log nas zla ba bzhi ring la ngal bsos pa yin /de nas yang bskyar hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin na gor mo nas phyag 'tshal te lha sar thon pa'i nyin mo de hor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la khel 'dug de ltar na mtsho sngon mtsho lho nas na gor mo'i grong khyer bar du zla ba bdun lhag la phyag 'tshal pa dang / na gor mo nas lha sa'i bar zla ba brgyad dang nyin nyi shu tsam la phyag 'tshal pas bsdoms pas zla ba bcu drug ste lo gcig dang zla ngo — 138—
bzhi tsam 'gor/ mtsho lho nas phyag 'tshal mgo brtsams pa nas mjug rdzogs pa'i bar du lo gcig dang zla ngo brgyad nyin nyi shu lhag 'gor/ des na le bar rer phyag bzhi brgya re 'tshal pa'i dbang du btang na mtsho sngon nas lha sa'i bar spyi le stong gcig dang dgu brgyad tsam yod pas rags rtsis byas na phyag 'bum bdun khri drug 'tshal yod/lnga ba/ brkyangs phyag 'tshal pa'i 'brasabu/phyag 'tshal nas lha sar thon la nye skabs jo mo dam chos pad ma'i a ma dang gnyen nye rnams nyin 'ga'i sngon du lha sar yong nas bsgugs pa dang / jo mo lung rigs sgrol ma'i spun grwa ba zhig dang / dge slong chos grags dang dge sbyong tshul khrims gnyis kyi gnyen nye mang bo zhig kyang lha sar yong nas kho tshor sgug bzhin bsdad/ hor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin te ston pa lha las babs pa'i dus chen nyin gyi snga dror lha sar slebs pa dang / de ga'i a mdo ba mang po zhig yong nas kha btags sogs phul te kho tsho mdun bsu byas shing / lam bar du dka' sdug gang dag myangs tshul sogs kyi gtam dris/ dam chos pad mas phyag 'tshal nas lha sar thon rjes a mas kho mor sgug 'dug pa dang / a mas kho mo'i gdong nag por gyur cing lus zungs zad pa'i rnam pa mthong ma thag sems kyis ma bzod par ngus shing mig chu mang po shor/ dam chos pad mas phyag 'tshal nas jo khang du thon la nye skabs rtags mtshan khyad par can zhig mthong /ba jo khang du mjal rjes phyag 'tshal nas pho brang po ta la'i 'dabs su phyag yongs su rdzogs par byas/ de nas nyin nyi shu tsam gyi ring la gtsang bkra shis lhun po dang / sa skya dkon pa/ zhwa lu dgon pa/ rgyal rtse dpal 'khor mchod rten/ bsam yas dkon pa/ khra 'brug dgon pa sogs la mjal/ kho mo'i dbu sa rogs gsum po bsam yas dgon par mtshams la bsdad/ kho mo'i lus phung nyam thag par gyur pas khyim mi rnams dang mnyam du mjal skor du 'gro ba'i lam bar du rkang lag dang lus po yar — 139 —
'degs mi thub pa byung / khyim mi rnams kyis kho mo myur du phyir pha yul du khrid nas ngal bso legs po zhig bya dgos zhes bshad/ yin yang kho mos jo khang la phyag skor thengs gcig 'tshal 'dod pa'i re ba bton pa ltar skor pa phyed tsam la phyag 'tshal pas lus po sngar bzhin yang mor gyur pas jo khang la phyag skor bdun 'tshal/de nas khyim mi rnams dang mnyam du phyir pha yul la yong ba dang / sde mi rnams yong nas kho mos lam bar du dka' sdug chen po myangs min dris pa dang / sde ba gzhan pa'i mi rnams kyang yong nas kho mor rten 'brel zhu ba dang lam bar gyi gnas tshul rnams re re bzhin dris/ kho mor phyag 'tshal pa'i dge mtshan dang 'bras bu gang dag yod tshul dris pa na/ kho mos bshad rgyur/ 99rang gis phyag 'tshal nas dge ba mang bo zhig bsags pa dang mnyam du lus kyi sdig sgrib mang po zhig sbyangs yod/ de las gzhan lus phung gi bde thang la phan thogs ha cang che ste/ ngas lha sar phyag ma byi( ༵ hūm̐ dī ༷༷dī zloX ༷༷ yo) sapa~X ma shārnyi ༵ ༷ ༷ga ༵ ༵ hūm̐ k+ṣiṃ dī//tsho ༷༵ dī ༵ sna rdzu m+p+raṃ pa hūm̐ je legs su gyur/ da lta dam chos pad mas 'ba' rdzong rka mo che sde ba'i nye 'dabs su chags yod pa'i gsang sngags bde chen mkha' 'gro gling du kha ton dge sbyor byed bzhin yod/ /jo mo dam chos pad ma rab tu byung ba'i gnas tshul dang / phyag 'tshal nas lha sar mjal pa'i myong tshor dang brgyud rim bcas gas nga tshos shes thub pa ni bod rigs bud med cig la mtshon na chos bsgrub rgyu ha cang dka' ba dang / kho mor phyag 'tshal nas lha sar mjal pa'i snying stobs yod /pa ni chung dus nas a pha tshe las 'das pas a ma dang a ce gnyis la rogs byas nas ༷khyim las dang zhing las gang mang las te sdug myangs par goms par gyur pas yin te/ khri ku'i bis kya dgon /pa'i grwa btsun dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang jo mo dam chos pad ma gnyis kyis za khang zhig tu lha sar /phyag 'tshal pa'i skor gleng dus/ kho mos bshad rgyur/ 29ngas lha sar phyag 'tshal 'dod kyi 'dun pa — 140—
de grogs mo jo mo gnyis la ma bshad/ rgyu mtshan ni kho mo gnyis ni phyag 'tshal nas lha sar mjal te sdug myang thub pa zhig min/ nga la mtshon na chung dus nas las ka mang po las pas sdug myang thub/〉〉ga ces bshad pa dang / kho mos chos dang rig gnas cung zad ma gtogs mi shes pas phyag 'tshal nas sgrib pa sbyang 'dod kyi 'dun pa brtan po zhig ldan pa dang gcig rab tu byung rjes mtshams la bsdud de dus rgyun du brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas goms lobs su song ba dang gnyis/ chung dus nas khyim las dang zhing las gnyer nas dka' sdug dang gdong gtod thub pa gsum bcas ni kho mos le bar stong tsho gnyis tsam la brkyangs phyag 'tshal nas bde blag ngang legs 'grub byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo gsum red snyam du bdag gis sems so/ /mchan 'grel/① skabs der kho mo'i sde bar slob chung lo rim dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis ma gtogs med pas kha sgang sde ba'i slob chung du zhugs/zhuzhu(ku⑨⑩⑩⑩⑩⑩⑩⑩⑩bcar 'dri bya yul/ jo mo dam chos pad ma/ bcar 'dri byed mkhan/lhun grub rdo rje/ bcar 'dri'i gnas/ 'ba' rdzong rka mo che sde ba'i nye 'dabs kyi gsang sngags bde chen mkha' 'gro gling / bcar 'dri'i dus/ spyi lo 2009 lo'i zla ) tshes 30 nyin/ bcar 'dri'i yo byad/861tshogasga 1 sgra phab smyu gu/ (40017 14 56 40703)bu ho rdog ni sog skad de chad 'grib can gyi chu mig ces pa'i ming ste/ 'dir de lta bu'i chu mig gi ming thogs pa'i mtsho lho khul gung ho rdzong chab cha grong brdal gyi mnga' khongs kyi ho rdog sde bar go dgos/dpon ni a mdo'i kha skad de khyim sngags kyi ming yin/ skabs 'dir ho rdog na yod pa'i khyim sngags kun la go ba ma yin par a khu rig 'dzin 'jigs med ces pa der go dgos/① tshogs zhes pa yi dam gyi lha tshogs dgyes pa'i phyir tshogs 'khor bskor pa la go dgos/—141—
② phud ces pa a mdo'i kha skad de sngon bsgrubs pa'i don te sngon 'gro phud ces pa ni rang gi yi dam de sgrub pa'i skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol 'debs/ phyag mchod pa/ bskor pa/ rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg sku bzhengs bcu'am/ yang na skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ yig brgya/ phyagmchod pa/ gsol 'debs te 'bum drug dang ma mtha' yang skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed/ yig brgya/gsol 'debs bcas 'bum bzhi nges par 'gro dgos pa yin/① mi'i ske dang rked pa na dus rtsam pa nyung tsam gtor nas lag mthil gyis yang yang phur pa la zer/② bcar 'dri byed skabs kho mos rtags mtshan khyad par can ci zhig mthong ba nga la bshad ma 'dod pas 'dir 'god thabs bral/— 142 —
mdo smad dhī ཿ tsha dgon pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs thad kyi 'gyur ldog skor rags tsam gleng pa/de yang dhī ཿtsha dkon pa ni mtsho sngon zi ring grong khyer nas spyi le brgyad cu lhag gi gnas su yod pa'i ba yan rdzong gi nub phyogs su chags yod pa dang / spyi lo 1903 lor zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta rje dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos phyag 'debs mdzad cing / dgon pa'i mtshan yongs la dpal mi 'gyur dge ldan bkra shis chos sdings sam dhī ཿtsha bkra shis chos sdings gling zhes 'bod/dgon pa 'di nyid dge lugs pa'i ri khrod kyi dgon pa zhig yin la sngon chad mkhas dbang gang mang zhig dgon pa 'di las mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams la sbyangs nas mkhas par gyur pas mdo smad du ming grags ha cang che zhing / nā len dra gnyis pa zhes pa'i mtshan yang thogs myong / spyi lo 1981 lor yang dar gyi chos sgo phye rjes dgon sde 'di nyid bskyar bzhengs byas/ sngar gyi phyag srol ltar chos thog dang dus mchod rnams btsugs te gzhung pod lnga'i 'chad nyan spel pa nas bzung grwa btsun yang rim bzhin je mang du gyur te da lta bzhi brgya tsam la slebs yod/ dus mtshungs su chos lugs kyi srid jus dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros sogs la brten nas dgon sde'i rig gnas la'ang rim bzhin 'gyur ldog mi nyung ba zhig byung dang 'byung bzhin yod la/ de ni dgon sde'i rig gnas deng gi spyi tshogs dang bstun pa'i snang tshul zhig yin la dgon sde'i rig gnas kyi 'phel rgyas shig kyang red/ yin na yang 'di'i skor la do snang dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan cung nyung zhing 'di'i — 143 —
thad kyi dpyad rtsom yang re gnyis ma gtogs med pas/ 'dir ched du 'das zin pa'i lo ngo nyi shu'i ring la dhī ཿtsha dgon pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs la 'gyur ldog gang dag byung yod pa dang /des dgon sde'i slob gso'i 'phel rgyas la nus pa ga 'dra zhig thon yod tshul sogs cung zad gleng bar 'dod do/ /dang po/ dgon par slob grwa btsugs pa/grwa btsun gyi slob gso ni dgon sde'i rig gnas kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig yin la/ dge lugs pa'i grwa btsun gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bya ba gtso bo'ang nang bstan gyi gzhung pod lnga la slob gnyer rdo rus thug pa zhig bya rgyu de red/ 'das zin pa'i lo ngo nyi shu'i ring gi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun nas mdo smad dhī ཿtsha dgon pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs la'ang 'gyur ldog nges can zhig byung yod pa dang / dgon par slob grwa btsugs pa ni slob gnyer lam lugs thad kyi 'gyur ldog dang 'phel rgyas kyi snang tshul gtso bo zhig red/ de ni dang thog dgon pa'i khri ba dang do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne ba rnams gros bsdur byas pa brgyud nas thag bcad pa ltar slob chung gsar du btsugs pa ma yin par dgon pa'i slob gso'i dgos mkho dang dus rabs kyi 'phel rgyas dang bstun nas slob chung zhig rim gyis chags pa red/ spyi lo 1981 lor chos sgo phye rjes sprul sku blo bzang grags pa rgya mtsho mchog gis dgon pa'i khri ba'i 'gan bzhes shing / khong ni dgon pa 'di'i khri rabs drug pa yin/ spyi lo 1995 lo'i chos thog gi skabs su khong nyid chos grwa'i rtsod par gzigs rtog tu phebs pa na lo chung grwa ba rnams kyis rtsod pa 'phen mi shes pas rgyun du rtsed nas nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed bzhin yod par gzigs pa la brten nas khong gis rtsod pa'i skabs su lo chung grwa ba rnams la zur du yi ge 'bri klog re bslab na legs zhes dgongs 'char bton pa ni dgon par slob chung btsugs pa'i thog ma'i rgyu rkyen yin pa dang / de la brten nas dge bskos dang do dam u — 144—
yon lhan khang gi las sne ba rnams kyis rdo sbis mkhas grub dang gling rgya chos grags gnyis la las bgo byas te thugs rje chen po'i lha khang du lo chung grwa ba bco lnga tsam la yig gzugs bslab tu bcug pa ni dgon pa'i slob chung gi thog ma'i rnam pa red/ de nas lo ngo gcig tsam gyi rjes su yig gzugs bslabs mtshams bzhag ste phal cher lo ngo gsum tsam 'gor/ spyi lo 1999 lo'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes mgor dge bskos ka rgya tshul khrims lags kyis lo chung grwa ba rnams la yang bskyar yig gzugs bslab dgos tshul do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne ba rnams la bshad de las bcol dang re ba bton pa la brten nas seng gshong dge 'dun 'jigs med lags kyis a khu phag skor skal bzang0sbyor klog gi dge rgan dang a khu rig smon bsam gtan①yig gzugs kyi dge rgan du bskos shing / lo de'i dgun chos nas bzung 'dra sku lha khang du 'tshogs te slob ma rnams la dngos su slob khrid byed mgo brtsams/ skabs der slob ma nyi shu lhag yod pa dang sbyang bya ni yig gzugs gcig pu ma yin par sbyor klog dang thob thang la sogs pa yang bslabs pa yin te/ seng gshong dge 'dun 'jigs med lags kyis 99lo chung grwa ba rnams la yig gzugs kho na bslabs pas mi chog ste/ bsdus chung du zhugs dus sum rtags kyi rmang gzhi cung zad med na bsdus grwa'i gzhung go dka' bas de la dmigs nas dge rgan rnam gnyis la dag yig dang thob thang sogs kyang 'khrid du bcug pa yin/〉〉 du zhes gsungs/ yin na yang skabs der slob khang dang cog tse rkub stegs bcas kyi cha rkyen ma 'dzoms pa dang dkon pas kyang de la de 'dra'i do snang chen po ma byas pa red snyam/ skabs de'i 'dzin grwa dang slob sbyong gi cha rkyen skor zhib tu dris pa na dge rgan rig smon bsam gtan lags kyis bshad rgyur/ 22dang thog 'dra sku lha khang du 'tshogs dus slob ma'i bod yig gi chu tshad gzhir byas nas 'dzin grwa gnyis su bgos pa dang / gcig ni ka kha'i 'dzin grwa dang cig shos ni bod yig gi rmang gzhi cung zad yod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis grub pa'i 'dzin grwa zhig yin/ skabs de'i slob sbyong gi cha rkyen ha cang zhan te/ cog tse dang rkub stegs med pa dang / khang — 145 —
ba yang gcig ma gtogs med pas de'i gyang ngos su sgo sam zhig bkal te slob khrid byas/ khang mig gcig gi nang du 'dzin grwa gnyis la slob khrid byed thabs med pas/ ngas 'dzin grwa ka bar slob khrid byed dus dge rgan phag skor skal bzang gis 'dzin grwa kha ba'i slob ma rnams khang ba'i phyi rol tu khrid de blo 'dzin dang skabs 'gar ngal bso byed du bcug ste res mos sgos slob khrid byas pa yin/ de ltar 'dra sku lha khang du slob khrid byas nas lo ngo gcig tsam 'gor/11 ① zhes gsungs/de nas tshogs chen 'du khang rgyab kyi dpar khang rnying ba zhig yod pa der gnas spar nas rkub stegs rnying ba 'ga' re bsgrigs pa dang shing leb 'ga' khyer yong nas cog tse'i dod tsam bzos nas der lo ngo gcig tsam la slob khrid byas/ skabs der slob ma bzhi bcu tsam yod pa dang lo de nas bzung slob chung du slob gnyer byed bzhin pa'i lo chung grwa ba rnams la rgyugs blangs te rgyugs 'bras la brten nas 'dzin grwa yar 'phar ba dang slob mthar phyin pa'i slob ma rnams la dgon pas 'dzin yig ster pa'i srol btsugs pa red/spyi lo 2001 lo'i dgun chos kyi mgor tshogs chen 'du khang rgyab kyi sman khang gzhan du spar rjes de ru khang mig che ba gnyis dang chung ba gcig yod pa slob khang du byas pa dang / dge bskos dang do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne ba rnams gros bsdur byas te sngon gyi 'dzin grwa gnyis po 'dzin grwa gsum du bgos shing bod yig bslab bya gcig pu'i khar rgya yig dang dbyin yig gi slob khrid gnyis gsar du bsnan te/ dge rgan rig smon bsam gtan gyis sngar bzhin yig gzugs khrid pa dang /dge rgan phag skor skal bzang gis bod yig dge rgan sangs rgyas chos dar gyis rgya yig dge rgan dge 'dun bzang bos dbyin yig slob khrid byas/ de rna lo chung grwa ba rnams la thog mar yig gzugs bslabs pa la brten nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su phyin te slob chung gi rnam par 'gyur ba'i lo zhig yin te/ skabs der slob ma'i bslab bya sngar las kha je tshang du gyur cing / slob ma'i chu tshad dang bstun nas 'dzin grwa yang mtho dman bar ma gsum du bkar pa dang / 'dzin grwa re la — 146—
slob khang re yod par gyur pa ma zad/ rgyugs 'bras la brten nas 'dzin grwa 'phar pa dang lo gsum gyi rjes su slob chung mthar phyin pa'i srol yang btsugs/spyi lo 2004 lor slob chung gi slob gso'i dgos mkho ltar dge bskos gtso byas pa'i dgon pa'i las sne ba rnams kyis dge rgan dang bslab bya'i thad nas bcos sgyur cung zad byas te/ dge rgan phag skor skal bzang la gnang ba byin nas ngal bso ru bcug ste de'i tshab tu do rgya blo bzang bod yig gi dge rgan du bskos pa dang /༷ sngar gyi bslab bya gtso bo gsum gyi khar rtsis rig gsar du bsnan nas 'od zer grags pa de'i dge rgan du bskos/ skabs der rgya'i skad yig gi dge rgan sangs rgyas chos dar gnas gzhan du song bas dge rgan rig smon bsam gtan lags kyis yig gzugs dang rgya yig gnyis ku'i slob khrid kyi 'gan khur te lo chung grwa ba rnams la slob khrid gang legs byas te sman khang gi gnas der lo drug 'gor/ spyi lo2006lor dbyin yig gi dge rgan gnas gzhan du song rjes dbyin yig gi slob khrid byed mtshams bzhag pa dang / lo der a khu bya khyung blo bzang do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sner bskos rjes khong gis slob grwa 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i 'gan khur te lo chung slob ma rnams la ched du slob sbyong byed sa'i slob khang zhig dgos snyam ste/ spyi lo 2007 lor rgya'i sbyin bdag cig gis dmangs sgor 'bum gcig dang sku phyogs sku mched lags kyi sbyin bdag cig gis dmangs sgor khri gsum gyi rogs skyor byas pa la brten nas lo de'i hor zla gsum pa'i tshes mgor tshogs chen 'du khang gi rgyab tu slob khang gsar pa khang mig lnga can zhig dngos su las mgo brtsams te lo de'i zla brgyad par legs 'grub byung / de'i skabs su slob ma rnams sku phyogs zhwa dmar tshang gi nang chen gyi lhas ra bar mar 'tshogs te lo phyed tsam la slob khrid byas/ lo de'i dgun chos nas bzung slob ma lnga bcu tsam yod pa tshang ma slob khang gsar par 'tshogs te slob khrid byas/bsdoms pas khang mig lnga yod pa las gsum ni slob khang dang / gcig ni dge rgan rnams kyi gzhung las khang / gcig ni slob grwa'i dngos po rnams 'jog sa red/— 147 —
lo chung slob ma rnams bslab bya gang la spro ba yod tshul skor dris shing / kho tshos lan btab pa ltar na ches dga' ba'i bslab bya ni bod yig dang de nas rtsis rig yin pa dang / rgya yig sbyang rgyur spro ba de 'dra med pa dang kho tshor mtshon na ches sbyang dka' ba'i bslab bya yang rgya'i skad yig red zer/ dgon par slob chung gsar du btsugs pa'i dgos pa dang bslab bya'i gras su thog mar rgya yig dang dbyin yig de nas rtsis rig bsnan pa'i dmigs yul dang dgos pa ci yin dris pa na dge rgan do rgya blo bzang lags kyis (2slob grwa gsar du btsugs pa'i dgos pa ni gtso bo lo chung grwa ba rnams kyis gzhung pod lnga'i dang po tshad ma rig pa sbyang bar rmang gzhi brtan po zhig chags pa'i ched yin pa dang / rgya yig ni dus rgyun gyi 'tsho ba'i nang du spyod rgya che zhing grong khyer sogs su song tshe rgya yig cung zad ma shes na dka' khag mang po zhig la 'phrad srid pa dang / dbyin yig ni da lta 'dzam gling gi spyi skad lta bur gyur yod pas de cung zad shes na legs snyam nas bslab bya'i gas su bzhag pa red/ rtsis rig bslab bya'i gras su bzhag pa ni dgon pa'i rtsis gnyer pa dang dkon gnyer sogs kyi 'gan khur dgos tshe rtsis cung zad shes dgos pa la dmigs pa red/lha ① ces bshad/spyi lo 2009 lor dgon pa'i 'du khang bskyar bzhengs byed ched sngon chad do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne'i 'gan khur myong ba'i grwa btsun nyams myong can rnams yang bskyar do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne bar bskos rjes/ seng gshong dge 'dun 'jigs med lags la slob grwa dang sman khang / glog klad khang dang dpar khang rnams las rgyu'i 'gan bzhag pa dang / khong gis dgon pa'i 'du khang rgya bskyed de sum thog can zhig bzhengs tshe de'i rgyab kyi slob khang gi lhas ra je chung du gyur 'gro ba dang / dgun khar nyi 'od mi phog pa sogs la dmigs nas slob grwa dang sman khang gnyis legs po zhig las dgos snyam ste do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne ba gzhan rnams la ji ltar las rgyu'i skor yar zhu byas te gros legs po zhig byas/ do dam u yon lhan khang gi re ba ltar spyi — 148—
lo 2010 lo'i hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas hor zla bcu ba'i tshes mgo'i bar dgon pa'i zhol du brtsegs ma rer gyan bdun re yod pa'i slob khang sum thog can zhig las pa dang / gcig thog ni dge rgan dang slob ma rnams kyi mal khang dang za khang yin la/ nyis thog tu slob khang gsum yod pa dang / sum thog tu dpe mdzod khang zhig dang dge rgan gyi gzhung las khang rnams yod/ spyi lo 2010 lo'i lo mjug nas bzung dgon pa'i slob chung cung tshad ldan can du gyur te lo chung grwa ba rnams la slob khrid byed bzhin yod par ma zad/ phyogs so so nas yong ba'i bod kyi slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum gyi slob ma rnams la sum rtags dang snyan ngag bsdus grwa sogs slob khrid byed bzhin yod/ de'i skor dris pa na seng gshong dge 'dun 'jigs med lags kyis 99sngon chad dhīḥtsha dgon pa'i slob gsos bod kyi slob gso'i 'phel rgyas thad la nus pa chen po zhig thon yod pa ni dag yig gsar bsgrigs rtsom mkhan a khu bsam gtan lags dang / sge'u steng yongs 'dzin blo bzang dpal ldan gyi dngos slob a lags tshe tan zhabs drung / mtsho lho mi rigs dge thon slob grwar lo du mang ring dge rgan gyi las gnyer pa'i a khu bshad sgrub rgya mtsho sogs las shes nus shing /da lta'ang dgon pas mtsho lho khul gyi mi rigs slob 'bring re gnyis la bsdus grwa'i dge rgan mngags yod/ yin na yang de tsam gyis mi chog pas da lta slob ma rnams tshur dkon par bsdus nas slob khrid byed ched du slob khang 'di 'dra chen po zhig las pa yin/ 11 ①zhes bshad/slob chung de'i rgyugs len tshul dang 'dzin grwa 'phar tshul ni rgyal khab kyi slob grwa dang 'dra zhing /dgon pa'i slob gnyer gyi khyad chos dang bstun ci thub byas yod par ma zad/ slob chung gi slob gnyer lam lugs cung grim lhod dang ldan pa zhig red/ dper na/ dgun chos dang rdo gcal gnyis slob skabs gcig tu brtsis te rdo gcal gyi mjug tu rgyugs chung len pa dang dpyid chos dang dbyar chos gnyis slob skabs gcig tu brtsis te dbyar chos kyi mjug tu rgyugs chen len pa red/rgyugs chung gi bya dga' ni dge bskos dang do dam khang gi las sne ba rnams slob grwar 'ongs te ster — 149—
pa dang / rgyugs chen gyi sbyangs 'bras tshogs chen 'du khang 'gram gyi gyang ngos su gsal bsgrags byed/ de'i bya dga' drug pa'i tshes bzhi'am yang na tshes drug la chos grwar grwa tshang mang po 'tshogs pa'i dbus su dgon pa'i khri ba dang do dam u yin lhan khang gis ster pa red/ rgyugs 'bras ha cang zhan pa rnams 'dzin grwa yar 'phar du mi 'jug par rang sor 'jog skabs 'gar slob ma re gnyis lo bzhi lnga 'gor yang da dung slob mthar phyin ma thub pa dang yang na lo bco brgyad yan chad dmigs bsal gyis chos grwar zhugs su 'jug pa red/ sngon chad slob grwar song myong ba zhig yin tshe rgyugs sprad de thad kur 'dzin grwa gnyis pa dang yang na gsum pa nas zhugs chog pa dang / bod yig gi rmang gzhi brtan po yod pa zhig yin tshe thad kur chos grwar zhugs kyang chog pas dgon par gsar du zhugs pa rnams nges par slob chung du zhugs dgos pa'i nges pa med/ slob mthar phyin pa'i dus ni lo re'i dbyar chos kyi mjug ste hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu nas bco lnga'i bar yin la/mthar phyin mdzad sgo de 'dra gzab rgyas shig min par do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne ba rnams dang dge bskos rnams slob chung du yong nas mthar phyin slob ma rnams kyi ming tho gsal bor bsgrags te mthar phyin 'dzin yig ster pa dang chabs cig chos grwar zhugs rjes slob gnyer la 'bad dgos tshul gyi kha ta dang bcas mjug sgril par byed/ slob chung btsugs nas spyi lo2010 lo'i dbyar chos kyi mjug bar 'dzin grwa bcu gcig slob mthar phyin pa red/ de ltar dgon par slob chung btsugs te lo ngo gsum ring la lo chung grwa ba rnams la sbyor klog dang thob thang / sum rtags sogs khrid bzhin yod pa de ni dhīḥtsha dgon pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs kyi 'gyur ldog gtso bo zhig yin la/ des dgon sde'i slob gso'i 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po zhig thon yod de/ lo chung grwa ba rnams slob chung nas mthar phyin rjes rgya yig dang rtsis rig gi shes bya mang po zhig rtogs yod par ma zad/ bod yig gi yon tshad nges can zhig la thon yod pas bsdus grwa'i gzhung don go bar phan thogs mi nyung ba zhig yod/— 150—
gnyis pa/ rgya lo'i rdo gcal dang ston chos/ drug pa'i tshogs langs rnams gsar du btsugs pa/ dhīḥtsha dgon pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs thad kyi 'gyur ldog gzhan zhig ni rgya lo'i rdo gcal dang ston chos/ drug pa'i tshogs langs rnams gsar du btsugs pa de red/ de yang dgon par dgung lo bgres pa'i dge bshes chen mo rnam gsum bzhugs pa las spyi lo 1990lo'i zla gsum pa dang bzhi bar snga rjes su dge bshes chen mo rje dge 'dun shes rab lags dang rje smra ba'i dbang phyug zho 'ong phun tshogs dar rgyas rnam gnyis sku gshegs pas lo de nas bzung dge bshes chen mo ye shes rgya mtsho tshang dge rgan du gdan drangs shing / spyi lo 1991 lor khong gi thugs dgongs ltar rgya lo'i rdo gcal btsugs/ sngon chad dhī ཿtsha dgon par rgya lo'i nang du chos thog gcig kyang med pas rgya lo'i rdo gcal chos thog nyin bzhi bcur 'tshog rgyu gtan 'khel byas te rgya lo'i tshes brgyad nyin nas gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad bar dang / gnyis pa'i mchod me'i rjes kyi gnyis pa'i tshes nyer bzhi nyin nas gsum pa'i tshes lnga bar yin/ rgya lo'i rdo gcal gyi skabs su phyi dro'i dus tshod bzhi yas mas su 'khar rnga brdungs pa na grwa tshang yongs rdzogs tshogs chen 'du khang gi sgo chen mdun du 'tshogs nas mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs/ gsungs nas phyi dro'i dus tshod lnga yas mas su grol rjes zla bo nyis cha dang dam bca' nang 'dzugs kyi rtsod pa byed/ dge bskos kyis dus tshod gcig tsam la gzigs rtog gnang nas shag tu phebs rjes grwa ba rnams kyang rang rang gi shag tu phebs chog yin na yang dge bskos phebs shul du dpe cha pa rnams kyis da dung chos ra'i nang du mu mthud du rtsod pa byas te yun ring 'gor ba'i skabs kyang shin tu mang la/ dpe cha pa de rnams la gzhug skyor pa zhes 'bod pa dang yang na grwa ba ga ge mo zhig gzhug skyor la bsdad yod ces zer/ rgya lo'i rdo gcal mjug gi — 151—
nyin bcu'i nang du thog mar dam bca' chung ba nyin bdun dang de'i rjes dam bca' chen mo nyin gsum la yod/ dam bca' chung ba ni 'dzin grwa gong 'og gnyis kyi dpe cha pa rnams phan tshun rtsod pa byed pa la zer pa dang / dam bca' chen mo ni rang gi 'dzin grwa'i dpe cha pa rnams dang 'dzin grwa gong ma'i gong ma'am zhol ma'i zhol ma gnyis kyi dpe cha pa rnams dang phan tshun rtsod pa byed pa la zer/ de'i skabs su yang tshogs chen 'du khang gi mdun du grwa tshang yongs rdzogs 'tshogs nas mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs gsungs tshar nas grol pa na/ thog mar zla bo nyis cha'i rtsod pa cung zad byas rjes dam bca' chung ba dang dam bca' chen mo'i mgo rtsom par byed pa dang / 'dzin grwa'i dpe cha pa'i mang nyung ltar grwa ba gsum nas lnga 'dzin grwa gzhan pa'i nang du dam bcar phebs/gnyis pa'i mchod me'i sngon gyi zla ba gcig ring gi rdo gcal chos thog gi skabs su dam bca' che chung gnyis med pas de'i skabs su zla bo nyis cha'i rtsod pa cung yun ring byas rjes dam bca' nang 'dzugs kyi rtsod pa byed/ 'di yang dhīḥtsha dgon pa'i dgon sde'i rig gnas kyi 'gyur ldog gam 'phel rgyas shig yin la/ 'di las dgon pa'i khri ba dang las sne ba rnams kyis grwa btsun gyi slob gso'i 'phel rgyas la thugs khur dang shugs 'don bzhin pa gsal bor rtogs thub ste/ dge rgan chen mo lung rigs lags kyis (tsasngon chad dhī ཿtsha dgon par rgya lo'i nang du chos thog med pa dang dgon pa'i slob gso gong 'phel du 'gro dgos na dpe cha pa rnams la rtsod pa mang po byed du 'jug rgyu shin tu gal che bas/ rgya lo'i rdo gcal btsugs nas chos grwa'i rtsod pa je mang du btang ba yang khong (dge bshes chen mo ye shes rgya mtsho tshang ) gi bka' drin yin/11 ① zhes gsungs/ston chos ji ltar btsugs tshul bshad pa la/ spyi lo 2008 lo nas bzung tshod lta'i tshul du dgu ba'i tshes bco lnga nas bcu ba'i tshes lnga bar ston chos nyin nyi shu la btsugs pa dang / de 'dzugs dgos tshul gyi re ba 'don mkhan ni seng gshong 'jigs med lags yin/ khong gis gzhan pa'i dgon pa re gnyis na ston chos btsugs yod pa gsal bor shes pa la brten nas ston chos kyi dge — 157—
mtshan dang de 'dzugs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dgon pa'i las sne ba rnams la zhus te dngos su btsugs pa red/ ston chos kyi dus tshod bkod sgrig thad nas phal cher dbyar chos dang 'dra ste/dpe cha pa rnams zhogs par dpe khrid la 'gro ba dang / snga dro'i dus tshod bcu dang phyed kur grwa mang rnams yar 'tshogs nas chos grwar rtsi bzhag dang rgyugs blor skyor/ de nas tshogs chen 'du khang du 'tshogs te dga' ldan lha brgya ma sogs gsungs nas dros ja bzhes pa dang / phyi dro'i dus tshod gcig bar grol chung dang de'i skabs su dge rgan rnams kyis dpe khrid gnang ba dang / phyi dro'i dus tshod gsum yas mas su yar chos grwar 'tshogs te 'dzin grwa re re'i nang khul du zla bo nyis cha'i rtsod pa byed/ skar ma sum cu tsam gyi rjes su 'du khang du 'tshogs nas rten 'brel bstod pa sogs gsungs rjes gung tshigs bzhes pa dang / gung tshigs kyi rjes su ma ṇi dang ltung bshags/ sgrol ma sogs gsungs te dus tshod lnga yas mas su grol nas 'dzin grwa'i nang khul du zla bo nyis cha'i rtsod pa byed/ rtsod pa'i dus yun ni dus tshod gcig tsam yin/ de nas phyir 'du khang du 'tshogs te sgrol ma sogs gsungs nas dus tshod bdun yas mas su grol pa na yang bskyar rtsod pa byed/ dge bskos kyis dus tshod gcig tsam la rtog gzigs mdzad rjes shag tu phebs pa red/ston chos kyi skabs su bsdus chen/ rtags rigs/ blo rig gzhung gsar 'dzin grwa rnams mnyam du bsres nas rnam 'grel rtsod du 'jug pa dang / phar phyin skabs dang po dang bzhi ba'i 'dzin grwa gnyis bsres nas drang nges rtsod/ mdzod 'dul dbu gsum gyi 'dzin grwa gsum bsres nas mdzod rtsod/ bsdus chung gis bskyar du gung thang rigs lam 'phrul lde rtsod/ bsdus 'bring gis sngon song rnams slar yang rtsod pa ni sngar med pa'i slob gnyer byed thabs gsar pa zhig red/a khu lung rtogs lags kyis ((sto/na chos btsugs pas dgon pa'i slob gso'i 'phel rgyas la nus pa chen po zhig thon yod de/ ston khar nam zla'i dro grang snyoms pas dpe char gzigs pa'i dus skabs bzang bo zhig yin pa dang / ston chos dang bcu ba'i lnga mchod gnyis kyi bar du nyin nyi shu tsam ma — 153 —
gtogs med pa dang / dpe cha pa rnams kyis ston chos kyi skabs su slob gnyer byas pas bcu ba'i lnga mchod kyi phar phyin dam bca' dang bka' bcu'i dam bca'i skabs su rtsod pa'i thugs sngar las je cher song 'dug71 ①ces gsungs pa las dgon pas slob gnyer la thugs 'don bzhin yod pa dang / sto/na chos btsugs pa la brten nas dgon sde'i slob gso gong 'phel du 'gro bzhin pa'ang rtogs thub/da dung 1996 lor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nas bcu gcig par tshogs langs gsar pa btsugs shing / rtags rigs nas 'dul ba'i bar gyi 'dzin grwa brgyad po'i nang gi dpe cha pa rnams tshogs langs la bkod sgrig byed/ nyin rer 'dzin grwa re re nas dpe cha pa gnyis res rtsod pa byed pa red/zla bzhi ba'i tshes mgor dge bskos kyis de'i skor gyi gnas tshul 'dzin grwa re'i skyor dpon la zhib tu dris nas bsko ba red/ bsdus grwa'i tshogs langs ni bdun pa'i dus mchod kyi skabs su bkod sgrig byas yod/ dbyar chos skabs kyi drug pa'i tshogs langs ni dros ja bzhes tshar te dus tshod bcu gcig gi rjes su dge bskos kyis brda brgyab pa na rtsod pa byed mkhan gnyis gral 'dabs su yong nas phyag gsum 'tshal pa dang / de nas gcig gdong gral dang cig shos dge bskos kyi gral du song nas gnyis ka yar langs te rtsod pa byed/ ka ring zhol ma'i 'dabs su dhī skad btang ste khyab mtha'i mgo bzung nas rtsod pa 'phen par byed/ rtsod pa'i skabs su dam bca' ba dang rigs slong pa gnyis gral nas yar 'gro mar 'gro byed/ thog mar rigs slong pas dge bskos gral nas bgro gleng byed/ dam bca' bas gdong gral nas lan 'debs par byed/ phan tshun bgro gleng byed pa'i dus tshod ni skar ma bco lnga nas nyi shu bar yin/ rtsod pa byas tshar rjes rigs slong pas dhī skad ring bo zhig gtong ba red/ de'i rjes gdong gral gyi dam bca' ba des rigs slong pa byas te dhī skad btang nas rtsod pa 'phen pa dang / cig shos des dge bskos gral nas lan 'debs par byed/skar ma nyi shu tsam gyi rjes su yang gdong gral gyi rigs slong pa des dhī skad ring bo snga ma bzhin btang — 154—
rjes sangs rgyas rnam gzigs sogs gsungs nas grol bar byed/ rtags rigs yan gyi dpe cha pa rnams tshogs langs kyi skabs 'dir rtsod pa byed dus rigs slong pa dang dam bca' ba gnyis gral mgor 'gro chog pa dang / bsdus grwa'i tshogs langs pa rnams kyis de ltar bya mi rung ngo / /gsum pa/ rjo rams pa dang bka' bcu'i dam bca' 'drag pa'i srol btsugs pa/dhī ཿtsha dgon par sngon chad nas phar phyin rab 'byams pa'i dam bca' dang bka' rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog tshul yod/ yin na yang rdo rams pa'i dam bca' 'jog pa'i srol ni gsar du btsugs pa dang / bka' bcu dam bca' ni sngon chad kyi bka' rams pa'i tshab tu btsugs shing / de yang rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen gyis bka' bcu'i dam bca' gnang ba'i srol btod pa'i rgyun ltar 'dir gzhung pod lnga las tshad ma dang phar phyin/ dbu ma bcas gzhung gsum gyi dam bca' yin/ rdo gcal dam bca' thog mar ji ltar btsugs pa red ce na/ dhīḥtsha dgon pa'i sngon chad kyi sgrig yig bor brlag tu song ste lag bris ma kha mi tshang ba zhig ma gtogs mi 'dug pas thengs shig la grwa tshang mang po 'tshogs pa'i skabs su dge bshes chen mo ye shes rgya mtsho tshang la sgrig yig cig gsung dgos tshul zhus pa dang / der brten khong gis sgrig yig thar ba'i lam gyi 'jug ngogs gsung ba'i skabs su rdo gcal dam bca' 'jog mkhan zhig yod tshe rgya lo'i tshes bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du 'jog dgos zhes gsungs nas rdo gcal dam bca' 'jog pa'i dus gtan 'khel byas/ de'i dam bca' 'jog srol ni rgya lo'i tshes bcu gcig nyin gyi phyi dro'i dus tshod bzhi par grwa tshang yongs rdzogs 'du khang gi sgo khar 'tshogs te mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs gsungs nas tshar pa na chos grwa'i rdo gcal gyi steng du dam bca' 'jog pa'i mgo brtsams shing / dam bca' ba gcig ma gtogs med pa dang dam bca' 'jog pa'i dus yun ni nyin rer dus tshod gsum tsam yin/ tshes bcu gcig nas bco lnga'i bar nyin rer gzhung pod re — 155 —
rtsod dgos pa dang / tshes bcu gcig nyin 'dul ba dang bcu gnyis nyin mdzod/ bcu gsum nyin dbu ma/ bcu bzhi nyin tshad ma dang tshes bco lnga'i nyin phar phyin skor gyi brgal brtag byed pa yin la/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin rten 'brel la dmigs nas rtsod pa rdzogs la nye dus phar phyin gyi skabs brgyad pa'i 'phrin las skor nas rtags gsal 'phen pa'i srol yod/ nyin der rdo gcal dam bca'i brgal brtag gi rtsod pa snga dror byed pa dang phyi dror rdo gcal dam bca' 'jog mkhan gyis grwa tshang yongs la mang ja bskol nas mang 'gyed gtong pa red/dge rgan chen mo lung rigs lags kyis 99rdo gcal dam bca' 'jog skabs nyin rer gzhung pod re'i dam bca' 'jog dgos pa dang / gzhung pod re re'i thad nas rtsod pa 'phen mkhan gyi rigs slong pa bcu gnyis re bkod sgrig byed pa red/ 11 ① ces gsungs pa ltar na/ nyin lnga'i nang du bsdoms pas rigs slong pa drug cus 'phangs pa'i lung rigs kyi brgal brtag rnams la lan gdab dgos/ de las gzhan da dung rdo gcal dam bca' 'jog pa la thog mar dgun chos kyi skabs su phyi dro'i dus tshod bzhi yas mas nas drug yas mas bar rang gi 'dzin grwa las gzhan pa'i 'dzin grwa bcu bo'i nang du re re bzhin dam bca' 'jog dgos shing / dgun chos skabs kyi dam bca' bzhag tshar rjes da gzod rdo gcal dam bca' 'jog pa red/bka' bcu'i dam bca' ni rgya lo bco lnga'i nyin do dam u yon lhan khang gi las sne bas dge bskos dang gros byas te dam bca' ba gnyis bdams pa dang / de gnyis kyis 'bad pas dpe char bltas te zla ba dgu'i ring la dam bca' 'jog par gra sgrig legs po bya dgos pa dang / dam bca'i rjes kyi mang ja gtong bar yang sta gon bya dgos/ dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nyin gyi phyi dror yar tshogs 'tshogs nas grol rjes dus tshod lnga yas mas su bka' bcu dam bca'i mgo brtsam dgos/ thog mar dam bca' ba gnyis dbu ma'i 'dzin grwar dam bcar phebs pa dang / tshes nyer lnga'i nyin gyi snga dro'i dus tshod brgyad par tshogs grol/ phyir 'tshogs pa na dge — 156—
bskos kyis bka' bcu dam bca' ba gnyis la zhwa mos brda blta na pa dang mnyam du phar phyin skabs bzhi ba'i 'dzin grwa'i nang du dam bcar phebs pa dang rtsod pa'i dus yun dus tshod gnyis tsam yin la/ skabs der 'dzin grwa gzhan pa'i nang du dam bca' nang 'dzugs kyi rtsod pa byed pa red/ de nas dge bskos kyis brda brgyab pa na 'du khang du 'tshogs nas dros ja bzhes pa dang / dus tshod bcu gnyis yas mas su grol chung grol/ dus tshod gnyis dang phyed ka yas mas su phyir yar 'tshogs nas gong ltar dge bskos kyis brda brgyab pa na dam bca' ba gnyis phar phyin skabs dang po'i 'dzin grwa'i nang dam bcar phebs pa dang / rtsod yun dus tshod phyed ka tsam yin/ de nas 'du khang du 'tshogs nas gung tshigs bzhes pa dang / dus tshod lnga yas mas su tshogs grol/ rang rang gi shag tu mchod me dang gling me sna tshogs 'bul/dgong mo'i dus tshod bdun dang phyed ku'i steng grwa tshang yongs rdzogs 'du khang gi sgo khar 'tshogs/ dge bskos kyis dam bca' ba gnyis gdan 'dren zhus pa dang / dam bca' ba gnyis kyis lag tu spos bsgron pa bzung nas chos grwa'i sgo kha nas gus pa'i tshul gyis yar phebs te grwa tshang gi gral 'dabs su phyag gsum 'tshal rjes yar phebs nas gdan dkar steng du kha mar 'khor te bzhugs/ grwa tshang yongs rdzogs 'tshogs pa'i dbus su thog mar dge bshes shig yar bzhengs nas rtsod pa'i mgo brtsams te rtags gsal gtong ba dang / de nas rigs slong pa rnams bka' rams 'dzin grwa nas bsdus chung bar rim pa ltar bzhengs nas rtsod pa 'phen pa dang / 'dzin grwa re nas rigs pa smra ba drug nas bdun yar bzhengs te rtags gsal gtong dgos/ rtsod pa'i dus yun ni rigs slong pa rer skar ma bco lnga nas nyi shu bar yin/ dus tshod thon la nye ba na rigs slong pa rjes mas sngon mar rtsod mtshams 'jog tu bcug nas rtsod pa gsar pa zhig gi mgo bzung ste mu mthud du rtags gsal gtong ba dang / rtsod pa'i skabs su dam bca' ba'i 'gram gyi dge bshes dang dpe cha pa rnams kyis rigs slong par rtsod pa'i grogs byed pa dang / mjug tu dge ba'i — 157 —
bshes gnyen zhig gis rtsod pa dge bsngo dang bcas dam bca'i mjug sgril par byed/ grol khar grwa tshang gis dhī skad gtong bzhin yar bzhengs nas zhwa mo bsnams te grol pa dang / skabs der rgyun par dgong mo'i dus tshod bcu gnyis dang phyed ka yas mas su thon yod/ tshes nyer drug nyin gyi dus tshod kyi bkod sgrig tshes nyer lnga dang 'dra/ tshes nyer drug nyin gyi snga dro'i dus tshod brgyad kyi rjes su sngar bzhin dge bskos kyis brda brgyab pa na dam bca' ba gnyis gzhung gsar 'dzin grwa'i nang du dam bcar phebs/ phyi dro'i dus tshod gnyis dang phyed dzo'i steng yar 'tshogs rjes dge bskos kyis brda bstan pa na dam bca' ba gnyis blo rig 'dzin grwa'i nang du dam bcar phebs/gung tshigs rjes kyi phyi dro'i dus tshod bzhi dang phyed ka yas mas su rtags rigs 'dzin grwa'i nang du phebs/ tshes nyer bdun nyin nyin sngon ma ltar dam bca' ba gnyis snga dror bsdus chen 'dzin grwa dang gung tshigs kyi sngon la bsdus 'bring 'dzin grwa/ gung tshigs kyi rjes su bsdus chung 'dzin grwar phebs nas dam bca' 'jog pa red/ tshes nyer brgyad nyin gyi dus tshod brgyad dang phyed ku'i rjes su dam bca' ba gnyis bka' rams 'dzin grwar phebs nas zhwa mo bsnams pa dang dbu mdzad kyis rgyal ba ma lus ma gsungs te ka ra gnam la gtor nas bka' bcu'i dam bca'i mjug sdud par byed/ lo bgres pa'am 'dzin grwa mtho ba'i dam bca' ba des tshes nyer brgyad nyin mang ja bskol pa dang gzhan cig shos des tshes nyer dgu'i nyin mang ja bskol nas 'gyed gtong ba red/ tshes nyer brgyad dang nyer dgu gnyis la 'dzin grwa gcig pa'i chos grogs dang grogs po rnams dam bca' ba gnyis kyi shag tu song nas dpa' dar 'bul pa dang / dpe cha dang gzan sham/ ja dang gos/ sil shog sna lnga dang sgor mo sogs ster pa red/ chos grogs rnams phyir phebs skabs sgo kha nas grwa ba lo chung gsum gyis rten 'brel du ja dang / zho dang / gro 'bras bcas yod pa'i dkar yol lag tu bzung nas ja bzhes/ zho bzhes/ 'bras bzhes zhes zer pa dang / chos grogs rnams kyis srin mdzub kyis mchod kha re 'phen par byed pa red/— 158 —

par 'gyur la/ de ltar na bsdus grwa slob 'dod kyi 'dun pa'ang je che nas je drag tu 'gro ba gdon mi za/ bsdus grwa'i slob khrid ni snyan ngag dang lo rgyus/ rtsom 'jug gi slob khrid dang 'dra bar bslab 'dod kyi 'dun pa che ba/ mnyan na yid 'gugs pa/ sun snang med par spro ba 'phel ba zhig ma yin pas dang thog nges par phal skad gtsor byas nas slob khrid bya dgos/ gong du bkod pa phal skad dang sbyar nas bshad na 'di ltar 'gyur te/ 99mi nyung shas shig gis kha dog yod tshad dmar po yin zhes khas blangs tshe/ 'o na 'dod pa de ltar na chos dung dkar po'i kha dog dmar po yin par 'gyur dgos te/ de kha dog yin pa'i cergyu mtshan gyis so/ /kha dog yod tshad dmar po yin zhes gong du khas blangs zin/ chos dung dkar po'i kha dog kha dog min zer na/ de kha dog yin pa ra 'gyur te/ dkar po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /〉〉 zhes pa lta bu/ 'di ltar phal skad gtsor byas nas slob khrid byas te slob ma rnams thal 'gyur gyi 'gros rim la blo cung zad goms rjes bsdus grwa'i rtsod stangs spyad nas slob khrid byas na legs/thal 'gyur gyi 'gros rim dang rigs lam gyi 'gro stangs/ tshad ma'i brda chad bcas la blo goms tshe phal skad dang sbyar nas 'chad pa la dgos pa med de/ de rnams blo la nges phyir phal skad dang sbyar — 161 —
nas 'chad pa yin/ slob grwa chen mor bsdus grwa ni slob skabs gnyis ring gi bslab bya yin la/bsdus chung khrid tshar nas bsdus 'bring rdzogs la nye yang da dung slob ma mang che bas thal 'gyur sla mo rnams la gan don mthun zhig kyang 'debs mi thub/ de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni dge rgan gyis dang thog thal 'gyur dang lan ji ltar 'debs tshul/ de dang 'brel yod kyi tshad ma'i brda chad rnams ma bshad par thad kur phan tshun rtsod pa'i tshul gyis slob khrid byas pa dang / yang na phal skad kho nas slob khrid byas te slob ma rnams thal 'gyur gyi 'gros rim dang rigs lam gyi 'gro stangs la blo goms par mi 'bad pa'i gnad 'di la thug pas dang thog phal skad dang sbyar nas slob khrid bya dgos pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis thal 'gyur gyi 'gros rim cung zad nges tshe/ phal skad spangs nas snga phyi rgol gnyis phan tshun rtsod pa'i tshul gyis slob khrid byas na thal 'gyur gyi 'gros rim dang rtags gsal 'phen tshul/ lan 'debs tshul rnams kyang rim bzhin rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /lnga ba/ snga phyi rgol gnyis phan tshun rtsod pa'i tshul gyis slob khrid bya dgos pa dang 'os 'tsham gyi rtsod pa'i dus shig kyang bkod sgrig bya dgos/bsdus grwa ni sum rtags/ dang snyan ngag lo rgyus sogs kyi bslab bya dang mi 'dra bar mgo nas mjug bar snga phyi rgol gnyis su phye ste phan tshun rtsod pa'i tshul gyis bkod yod de/ de'i gzhan lugs dgag pa dang rang lugs/ rtsod pa spong ba gang yin yang rtsod pa'i dgos mkho ltar bzhag pa zhig yin te/ gzhan lugs dgag pa ni gzhan pha rol bo'i yang dag ma yin pa'i rigs pa dang zhe 'dod sogs rtags sam sgrub byed yang dag bkod pa la brten nas 'gog par byed pa la bya zhing /rang lugs bzhag pa ni rang lugs kyi mtshan nyid dang mtshon bya/ dbye gzhi dang dbye chos/ don gcig ming gi rnam grangs dang khyab bya khyab byed/ yod med sogs kyi rnam gzhag ji bzhin du bkod pa la bya/ rtsod pa spong ba ni gzhan pha rol pos rang gi lugs la rgol ba byas tshe/ de la lan don — 168—
mthun nam gtan tshigs dang mthun pa'i sgo nas pha rol po'i yang dag ma yin pa'i rigs pa'i rgol ba'am gnod pa zlog par byed pa la bya ba yin pas de gsum gang yin yang snga phyi rgol gyi rtsod pa dang kha 'bral thabs med pa dang / de ni rtags sam sgrub byed bkod nas gzhan gyi lugs dgag cing rang lugs 'jog par byed pa'i gzhung zhig yin pas phan tshun rtsod pa'i tshul gyis slob khrid byas na dge rgan gyis 'chad bde ba dang slob mas cung rtogs sla ba zhig yin te/ dam bca' bas lan btab pa yang dag tu mthong tshe rigs slong pas rang nyid kyi rigs lam dang zhe 'dod yang dag ma yin pa rang thugs kyis nges 'gro ba dang / yang rigs slong pa'i rigs lam dang zhe 'dod yang dag tu mthong tshe dam bca' bas rang nyid kyi khas len dang zhe 'dod yang dag ma yin par nges te rigs slong pa'i zhe 'dod tshad mar 'dzin pa ma zad/ des bkod pa'i sgrub byed dang rigs lam gyi 'gro stangs rnams ji ma ji bzhin du blo ngor gsal por 'char zhing brjed dka 'a ba dang / rtsod pas ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gsum ldog par byed cing rig pa rgyas par byed pa dang rigs lam la byang bar byed pa/ gzhan yang 'chad pa'i kha lce je bde dang je myur du 'gro ba sogs rtsod pa la dge mtshan mang po ldan pas/ dge rgan gyis rtags gsal 'phangs nas slob ma rnams la lan gdab tu 'jug pa dang / kho tshor rtags gsal 'phen du bcug nas dge rgan gyis lan btab na slob mas thal 'gyur gyi 'gros rim dang rtags gsal ji ltar 'phen tshul/ lan ji ltar 'debs tshul rnams gsal bor rtogs par 'gyur bas dge rgan gyis snga phyi rgol gnyis phan tshun rtsod pa'i tshul gyis slob khrid byed dgos pa dang / slob ma rnams la ched du rtsod nga/'i dus shig kyang bkod sgrig byas te/ri kho tsho phan tshun bar rtsod pa byed du bcug nas slob thun steng du khrid zin pa'i rtsod skor dang sde tshan rnams la sbyangs pa legs po byed du 'jug pa dang / ma rtogs pa'i dka' gnad thams cad dge rgan la dris nas blo la nges par byas te bsdus gzhung la 'jug par byed pa ni slob grwar bsdus grwa sbyangs pa la med du mi rung ba'i mthun rkyen gal chen zhig yin no snyam du bdag gis sems so/ /— 169 —
drug pa/ slob mas dge rgan rgya slob khrid dang rtsod pa gnyis zung 'brel sgos bsdus grwa'i gzhung nges par bya dgos/mar khe si ring lugs kyi gzhung lugs nang du gzhung lugs dang lag len gnyis zung 'brel byed dgos pa bstan yod pa ltar/ slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma rnams kyis bsdus grwa slob pa'i skabs su/ dge rgan gyi slob khrid dang rtsod pa gnyis la brten nas bsdus grwa la sbyangs pa ni gzhung der 'jug pa'i thabs dam pa zhig yin te/ dge rgan gyi slob khrid kho na la brten nas sbyangs na bsdus grwa'i gzhung gi gzhan lugs dgag tshul dang lan 'debs tshul/ tha snyad rnams kyi don dang khyab che chung / mtshan mtshon gyi 'brel ba sogs cung zad nges na yang cung mtha' 'khyol pa'am dpyis phyin par rtogs mi nus pa dang / dge rgan gyi khrid ston la ma brten par rang sbyong dang rtsod pa'i las la zhugs pa kho nas de bas kyang bsdus grwa'i gzhung rtogs par mi 'gyur bas/ slob khrid byed pa'i skabs su dge rgan gyis bsdus grwa'i gzhung la dogs slong gang mang byas te slob ma'i blo sgo 'byed pa dang / slob mas bslabs zin pa'i rtsod skor dang sde tshan rnams gzhir byas nas rtsod pa byed pa dang / phan tshun rtsod pa'i go rim khrod thag gcod ma thub pa'i dka' gnad rnams slob thun gyi skabs dang yang na slob gseng gi dus su dge rgan la dris nas nges par byed pa dang / de nas yang mu mthud du rtsod pa'i las la zhugs nas slob thun gnyis ring la bslabs zin pa'i shes bya rnams nyin der shes su bcug na bsdus grwa'i gzhung yun gyis rtogs par 'gyur te/ dgon pa'i bsdus grwa'i slob khrid la mtshon na yang dge rgan gyis dogs slong dang blo sgo 'byed pa gtsor byas nas khrid pa na/ slob gnyer pa rnams kyis gtso bo chos grwar phan tshun bar rtsod pa byas pa la brten nas gzhung nges par byed pa dang / rtsis 'khor gyi slob khrid lta bu la mtshon na'ang dge rgan gyi slob khrid dang rtsis 'khor gyi lag len gnyis zung 'brel sgos sbyangs na shes sla ba las/ rtsis 'khor gyi slob — 170—
khrid la mnyan pa tsam dang yang na de'i lag len kho nas dpyis phyin pa zhig rtogs mi thub/ des na slob mas dge rgan gyi slob khrid dang rtsod pa'i las la zhugs pa gnyis zung 'brel sgos bsdus grwa'i gzhung la 'bad pas sbyangs na mi 'gyangs par bsdus grwa'i gzhung cung mtha' 'khyol pa zhig shes thub pa dang / de la brten nas gzhung gzhan sbyangs pa la'ang blo sgo chen po zhig 'byed nges yin/mdor na/ slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan rnams kyis slob ma rnams la thog mar bsdus grwa'i lo rgyus dang gzhung der 'jug pa'i dgos pa bshad pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa dang / de nas rang lugs dang rtags gsal rtsod gzhi gsum ngos 'dzin tshul/ thal 'gyur la lan ji ltar 'debs tshul rnams bslabs rjes/ phal skad dang sbyar nas gzhan lugs dgag pa sogs bshad de slob ma rnams thal 'gyur gyi 'gros rim dang tshad ma'i brda chad rnams la blo cung zad goms tshe/ dge rgan gyis snga phyi rgol gnyis phan tshun rtsod pa'i tshul gyis slob khrid byed pa dang / slob ma rnams la 'os 'tsham gyi rtsod pa'i dus shig kyang bkod sgrig byas te phan tshun rtsod du bcug nas slob khrid dang rtsod pa gnyis zung 'brel sgos bsdus grwa'i gzhung la 'jug par byas na/ slob ma rnams gzhung de la sun snang med par 'jug pa dang / slob khrid kyi 'bras bu'ang cung legs po zhig 'byung nges yin snyam/ 'di ni kho bos mtsho sngon slob gso slob gling du lo ngo gnyis ring la bsdus grwa khrid khul byas pa'i rang blo'i myong ba gzhir byas te bris pa yin yang / bdag blo dman zhing lta rgya chung ba/ bsdus grwa'i gzhung la byang cha med pas 'dir nor 'khrul gang mang zhig 'byung srid pas gzur gnas mkhas pa rnams kyis skyon brjod dang dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar mdzod cigzur lta'i dpyad yig/11 rje dmu dge bsam gtan/ blo gsal rigs sgo/khukhu mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1990 6(21 bse ngag dbang bkra shis/ bse bsdus grwa/khukhu mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 1998 3— 171 —
mi rigs slob grwa'i slob khrid thad kyi gnad don 'ga' gleng pa/de yang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros rim khrod du slob gsos go gnas gal chen zhig bzung yod pas rgyal khab dang dra rigs gang yin yang slob gso'i 'phel rgyas la mthong chen byas nas de la zhib 'jug dang bcos bsgyur gang mang byed bzhin yod/ de bzhin du nga tsho'i bod mi rigs kyi slob gso la mtshon na yang de la zhib 'jug dang bcos bsgyur gang legs byas te gong 'phel du gtong bar kun gyis 'bad kyin 'dug nga tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar mi rigs slob grwa ru gtso bo skad gang la brten nas slob khrid byed dgos pa'i thad la da bar du bgro gleng dang zhib 'jug mang po byas myong na yang / da lta da dung gcig mthun gyi lta tshul zhig byung med par mu mthud du rtsod gleng dang zhib 'jug byed bzhin yod/ de'i thad nas lta tshul gtso bo gnyis byung yod pa ni slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang po dang rnam pa rigs gnyis pa de gnyis red/ de'i dang po ni mi rigs slob grwa so so ru rgya'i skad yig dang dbyin ji gnyis las gzhan pa'i bslab bya rnams bod yig bod skad kyi lam nas 'khrid rgyu de yin zhing / rigs gnyis pa ni bod kyi skad yig dang dbyin ji las gzhan pa'i bslab bya rnams skad rigs gnyis pa ste rgya yig rgya skad kyi lam nas 'khrid rgyu de red/ de la kha cig gis mi rigs slob grwar slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs gnyis pa bkol na bod kyi slob ma rnams kyi rgya'i skad yig gi chu tshad je mthor 'gro bar phan pa dang / mtho 'bring mthar phyin skabs rgyal nang gi ming grags che ba'i slob grwa chen mo rnams su zhugs thub pa dang ched las kyang sna mang po las shin tu spro ba yod pa — 172 —
zhig bdam chog zer/ slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang po la brten nas skyed sring byas pa'i slob ma rnams kyi rgya'i skad yig gi chu tshad cung zad zhan pas slob mthar phyin nas bya ba 'tshol dus slob ma gzhan rnams kyi 'gran zla mi 'ong zer/ de la blo dman pa kho bos rang nyid kyi lta tshul 'ga' brjod 'dod de dpyad rtsom 'di nyid bris pa yin la/ gal te rtsom thung 'di'i nang du bden pa dang legs pa'i cha re gnyis bdog tshe de nyid bod kyi slob gso gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i rgyu zhig tu 'gyur bar smon/dang yo/ skad gang la brten nas slob khrid bya dgos tshul/skad cha ni mi phan tshun bar brda sprod byed kyi lag cha zhig yin zhing de la brten nas dge rgan gyis bslab bya'i gzhung rnams khrid ston dang slob mas 'bad pas sbyangs pa gnyis zung 'brel sgos gzhung don rnams rtogs par byed pa red/ nga tsho'i mi rigs slob grwa so so ru skad gang la brten nas slob khrid bya dgos pa 'di ni bod kyi slob gso'i slob khrid thad kyi gnad don gtso bo zhig yin te/bod yig bod skad la brten nas slob khrid byed pa'i rnam pa de la slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang po (beṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhatsho) zhes 'bod pa dang / rgya yig rgya skad kyi lam nas slob khrid byed pa'i rnam pa de la slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs gnyis pa ( khuṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭhatsha) zhes zer/① rigs de gnyis las gang rung zhig bdams rjes/ de la 'tsham pa'i slob deb kha tshang zhig dang de rnams khrid ston byed pa'i dge rgan gyi dpung sde nges can zhig dgos pas/ de gnyis dus tshod thung thung zhig gi nang du phan tshun brje thub pa zhig gtan nas min/ mtsho sngon sa khul la mtshon na slob khrid kyi rnam pa de gnyis ka bed spyod byed bzhin yod de/ mtsho lho dang rma lho bod rigs rang skyong khul gnyis kyis slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang po bkol bzhin yod pa dang / yul shul dang / mgo log mtsho byang / mtsho nub bcas bod rigs rang skyong khul bzhi yis rigs gnyis pa spyod bzhin yod/— 173 —
rigs de gnyis las don dngos su mi rigs slob grwa'i slob gso'i 'phel rgyas dang 'tsham pa gang red ce na/ pha skad la brten nas slob khrid byed pa'i rnam pa rigs dang po de yin te/ slob mas slob gnyer byed skabs skad cha'i thad nas bkag rgya med par bslab bya'i don rnams ji ma ji bzhin du rtogs thub pa red/rang rgyal du'ang pha skad kyi slob khrid la mthong chen byed bzhin yod de/spyir btang gi slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum gang yin yang rnam pa rigs dang po bed spyod byed bzhin yod pa las rigs gnyis pa dbyin ji'i skad la brten nas slob 0khrid byed kyin med pa nga tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar red/ da lta dbyin ji'i skad ni 'dzam gling gi spyi skad lta bur gyur yod pa dang /skad de legs po zhig shes na slob sbyong dang bya ba'i khrod du go skabs mang po yod pa tshang mas gleng bzhin yod na yang / rgyal nang du dbyin ji'i skad la brten nas slob khrid byed bzhin pa'i slob grwa ha cang nyung / ming grags che ba'i rgyal nang gi slob grwa chen mo ste pe cin slob grwa chen mo dang chen hwa slob grwa chen mo/ h+phu dan slob grwa chen mo sogs nas slob ma rnams mthar phyin rjes phyi rgyal du slob gnyer byed du 'gro mkhan mang na yang / slob chen de dag tu rgya yig rgya skad la brten nas slob khrid byed pa las dbyin ji'i lam nas slob khrid byed kyin med pa ma zad/ thog mar phyi gling du byung zhing dar pa'i rig gzhung tshan khag mi'i rigs rig pa dang spyi tshogs rig pa sogs kyi bslab bya rnams khrid dus khungs gtugs sa ni dbyin ji'i dpe cha rnams yin na yang gzhung lugs de rnams kyang rgya yig rgya skad la brten nas 'khrid bzhin yod/phyi'i rgyal khab so sor slob gnyer byed bzhin pa'i rang rgyal gyi slob ma rnams la mtshon na yang slob sbyong khrod kyi dka' khag gtso bo ni skad cha'i thad kyi bkag rgya de yin/ kho tshos slob chung gi lo rim gsum pa bzhi pa nas bzung dbyin ji'i skad la sbyangs mgo brtsams pa dang / slob grwa chen mo mthar phyin dus dbyin ji'i skad la sbyangs nas nyung mtha' yang lo ngo bcu gsum tsam 'gor zin/de'i rjes su phyi rgyal du song nas lo ngo gnyis nas gsum tsam la slob gnyer byas pa'i dbang du btang — 174—
na bsdoms pas lo ngo bco lnga tsam la dbyin yig sbyangs zin na yang da dung slob khrid kyi skabs su ha mi ko ba'i gnas tshul yod/phyi'i rgyal khab tu yang slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang por mthong chen byas te slob ma'i pha skad gang yin pa de 'i lam nas slob khrid byed bzhin yod de/ dper na/ yo rob gling gi byang phyogs su yod pa'i h+phin lan rgyal khab tu si be tin ( phrin lan gyi khyim mtshes rgyal khab cig yin ) gyi skad bshad mkhan gyi mi grangs kyis h+phin lan rgyal khab spyi'i mi grangs kyi brgya cha'i drug ma gtogs zin med na yang grong sde dang grong rdal/ grong khyer so sor ched du si be tin gyi slob chung dang slob 'bring /slob grwa chen mo rnams btsugs yod pa dang / slob grwa de dag tu h+phin lan gyi skad dang dbyin ji'i skad las gzhan pa'i bslab bya thams cad si be tin gyi skad la brten nas slob khrid byed bzhin yod/da dung h+phin lan du grangs nyung mi rigs shig yod pa de la sa me'i mi ( byayong 930913 ) zhes 'bod pa dang de'i mi grangs sum khri lhag ma gtogs med na yang / kho tsho la sa me'i skad kyi slob grwa zur du btsugs te bslab bya rnams las lo rgyus dang sa rgyus rnams sa me'i skad kyis 'khrid bzhin yod pa dang / gzhan rnams sa me'i skad kyi dge rgan med pa'i rkyen gyis h+phin lan skad kyis slob khrid byed bzhin yod/ der ma zad sa me'i slob ma rnams slob grwa chen mor zhugs dus sa me skad kyis rgyugs sprad chog zer/② de las gzhan da dung rgyal spyi'i slob grwa'am dbyin ji'i slob grwa so sos slob chung gi slob ma sdud len byed skabs dbyin ji'i bu bcol khang du zhugs myong min dang khyim du dbyin skad bshad kyin yod med gsal bor 'dri ba dang / gal te khyim du dbyin skad bshad kyin med pa dang yang na dbyin skad kyi kha rgyugs blangs nas rgyugs ma 'phrod tshe slob grwa der zhugs mi thub/ gong gi dper brjod 'di rnams las nga tshos rgyal nang dang phyi rgyal gyi slob grwa gang yin yang pha skad kyi lam nas slob khrid byed pa'i rnam pa rigs dang po de gtso bor 'dzin bzhin yod pa shes thub la/ pha skad kyis slob gso'i khrod du go gnas gal chen zhig bzung yod pa'ang rtogs thu ba/ de'i phyir nga tsho'i mi — 175 —
rigs slob grwa rnams su yang slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang po bkol nas slob khrid bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che bar mthong zhing / slob mas rang gi pha skad la brten nas slob sbyong byas tshe skad cha'i thad nas bkag rgya ci yang med par cung gting zab pa'i sgo nas bslab bya rnams kyi don rtogs thub /de bzhin du slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs gnyis pa bed spyod byed mi 'os pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/mtsho sngon lta bu la mtshon na/ bod kyi slob ma rnams ni rong 'brog sa khul nas yong ba dang chung dus nas khyim du rgya skad bshad kyin med pas slob chung du zhugs rjes rgya yig rgya skad la brten nas slob gso myong ba ni nor 'khrul tshabs chen zhig yin/ dper na rtsis rig slob thun gyi skabs su slob ma rnams kyis gru bzhi nar mo (ṭha༅) dang skas dbyibs (/lkotsho) la sogs pa'i rgya yig gi tha snyad rnams kyi don ma go ba'i gnas tshul 'byung ba des skabs bab kyi rtsis gzhi rnams bde blag tu rtogs par gegs byed pa yin te/ gnas tshul de ni rgya'i slob ma zhig slob chung nas bzung dbyin ji'i slob grwar zhugs te rgya yig las gzhan pa'i bslab bya rnams dbyin skad kyi lam nas slob bzhin pa dang phal cher 'dra ste/ slob ma ci 'dra'i blo rno ba zhig yin na yang dbyin skad kyi bkag rgya'i dbang gis skabs bab kyi bslab bya'i don rnams ji bzhin du rtogs mi thub pa'i gnas tshul 'byung srid/ des na slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang po ni nga tsho'i mi rigs slob grwa so so ru nges par bed spyod bya dgos pa'i slob khrid kyi rnam pa zhig yin zhing / pha skad la brten nas slob khrid byas na da gzod mi rigs slob gso'i 'phel rgyas kyi mdun lam je yangs nas je yangs su 'gro nges yin /gnyis pa/ rgya'i skad yig gi slob khrid kyi gnad don/gong du gleng zin pa ltar kha cig gis mi rigs slob grwa so sos slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs gnyis pa bed spyod byas na bod kyi slob ma rnams kyi rgya'i skad yig gi chu tshad je mthor 'gro bar phan pa dang /slob mthar phyin rjes rgyal nang gi slob grwa chen mo ming grags can rnams su zhugs thub par 'dod — 176—
pa'i lta tshul de ni phyogs gcig la bsam blo btang ste phyogs gzhan dag la bsam blo ma btang ba'i skyon yod snyam ste/ des slob ma zhig gi skad rigs gnyis pa'i chu tshad je mthor 'gro bar mthong chen byas pa dang chabs cig skad cha'i thad nas bkag rgya yod pa'i gnad don de snang med du bzhag pa red/ bod kyi slob ma rnams kyis chung dus nas rgya yig rgya skad la brten nas slob sbyong byas na yang rgya'i slob ma rnams dang 'gran dka' ste/ rang gi pha skad ma yin pa'i skad rigs gnyis pa la brten nas slob sbyong bya dgos pas slob khrid kyi skad cha'i thad nas bkag rgya nges can zhig yod/ yang phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na mi zhig gi skad rigs gnyis pa'i chu tshad zhan pa ni rgyun ldan gyi snang tshul zhig yin te/ dper na rgyal nang gi slob grwa chen mo ming grags can rnams las mthar phyin pa'i slob ma rnams kyi khrod du dbyin ji'i chu tshad ha cang zhan pa'i slob ma mang po zhig yod pa dang / slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan rnams las kyang dbyin ji'i skad legs po mi shes pa'i dge rgan mang po zhig yod pa nga tshos shes gsal ltar red/ de bzhin du rgya'i skad yig ni nga tsho'i bod kyi slob ma rnams la mtshon na skad rigs gnyis pa yin la de legs po zhig sbyang rgyu ni las sla mo zhig ma yin pa'i khar/rgya'i skad yig gi dge rgan rnams kyis skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid byed thabs spyad nas slob khrid byed mkhan ha cang nyung ste/ mtsho sngon dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i mi rigs dge thon slob gling gi rgya'i skad yig gi dge rgan zhig mtsho lho khul khri ka rjong gi mi rigs slob grwa chung 'bring 'gar song nas rgya'i skad yig gi dge rgan sum cu lhag la kha brda byas nas skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid byed thabs bed spyod byed kyin yod med dris tshe/ de'i nang nas skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid byed thabs ha ko ba'i dge rgan re gnyis las mi 'dug zer/① de ni mi rigs slob grwa so so'i rgya'i skad yig gi slob khrid thad kyi gnad don gtso bo zhig yin la/ bod kyi slob ma rnams kyi rgya'i skad yig gi chu tshad cung zhan pa yang gtso bo gnad don de la thug yod snyam/rgya'i skad yig gi dge rgan rnams kyis bod kyi slob ma rnams la slob khrid byed dus rgya rigs kyi — 171—
slob ma rnams dang 'dra ba'i slob khrid byed thabs spyod mi 'os te/ rgya'i slob ma rnams la mtshon na rgya yig ni kho tsho'i pha skad yin pas chung dus nas khyim tshang gi slob gso'i khrod du pha ma gnyis las rgya skad dang rgya'i skad yig gi tha snyad mi nyung ba zhig bslabs zin par ma zad/ de dag gi bkol tshul dang tshig sbyor gyi 'gro stangs/ skad cha bshad stangs sogs snga mo nas shes yod pas tha snyad mang po zhig dang tshig mang po zhig gi don re re bzhin bshad mi dgos/ yin na yang bod kyi slob ma rnams la tha snyad re re dang tshig re re bzhin 'khrid dgos par ma zad/ skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid byed thabs bkol nas slob khrid bya dgos/ de dpe'i sgo nas cung zad bshad na/ lag brda dang 'dra par/ ri mo sogs bkol nas tha snyad sogs kyi don 'chad pa lta bu ste/ skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid kyi khrod du mthon po'i don bshad dus lag pa yar bkyags nas mthon po'i rnam 'gyur bstan te brda sprod par byed pa dang / sil tog kham bu'i don bshad dus 'dra par ram yang na ri mo la brten nas de'i don slob ma rnams la shes su 'jug pa/ grang ngar lta bu'i don 'chad dus lus po cung zad sgur ba'i tshul gyis lag pas dpung ba gnyis la 'jus nas lus cung zad 'dar nas grang ngar che ba'i don de rnam 'gyur dang tshugs ka la brten nas slob ma rnams la shes su 'jug dgos pa lta bu/ gzhan da dung slob khrid kyi skabs su dge rgan kho nas khrid ston byas te dus 'da' bar mi byed par nges par slob ma rnams la go skabs byin te rgya skad sbyong brdar byed du 'jug dgos shing / sbyong brdar gyi khrod du dge rgan gyis slob ma'i sgra gdangs mi dag pa dang bshad tshul nor ba rnams la dag bcos byed dgos/de la kha cig gis de ltar byas na rgya yig sbyangs pa las rgya skad bslab rgyu gtso bor bzung ba red ces bshad srid kyang rgya yig sbyangs pa la thog mar rgya skad shes dgos te/ rgya'i slob ma dang bod kyi slob ma gnyis kyis rgya'i skad yig sbyong mgo rtsom pa'i tshe na khyad par gtso bo ni gcig gis rgya skad bshad shes pa dang cig shos kyis bshad mi shes pa de ma yin nam/ de'i rkyen gyis phyi gling pa rnams — 178—
kyis rgya'i skad yig sbyong ba'i skabs su thog mar skad cha gtso bor bzung nas sbyangs pa dang / kho tshor ched du bsgrigs pa'i slob deb kyi nang du kha brda'i skor mang bo bkod yod pa yang rgyu mtshan de la thug yod/ rgya skad legs po zhig sbyangs te de'i 'chad mnyan gnyis la cung byang bar gyur tshe rgya yig gi sgra gdangs rnams dag par bklag thub pa dang / nyin tho dang rtsom thung sogs 'bri dus rgya skad ji ltar bshad pa nang bzhin yig thog tu 'god chog pas slob ma'i rgya'i skad yig gi chu tshad je mthor 'gro bar thad kur 'brel ba dam po yod/ 'di las nga tshos shes thub pa ni bod kyi slob ma rnams la rgya'i skad yig 'khrid dus skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid byed thabs spyod dgos pa dang / rgya skad bshad shes pa'i thog ma'i cha rkyen la brten nas rgya yig la legs par sbyang na cung shes sla bas slob mas pha skad la brten nas slob sbyong byed pa'i go rim khrod du rgya'i skad yig gi chu tshad je mthor 'gro thub kyin med pa ni gtso bo de'i slob khrid byed thabs la thug yod snyam/gsum pa/ dbyin ji'i slob khrid thad kyi gnad don/dbyin ji'i skad ni 'dzam gling du ches gal che ba'i skad rigs gtso bo zhig yin pa ma zad/ da lta 'dzam gling gi spyi skad lta bur gyur yod pas rgyal khab mang po zhig tu de nyid skad rigs gnyis par bzung nas slob khrid dang slob gnyer byed bzhin yod la/ rgyal nang du yang dbyin ji'i skad ni skad rigs gnyis pa'am phyi skad rnams kyi gtso bor 'dzin bzhin yod pa kun gyis shes gsal ltar red/ nga tsho'i mi rigs slob grwa so so ru'ang dbyin ji'i skad kyi slob khrid bkod sgrig byas te slob khrid byed bzhin yod mod/ yin na yang dge rgan dang slob ma su yin yang dbyin ji'i slob khrid gtso bor mi 'dzin pa dang / de ni bslab bya phal ba zhig tu brtsis nas slob sbyong dang slob khrid byed bzhin yod pa ni gtso bo slob grwa chen mor rgyugs sprod pa'i skabs su dbyin ji'i skar grangs bsdoms skar gyi nang du mi 'dus pa'i rkyen gyis red/ da dung dbyin ji'i slob khrid la gnad don zhig yod pa ni mi — 179—
rigs slob grwa so so'i dbyin ji'i dge rgan mang che shos kyis bod yig bod skad mi shes pa dang /slob khrid kyi skabs su dbyin skad kyi lam nas slob khrid mi byed par slob tshan gyi nang don dang brda sprod sogs rgya yig dang rgya skad la brten nas slob khrid byed bzhin yod pa ni nor 'khrul gyi slob khrid byed thabs shig yin te/ dbyin ji'i skad ni bod rigs slob ma rnams la mtshon na skad rigs gsum pa yin la/ de nyid skad rigs gnyis pa la brten nas slob khrid byas tshe slob ma rnams kyis dbyin ji'i skad shes par bkag rgya nges can zhig thebs bzhin yod de/ slob ma rnams kyi rgya'i skad yig gi chu tshad cung zad zhan pas rgya'i skad yig gi brda sprod skor gyi tha snyad rnams kyi don gsal bor rtogs mi thub pa dang / rgya yig tu bsgyur zin pa'i tshig rnams la go ba gting zab mo zhig lon mi thub pa'i gnas tshul yang 'byung srid/ de ni dper na rgyal nang gi spyir btang gi slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum rnams su skad rigs gsum pa ste nyi hong gi skad la sbyang dgos pa'i dbang du btang na/ nyi hong gi skad de dbyin ji'i skad la brten nas khrid pa dang phal cher 'dra ste/ de ni nyi hong gi skad rgya skad kyi lam nas 'khrid pa las ldab 'gyur gyis rtogs dka' bar 'gyur ba nga tshos bsam blo btang na shes thub/ de'i phyir nga tsho'i mi rigs slob grwa'i dbyin ji'i dge rgan rnams kyis nges par bod skad shes dgos pa dang bod yig shes na de las lhag par slob ma rnams kyis dbyin ji'i skad sbyong ba la phan thogs mi nyung ba zhig yod/ der ma zad dbyin ji'i skad dang bod kyi skad yig gnyis la 'dra sa cung mang bas bod kyi slob ma rnams la mtshon na dbyin ji'i skad cung zad sbyang sla ste/skad de gnyis gang yin yang sgra sbyor gyi yi ge yin pa dang dus gsum gyi skabs su las tshig gi gzugs mi 'dra ba/ sgra gdangs la 'dra sa mang bas dbyin ji'i tha snyad dang tshig brda sprod rnams bod skad kyi lam nas bshad na slob mas go sla ba dang / dge rgan gyis tha snyad rnams kyi don ci yin 'dri dus slob mas dbyin skad dang rgya skad kyis de'i rnams kyi don bshad mi shes kyang bod skad kyi lam nas bshad thub pa'i gnas tshul yod/ de bzhin du slob ma rnams la dri ba yod dus thad kur — 180—
bod skad kyi lam nas dris chog pa dang / dge rgan gyis kyang bod skad la brten nas dbyin ji'i tha snyad dang tshig rnams kyi don ga sal bor bshad chog yin na yang slob khrid kyi skabs su dge rgan gyis dbyin skad mang po bshad de dus 'da' bar mi byed par slob ma gsum nas lnga re tsho chung rer bgos nas phan tshun bar kha brda byed du 'jug rgyu gal che/ gzhan du na slob ma rnams kyi dbyin ji'i kha skad je legs su 'gro dka'/: da dung ri mo can gyi shog lhe re gnyis byin te slob ma rnams la de dang 'brel yod kyi dri ba rnams la lan gdab tu bcug na slob ma'i dbyin skad kyi chu tshad je mthor 'gro bar sman par ma zad/ dbyin ji sbyong ba'i spro ba bskyed par phan thogs nges can zhig yod/rgyal nang gi slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum rnams kyis kyang dbyin ji'i dge rgan 'tshol dus dbyin yig gi chu tshad cung mtho ba dang dbyin skad legs po zhig bshad shes pa tsam gyis mi chog par rgya yig rgya skad cung shes dgos pa'i re ba 'don bzhin yod pa yang rgyu mtshan de la thug yod pa dang /h+phin lan rgyal khab lta bur mtshon na yang slob grwa so sos dbyin ji'i dge rgan dang h+pha ran si'i skad kyi dge rgan/ 'jar man skad kyi dge rgan sogs sdud len byed dus h+phin lan gyi skad bshad ma shes tshe dge rgan gyi gras su sdud len mi byed pa red/ des na mi rigs slob grwa'i dbyin ji'i dge rgan rnams kyis nges par bod skad bshad shes dgos shing / bod skad bod yig gi ram 'degs la brten nas dbyin ji'i skad 'khrid na da gzod slob ma rnams kyis dbyin ji'i skad shes skyen pa red/mdor na/ bod kyi slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum du bod yig bod skad la brten pa'i slob khrid kyi rnam pa rigs dang po de bed spyod bya dgos shing / skad rigs gnyis pa'i slob khrid byed thabs spyad de bod kyi slob ma rnams la rgya'i skad yig 'khrid rgyu shin tu gal che ba dang / dbyin ji'i dge rgan rnams kyis nges par bod skad bshad shes dgos pa dang / bod yig legs po zhig shes na dbyin ji'i slob khrid la ram 'degs chen po zhig byed thub pas nga tsho tshang mas stobs shugs gcig sgril sgos mi rigs slob gso'i slob khrid thad kyi gnad don 'di dag thag gcod par 'bad 'bungs bya dgos/ /— 181 —
mchan 'grel/(7 nyis stong brgyad lo'i zla bdun par zi ling du bsdus pa'i skabs dang po'i mtsho lho'i slob gso'i gleng stegs kyi 〈ched las mkhas pa'i bsam 'char bsdu len gyi zin tho〉 ru gsal/① nyis stong brgyad lo'i zla drug pa'i tshes bcu dgu nyin smrin lan had 'od gser mkhar slob grwa chen mo'i ya h+phe zhib 'jug gling gi skad brda rig pa'i dge rgan chen mo yo ha yan ho nan (5lo2 )tshomakhrungs) la glog rdul yig sgam brgyud nas h+phin lan rgyal khab kyi slob gso'i gnas tshul dris pa 'dir bkod pa yin/① nyis stong brgyad lo'i zla bdun par zi ling du bsdus pa'i skabs dang bo'i mtsho lho'i slob gso'i gleng stegs kyi gros tshogs steng du bshad pa red/— 187—
phyisgrung gi slob grwa chen mo'i slob khrid byed thabs dang de'i dge can skor cung zad gleng pa/spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros shin tu mgyogs shing brda 'phrin dus rabs su skyod bzhin pa'i deng gi dus 'dir/ 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab so so'i spyi tshogs dang dpal 'byor / rig gnas dang slob gso bcas phyogs gang thad nas gong bu gcig gyur gyi lam du 'gro bzhin yod na yang / mi rigs mi 'dra ba'i rgyal khab re re la rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi re dang /yul srol goms 'dris re yod pa de la brten nas rgyal khab gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i slob gso'i ma lag re chags yod/ slob grwa'i slob gso la cha mtshon nas bshad na rgyal khab gang yin yang slob grwa so so'i slob gso'i dmigs yul gtso bo ni spyi tshogs la mkho ba'i shes ldan mi sna skyed sring bya rgyu de yin la/ de la yang tshad ldan gyi dge rgan dang slob deb legs po rnams yod pa tsam gyis mi chog par slob khrid byed thabs 'os 'tsham zhig la brten nas rig gzhung tshan khag so so'i gzhung don rnams slob ma rnams kyi blo la nges su 'jug rgyu ha cang gal che/ de'i thad nas col chung kho bos a me ri kha'i slob grwa chen mo re gnyis na slob sbyong byed bzhin pa dang slob mthar phyin zin pa'i grogs po 'ga' yod pa dang lab gleng byas shing / rang nyid kyis kyang yo rob gling gi h+phin lan rgyal khab kyi had 'od gser mkhar slob grwa chen mo ru lo ngo gsum ring la slob gnyer byas pa la brten nas myong tshor zab mo zhig thob pa ni phyi rgyal gyi spyi tshogs tshan rig gi slob khrid byed thabs de rang rgyal gyi slob grwa chen mo dang bsdur na khyad par cung zad che ba de yin/ de yang phyi gling gi slob grwa chen mo rnams su gtso bo ni — 183 —
tshogs 'du'i rnam pa can gyi slob khrid dang bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid/ slob ma'i khrid stegs steng gi 'chad ston bcas la brten nas dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la mdzub ston byas te dpe cha gang mang bklag tu 'jug pa dang / gros bsdur dang rtsad bsdur/ dri ba dris lan dang 'chad ston gyi sbyong brdar bcas byed du 'jug pa dang chabs cig slob ma'i rgyu cha 'tshol sdud kyi nus pa dang rig gzhung zhib 'jug gi nus pa/ smra brjod gtam bshad kyi nus pa sogs phyogs gang thad nas skyed sring byed bzhin yod pas 'dir de'i skor cung zad gleng khul byas na nga tsho'i mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i slob khrid byed thabs legs bcos byed par phan yang srid snyam pa'i kun slong dang bcas mtshams sbyor cung zad bya'o/ /dang po/ tshogs 'du'i rnam pa can gyi slob khrid la brten nas slob ma'i shes rgya cher bskyed pa/tshogs 'du'i rnam pa can gyi slob khrid byed thabs (90nga canga'ang00 5po/ca) ni 'dzin grwa rer slob ma brgyad nas nyi shu ma gtogs med pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis dge rgan gyi slob khrid 'char gzhi'i gnad bsdus ltar dpe cha bklags pa rnams slob thun gyi skabs su dge rgan dang rang gi slob grogs phan tshun bar gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan gyi lam nas rtsom pa po'i lta ba gtso bo rnams la rtsad bsdur byas te gting zab pa'i sgo nas blo la nges par byed pa ste/ slob khang gi cog tse sgrig stangs kyang tshogs 'du khang dang 'dra bar dbyibs sgor mo'i tshul du bsgrigs yod/phyi gling gi slob grwa chen mo'i dge rgan rnams kyis slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi gnad bsdus (5sto//zung55) bris pa zhib cha ha cang che ste/ slob skabs gcig la bsdoms pas slob thun ci tsam yod pa dang / slob thun re rer 'khrid rgyu'i le'u dang tshan pa rnams gsal bor bkod yod par ma zad/slob thun re re'i skabs su blta dgos pa'i dpe cha dang le'u re re'i ming / dpe cha de dag dpe mdzod khang gang du g.yor rgyu yod pa dang dpe khang gang du btsong rgyu yod pa/ yang na gnas gzhan — 184—
gang du yod pa dang gang nas de rnams bskyar dpar byas chog pa/ da dung slob skabs hril bo'i nang du las bya ci tsam bgo rgyu dang dpyad rtsom thung ngu ci tsam bri dgos pa/slob khrid skabs kyi sgrig lam/slob mjug gi rgyugs ji ltar len tshul dang rgyugs len pa'i dus tshod dang sa gnas sogs gsal bor bkod yod/ slob mgo tshugs ma thag dge rgan gyis slob ma re re la slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi gnad bsdus re ster pa dang slob ma rnams kyis de gzhir bzung nas slob khrid la gra sgrig dang slob stong la 'bad brtson byed pa red/ slob khrid la zhugs pa'i skabs su slob mas bklag dgos pa'i dpe cha dang le'u mang nyung ni gza' 'khor rer dpe cha gcig dang yang na le'u 'ga' re yin la/shog grangs mang nyung gi thad nas gza' 'khor rer shog ngos bzhi bcu lnga bcu nas brgya yan chad bklag dgos pa dang / de ni bslab bya gcig gi dpe klog gi tshad gzhi red/ slob ma rnams kyis nam rgyun khom skabs yod tshad bed spyad nas dpe mdzod khang dang yang na rang gi nyal khang ( rgyun par slob ma gnyis nas gsum mal khang gcig tu bsdad yod pa dang de'i nang du slob ma rer khang mig gcig re yod) du dpe char blta ba dang / de la dpe klog gi las bya (5977/nga8455/697674) zhes 'bod/ slob ma rnams slob khrid la ma zhugs gong du bklag bya'i dpe cha dang le'u rnams la nges par bltas tshar dgos pa dang / slob thun gyi skabs su dge rgan gyis gang 'khrid rgyu'i le'u dang tshan pa de mgo nas mjug bar kha tshang du slob khrid mi byed par dka' gnad kyi skon gtso bor bzung nas slob ma rnams la gros bsdur cung zad byed du bcug rjes/ dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la dri ba dris nas lan gdab tu 'jug pa dang dris lan kha tshang min tshe dge rgan gyis slob thun grol la nye ba'i skabs su kha gsab kyi tshul du dri ba rnams la lan 'debs pa'am yang na rang gi lta tshul brjod pa red/ de ltar dge rgan gyis slob mar bklag bya'i dpe cha mang po bkod sgrig byed pa dang slob mas de rnams bklags pa la brten nas gang bslab par bya ba'i rig gzhung tshan khag de'i skor gyi shes rgya cher bskyed pa dang / dpe cha bklags tshar rjes de'i nang don dang gzhung lugs kyi gnad don zhig — 185 —
gzhir bzung nas dpyad rtsom thung ngu re 'bri ru 'jug dpyad rtsom de ni rgyun par gza' 'khor gsum dang bzhi'i nang du bris tshar dgos pa dang shog ngos lnga nas drug longs dgos pa dang / slob skabs gcig gi nang du nyung mtha' yang dpyad rtsom thung ngu bzhi nas lnga bri dgos/ slob mjug gi rgyugs la dpyad rtsom shog ngos bcu longs pa zhig bri dgos pa dang de nī khrid zin pa'i gnad don zhig la dmigs nas dpe cha gzhan rnams la zur lta byas te bri dgos/slob thun re re'i slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi gnad bsdus ltar dge rgan gyis slob khrid kyi skabs su dpe cha de'i rtsom pa po ngo sprod rags tsam byas rjes slob ma rnams la bslab bya'i gzhung lugs kyi thad nas dri ba 'ga' dris nas lan gdab tu 'jug pa dang / yang na slob ma phan tshun bar gros bsdur byed du bcug nas bltas zin pa'i dpe cha dang le'u re re'i nang gi rtsom pa po'i lta ba gtso bo rnams blo la nges par byed pa dang / dri ba dris lan dang gros bsdur/ dogs slong byed pa bcas kyi thabs lam la brten nas slob khrid kyi mjug rdzogs par byed/ yang dge rgan la las slob thun dang po'i skabs su dpe cha'i rtsom pa po dang khong tsho'i lta ba rnams ngo sprod rags tsam byas rjes/ slob ma so so'i re 'dod ltar slob thun gang gi skabs su gros bsdur gyi mgo 'dzin pa ( khu/50555/07 667769) bya rgyu yin pa thag gcod nges red/ slob thun rjes ma nas bzung dge rgan gyis rtsom pa po dang de'i lta ba gtso bo ngo sprod tsam byas rjes/ slob thun re re'i mgo 'dzin pas slob grogs rnams la mdzub ston byas te bklags zin pa'i dpe cha'i nang don la gros bsdur byed du 'jug pa red/ de yang thog mar mgo 'dzin pas bltas zin pa'i dpe cha dang le'u rnams las khyab rgya cung che ba'i dri ba drug tsam gra sgrig byas te thad kur slob grogs rnams la dri ba 'phangs nas lan gdab tu 'jug pa dang dri ba rnams la gros bsdur byed du 'jug cing / skabs 'gar gnas tshul dang bstun nas thog mar slob ma gnyis re'i bar dri ba rnams la skar ma lnga nas bcu tsam la gros bsdur byed du bcug rjes slob ma yongs la lan gdab tu 'jug pa red/— 186—
nga tsho tshang mas shes gsal ltar dpe cha mang bor blta ba ni slob ma'i shes rgya cher bskyed pa'i thabs lam gtso bo zhig yin par ma zad/ dge rgan gyi slob khrid la'ang ram 'degs kyi nus pa nges can zhig thon bzhin yod de/ slob khrid ma byas gong du slob mas dpe cha las 'khrid rgyu'i tshan pa de zhib tu thengs gcig la bklags tshe/ slob ma'i sems su gang 'khrid rgyu'i tshan pa der cha rgyus gsal bo zhig yod par 'gyur bas/ dge rgan gyis mgo nas mjug bar du re re bzhin slob ma rnams la gros bsdur byed du 'jug mi dgos par dka' gnad kyi skor gcig pu la gros bsdur byed du bcug chog pa dang / slob mas dpe cha bklags pa la brten nas slob khrid kyi skabs su dge rgan gyis 'phangs pa'i dri ba rnams la kha tshang zhing cung gting zab pa'i sgo nas lan 'debs thub pa dang / gros bsdur byed pa'i tshe na yang dka' gnad dang dri ba rnams la bsam blo zhib tu btang nas rang gi lta tshul re brjod thub pa yin pas slob mas dpe cha bklags pa des dge rgan gyi slob khrid la ram 'degs kyi nus pa nges can zhig thon bzhin yod/ slob ma rnams la mtshon na yang dpe char blta ba'i skabs su ma nges pa dang dogs pa yod pa rnams slob khrid kyi skabs su gros bsdur byas chog pa dang / slob khrid kyi skabs su da dung ma nges pa rnams zhor du dge rgan la dris nas shes su bcug chog skabs 'gar dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la 'khrid gzhi dang 'brel ba'i dpe cha re 'ga' bklag tu bcug ste/ gza' 'khor 'ga'i rjes su slob ma re res res mos sgos ( 'dzin grwa rer slob ma 8 nas 10 bar ma gtogs med ) rang rang gis bltas pa'i dpe cha'i le'u re gnyis kyi nang don gnad bsdus shig slob thun gyi skabs su slob ma gzhan rnams la bshad du bcug pa la brten nas tshang mas dpe cha'i le'u de rnams la ma bltas kyang de dag gi nang don gnad bsdus shig blo la nges 'gro/ gzhan yang dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams kyis slob khrid kyi skabs su dri bar lan btab pa dang gros bsdur byas pa las slob mas dpe cha zhib tu bklags yod med gsal bor shes thub/ de ltar dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la dpe cha mang po bklag tu 'jug par ma zad/ gros bsdur dang rtsad bsdur/ dri bar lan — 187 —
'debs pa bcas kyi sbyong brdar khrod du zhugs su bcug pa la brten nas kho tsho'i bslab bya'i gzhung lugs kyi shes rgya cher bskyed pa red/gnyis pa/ bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid la brten nas slob ma'i zhib 'jug gi nus pa skyed sring byed pa/h+phin lan rgyal khab kyi slob grwa chen mo'i bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid ( 5'kho nga'ang ) ni gtso bo slob mas zhib 'jug byed pa dang dpyad rtsom 'bri bar mdzub ston byed pa'i slob khrid cig yin te/ thog mar dge rgan gyis slob ma re re la rang nyid spro ba yod pa'i gnad don dang de'i skor gyi dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/ zhib 'jug gi 'char gzhi sogs ngo sprod byed du bcug rjes/ slob ma'i re 'dod ltar slob ma 'ga' rer slob thun re bkod sgrig byas te rang nyid kyis zhib 'jug gi 'char gzhi ste dpyad rtsom gyi kha byang dang gleng gzhi/ de'i skor gyi rgyu cha bcas shog ngos gnyis tsam longs/ pa re bris nas dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams la re re byin te gsal bor bshad dgos pa dang / de nas slob grogs rnams kyis zhib 'jug gi 'char gzhi bri mkhan la dogs slong gi dri ba 'phen pa dang dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gzhan 'don sprod byed pa/ dpyad rtsom de ji ltar bris na legs tshul skor gyi bsam tshul 'don pa bcas byas nas dpyad rtsom bri bar mthun rkyen bskrun pa red/de ltar slob ma rnams kyi zhib 'jug gi 'char gzhi rnams re re bzhin gros bsdur byas rjes/ca༄ ṭ+wās mis sngar ga.ir+sā r+sā' 4/ re rer slob gun re brkod sgrig byas nas thengs gnyis pa'i mgo rtsom pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis rang gi dpyad rtsom gyi dkar chag dang de'i le'u rnams gsal ༄ra bgos nas le'u re re'i nang du gtso bor ci zhig bri rgyu dang de ji ltar bri rgyu dang / rang gi lta tshul gtso bo ci yin pa rnams gsal bor bris nas dpyad rtsom gyi 'char gzhi shog ngos lnga tsam longs pa zhig gza' 'khor gcig gi sngon la rang gi dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams la ster pa dang yang na nyin — 188—
gnyis gsum tsam gyi sngon du glog rdul yig sgam brgyud nas dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams la bskur dgos/ 'di'i skabs su slob ma re la rang gi snga rgol pa (0990bcang ) re yod la/ de ni dri ba 'don mkhan dang bsam 'char dang lta tshul 'don mkhan gtso bo yin zhing / thog mar slob ma rang nyid kyis dpyad rtsom gyi kha byang dang de'i le'u re re ngo sprod rags tsam byas rjes/ snga rgol pa sa dri ba 'phen pa dang yang na bsam 'char dang lta tshul 'don pa red/ de la slob ma rang nyid kyis lan 'debs pa dang snga rgol pa'i bsam 'char legs shos rnams myur du zin bris su 'god pa red/de'i rjes slob ma
