gzhan rnams kyis rang nyid la yod pa'i dogs pa dang dri ba gzhan rnams 'dri ba dang dri ba dris lan gyi lam nas gros bsdur byed pa dang / mthar dge rgan gyis kyang kha gsab dang phyogs sdom gyi tshul du rang gi lta tshul brjod pa red/ thengs gsum pa'i skabs su slob ma rnams kyis rang nus ci lcogs kyis dpyad rtsom legs po zhig bris nas slob thun gyi skabs su sngar bzhin thog mar slob ma rang nyid kyis dpyad rtsom slob grogs rnams la mtshams sbyor byed pa dang / de nas snga rgol pa dang slob grogs rnams kyis dri ba 'don pa dang / dogs slong dang rtsad bsdur cung yun ring bor byas pa brgyud nas bsam tshul gang mang bton te dpyad rtsom de nyid je legs nas je legs su gtong ba red/ de ltar legs bcos byas pa'i mjug mtha'i dpyad rtsom de dge rgan la sprod dgos pa dang de ni slob mjug gi rgyugs lta bu yin la dge rgan rnams kyis de la brten nas slob mar rgyugs 'bras kyi skar ma ster pa red/ slob khrid 'dir zhugs pa'i slob ma cung mang drags tshe slob skabs gcig gi nang du mjug rdzogs dka' bas slob skabs gnyis kyi ring la spel pa'ang yod/bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid 'di la dge mtshan ci zhig yod ce na/ dge rgan gyis mgo khrid de bgro gleng gi slob khrid la mdzub ston byed pa dang / slob mas rang gi bri 'dod pa'i dpyad rtsom dang lag tu son yod pa'i dpyad gzhi yig cha rnams slob grogs rnams la ngo sprod legs po zhig byas rjes/ thog mar dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams kyis dpyad rtsom de dang 'brel yod kyi dpe cha — 189 —
dang dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gzhan pa bklags myong ba dang yang na mthong myong ba rnams kyi kha byang dang rtsom pa po/ de dag dpe mdzod khang dang dpe khang gang du yod pa sogs gsal bor bshad de dpyad rtsom bri ba la rgyu cha gzhan mang po 'don sprod byed pa dang / bar du slob ma rang nyid kyis dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gzhan rnams btsal te dpyad rtsom bri ba'i go rim khrod du snga rgol pa dang slob grogs rnams kyis dpyad rtsom gyi thad nas dri ba 'phen pa dang bsam 'char dang lta tshul 'don par ma zad/le'u bko stangs dang dpyad rtsom 'bri thabs kyi skor nas bsam tshul dang thabs legs shos re 'don sprod byed pa red/ mjug mthar rang nyid kyis dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams kyi bsam tshul dang 'dod tshul ltar dpyad rtsom bris tshar te dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams la ngo sprod cig byas rjes/ sngar bzhin snga rgol pa dang slob grogs rnams kyis dri ba 'phen pa dang dpyad rtsom gyi zhan cha'i skor la gros bsdur dang rtsad bsdur legs po zhig byas te dge slob yongs kyis mjug mtha'i bsam 'char rnams 'don pa dang rang nyid kyis de ltar legs bcos byas te dpyad rtsom je legs nas je legs su gtong ba red/ de ltar legs grub byung ba'i dpyad rtsom de 'bri mkhan slob ma gcig pu de yin yang de ni dge rgan gyi mdzub ston dang slob grogs rnams kyi thun mong gi blo gros dang bsam tshul/ rogs ram bcas la brten nas bris pa yin pas rang nyid gcig pus bsam blo btang ste bri ba las ldab 'gyur gyis legs/ h+phin lan rgyal khab kyi had 'od gser mkhar slob grwa chen mor rab 'byams pa'i slob ma mang shos kyis bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid 'di la zhugs te rang nyid kyi mthar phyin dpyad rtsom 'bri bzhin yod/ yin na yang 'di lta bu'i slob khrid la thengs gcig zhugs pas rab 'byams pa'i dpyad rtsom zhig legs 'grub 'byung dka' bas/ thengs du mar zhugs te mthar phyin dpyad rtsom legs 'grub yong bar 'bad bzhin 'dug de ltar bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid la brten nas slob ma'i dpyad rtsom bri ba'i nus pa skyed sring byed pa dang chabs cig slob mar mthar phyin dpyad rtsom bri ba'i mthun rkyen legs po zhig kyang bskrun pa red/— 190—
gsum pa/ 'chad ston la brten nas slob ma'i rgyu cha 'tshol sdud dang smra brjod kyi nus pa skyed sring byed pa/dbyin ji'i skad du 999905cang ma /0711 zhes 'bod pa 'dir 'chad ston zhes bsgyur yod la de ni dge rgan gyis slob thun gyi skabs su 'khrid gzhi gtsor bzung nas slob khrid byed pa'i go rim khrod du gnad don skor zhig slob ma rnams la las bgo byas te kho tsho'i re 'dod ltar 'chad ston gyi dus nges can re gtan 'khel byed pa dang / slob mas gza' 'khor 'ga'i dus tshod bed spyad nas rang la 'khel ba'i gnad don de'i skor gyi rgyu cha mang po btsal nas bklags te/ rang nyid kyi bshad bya'i gnad don de gsal bo zhig nges rjes gra sgrig legs po zhig byas nas slob thun gyi skabs su slob grogs rnams la bshad pa dang / slob grogs rnams kyis dri ba 'phen pa dang dogs slong byed pa la slob ma rang nyid kyis lan 'debs pa de la zer/ slob ma rnams kyis bshad bya'i nang don rnams go rim ltar shog bu'i ngos su 'god pa dang / yang na bshad bya'i nang don gtso bo rnams 'gyig shog thog la bris nas 'chad ston gyi skabs su glog 'od la brten nas ras dkar gyi yol ba'i ngos su 'char du bcug nas dge rgan dang slob ma rnams la re re bzhin gsal bor bshad pa dang / 'chad sto/na byas tshar rjes slob ma gzhan rnams kyis rang nyid la dogs pa yod pa rnams dri ba dang 'chad ston pas re re bzhin lan gdab dgos/ 'chad ston gyi nang don de rgyun par dge rgan gyis gtan 'khel byed pa'i nges pa med de skabs 'gar slob ma rang nyid kyis 'khrid gzhi dang 'brel ba yod pa gang rung zhig gra sgrig byas chog ste/ dper na/ dmangs srol rig pa dang spyi tshogs rig pa'i slob khrid lta bu la mtshon na dge rgan gyis slob ma re re'i 'chad ston gyi dus bkod sgrig byas te bslab bya'i gzhung lugs de'i khyab khongs las gang rung zhig 'chad ston byos zer pa'ang yod pas/ skabs der slob ma rang nyid kyis rang gi pha yul phyogs kyi yul srol dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i nang gi gnad — 191 —
don gang rung zhig 'chad ston byas chog yang skabs 'gar dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la ched las thad nas rang rang gis zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa dang byas zin pa'i 'bras bu 'chad ston byed du 'jug pa'ang yod de/ slob ma rnams kyis rang nyid kyi zhib 'jug byed bzhin pa'i gnas tshul dang yang na byas zin pa'i mjug 'bras sogs slob khrid kyi skabs su rang gi dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams la bshad pa dang / de'i rjes slob grogs rnams kyis bton pa'i dogs pa dang dri ba rnams la lan gang legs re 'debs par byed/ 'di rnams las dge rgan gyis gnad don zhig dri ba'i tshul du las byar byin nas slob ma rnams la de'i thad nas 'chad ston byed du 'jug pa ni phyi gling gi slob grwa chen mo rnams su rgyun du mthong ba'i snang tshul zhig yin/ 'chad ston ni dge rgan gyis slob khrid byed pa'i go rim khrod du gnad don skor zhig slob ma rang rang la rgyu cha 'tshol sdud dang brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byed du bcug nas rang gi lta tshul dang zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu de slob ma gzhan rnams la gsal bor bshad dgos pa'i las bya zhig red/'chad ston gyi sbyong brdar 'di'i dge mtshan ni slob ma rnams kyis 'khrid gzhi gtso bor bzung nas slob sbyong byed pa'i zhor du gnad don dang dri ba der lan gsal bo zhig 'debs pa'i ched du dus tshod thung thung zhig bed spyad nas rang nus ci lcogs kyis rgyu cha mang bo zhig 'tshol sdud bya dgos pa dang / rang gis dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha rnams bklags pa la brten nas 'chad ston la gra sgrig legs po zhig byed dgos pas/ des slob ma'i rgyu cha 'tshol ba'i nus pa dang dri bar lan btab nas gnad don thag gcod pa'i nus pa skyed sring byed thub pa dang / slob ma rang nyid kyis thag bcad pa'i gzhung lugs kyi gnad don dang zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu rnams dge rgan dang rang gi slob grogs/ rnams kyi mdun sar gsal bor bshad dgos pas des slob ma'i smra brjod kyi nus pa dang spobs pa sogs skyed sring byed nus par ma zad/ slob ma rnams kyis dri ba 'phen pa dang dogs slong byed pa/rang gis lan 'debs pa bcas brgyud nas rang gis dpyad 'jog dang zhib 'jug byas pa'i 'bras — 191 —
bu la zhan cha gang dag yod pa nges 'gro ba dang gzhung lugs kyi gnad don dang dri bar sngar las gting zab pa'i sgo nas bsam blo gtong ba dang zhib 'jug byed par blo sgo yang 'byed nges yin/ de ltar 'chad ston mang po byas myong ba'i slob grwa chen mo 'i slob ma rnams ni gnad don thag gcod pa dang dogs pa dang dri bar lan 'debs pa la blo goms shing / mi mang tshogs pa'i dbus su gtam bshad par 'dzem dogs med par rang nyid kyi bsam tshul dang lta tshul gsal bor brjod nus pa zhig kyang yin no/ /bzhi ba/ gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan ni slob khrid byed thabs kyi lag cha gtso bo yin pa/gong du bshad zin pa ltar tshogs 'du'i rnam pa can gyi slob khrid dang bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid/ 'chad ston gyi sbyong brdar gang yin yang gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan brgyud nas slob ma'i gzhung lugs kyi shes bya rgya bskyed pa dang / zhib 'jug dang dpyad rtsom bri ba'i nus pa skyed sring byed par ma zad/ smra brjod dag pa'i kha lce dang spobs pa sogs kyang skyed sring byas pa red/ de ni phyi gling gi slob grwa chen mo'i slob khrid byed thabs kyi lag cha gtso bo zhig yin te/ gros bsdur byas pa brgyud nas slob ma rnams kyis phan tshun la dri ba 'don pa dang gcig gis shes pa'i gnas tshul dang gnad don de slob grogs rnams la bshad pa dang / mi shes pa rnams kyang slob grogs rnams la dris nas nges par byed pa red/ dri ba dris lan rabs dang rim pa la brten nas rang gis shes 'dod pa'i don gang dang gang yin pa de cung gting zab pa'i sgo nas rtogs par 'gyur te/ dper na ya gling gi rig gnas la slob sbyong byed pa'i slob ma zhig gis bod mi rnams la rus yod med dris pa na/ slob ma gzhan zhig gis bod la rus yod tshul dang rus chen bzhi dang rus chung bco brgyad sogs yod tshul gsal bor bshad pa dang / yang slob ma gzhan zhig gis 'o na da lta bod pa mang che bar rus med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhes dris pa na/ slob ma la las mi shes zhes lan 'debs nges — 193 —
la/ yang la las bod kyi rus nyams song ba yin las che zhes brjod pa na/ gzhan pa zhig gis de ltar na bod kyi rus ji ltar nyams pa dang de'i nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo ci yin zhes dri nges la/ de ltar gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan la brten nas rtsad bsdur gyi gting je zab tu 'gro bas dogs pa gang dang gang yod pa de cung gting zab pa'i sgo nas rtogs thub par ma zad/ dogs gzhi gzhan mang bo zhig kyang gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan la brten nas 'byung ba red/de bzhin du slob khrid byed pa'i skabs su slob mas mi shes pa dang dogs pa yod pa rnams rang gi slob grogs rnams la 'dri ba dang gros bsdur dang rtsad bsdur brgyud nas nges par byed pa dang /gal te slob mas dri bar lan btab pa kha tshang min pa dang nor ba byung tshe dge rgan gyis kha gsab kyi tshul du dri ba rnams la lan gsal bo re btab nas slob ma'i rgyud kyi dogs slong rnams sel bar byed pa dang / dge rgan gyis kyang slob deb las dka' gnad dang gtso gnad kyi skor dri ba'i tshul du slob ma rnams la las bya bgos pa na slob ma tshos dri ba de rnams la lan kha tshang zhing yang dag pa zhig gdab pa'i ched du de dang 'brel yod kyi rgyu cha mang po btsal te dge rgan gyi dri ba rnams la lan gdab ci thub byed pa red/ gzhan yang slob ma rnams kyis mthar phyin dpyad rtsom bri ba'i tshe na yang /thog mar rang nyid spro ba yod pa'i dpe cha dang rgyu cha rnams re re bzhin bklags nas de las byung ba'i dogs pa'am dri ba zhig gtsor byas nas mthar phyin dpyad rtsom bri ba red/ dri ba de la dbyin ji'i skad du zhib 'jug gi dri ba ( 88567905 456me 05 ) zhes 'bod pa dang / zhib 'jug gi dri ba de gtso bor bzung nas de dang 'brel yod kyi dri ba mang bo zhig bton nas dris lan 'tshol ba dang /'brel ba dam po yod pa'i dri ba rnams le'u re'i nang du bzhag nas dpyad rtsom bri ba red/ gong du bshad zin pa 'di rnams las nga tshos gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan ni phyi gling gi slob grwa chen mo'i slob khrid kyi lag cha gtso bo zhig yin pa gsal bor shes thub pa dang / de'i dge mtshan gtso bo ni gros bsdur la brten nas slob ma rang nyid kyi dogs pa mang bo zhig slob grogs rnams la 'dri bar — 194—
byed cing slob grogs rnams kyis gsal bor bshad pa la brten nas nges 'gro ba dang / slob grogs phan tshun bar dang dge slob bar du dri ba dris lan gyi sgo nas rtsad bsdur byas pa des bklags zin pa'i dpe cha'i nang don dang gzhung lugs kyi slob khrid/ 'chad ston gyi nang don dang zhib 'jug gi chu tshad sogs je zhib dang je zab tu 'gro bar nus pa chen po zhig 'don bzhin yod/lnga ba/ dge rgan gyis slob mjug tu slob ma'i bsam 'char sdud len byas te slob khrid kyi byed thabs dang slob deb kyi nang don je legs su gtong ba/nga tshos shes gsal ltar dpe cha mang che shos ni slob skabs gcig gi nang du 'khrid tshar dgos pas dge rgan gyis le'u re re bzhin khrid na slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi mi 'grub pa'i gnas tshul yang yod la/ skabs 'gar slob deb las gtso bo'i skor ma gtogs khrid kyin med pa dang / yang slob ma rnams la ma dris par dge rgan rang nyid kyis slob khrid byed thabs de slob ma rnams la 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig yin min gsal bor mi shes pas/ slob skabs shig mjug rdzogs dus dge rgan gyis slob ma re re la bsam 'char sdud len byed pa red/ rgyun par dge rgan gyis rang gi shes 'dod pa'i slob khrid skor gyi dri ba rnams shog bu'i ngos su bris nas slob ma rnams la byin te lan gdab tu 'jugde'i nang don ni dper na/ khyod kyis slob deb 'di'i nang du zhib tu sbyang 'dod pa'i le'u gang dag yin pa dang / bslabs zin pa las khyod la ches phan thogs yod pa'i le'u gang dag dang slob deb 'di'i nang du kha gsab bya dgos pa'i skor gang dag yod pa/ yang na khyod la mtshon na slob deb las le'u gang dag gros bsdur nyung tsam dang gang dag gros bsdur cung yun ring bor byed dgos pa la sogs pa'i dri ba bcu nas bco lnga tsam yod pa slob ma rnams la lan gdab tu 'jug pa red/ slob skabs rjes ma'i slob khrid kyi skabs su dge rgan gyis slob ma'i bsam 'char dang 'dod tshul ltar slob khrid kyi nang don thad nas gtso phal phye ste slob ma rnams la gros bsdur byed du 'jug pa dang /— 195 —
kha gsab bya dgos pa rnams slob deb kyi na nga du bsnan nas slob khrid byed pa red/'di'i dge mtshan ni slob ma'i bsam 'char dang dgos mkho gzhir bzung nas slob khrid byas na slob ma rnams la phan thogs pa dang / de ltar khrid na slob ma'i sbyang 'dod kyi 'dun pa yang je cher 'gro ba yin te/ rgyu mtshan ni bslab bya'i tshan pa'am le'u yod tshad slob mas sbyang 'dod pa 'ba' zhig yin la/ slob ma rang nyid kyis kyang sbyangs na rang la phan thogs chen po yod par bsams pa yin pas slob ma'i bsam 'char dang 'dod pa ltar slob khrid bya rgyu ni shin tu gal che/ de bzhin du dge rgan la las slob ma rnams la slob khrid byed thabs kyi phyogs nas kyang bsam 'char sdud len byed pa dang / dge rgan gyis slob ma'i bsam tshul dang 'dod tshul ltar rang gi slob khrid byed thabs la bcos sgyur cung zad byas te slob khrid byed pa yang yod/ dper na/ slob khrid kyi go rim khrod du gros bsdur cung nyung drags pa'am yang na gros bsdur gyi 'gros cung mgyogs pa la sogs pa'i slob ma'i bsam 'char rnams sdud len byas par brten nas phyogs gang thad nas bcos sgyur dang je legs su gtong ba red/ a ri'i slob grwa chen mo mang che shos la mtshon na slob mjug gi skabs su dge rgan gyis thad kur slob mar bsam 'char sdud len mi byed par sde khrag gi mgo gtso dang las byed mi sna re gnyis song nas slob ma rnams la slob khrid phyogs kyi bsam 'char sdud len byed pa dang / bsam 'char gyi sdud len gyi re'u mig nang du dge rgan gyis slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi gnad bsdus ltar slob khrid byas ma byas dang / dge rgan gyi slob khrid byed stangs/ smra brjod dag min sogs kyi dri ba rnams la slob ma rnams kyis slob khrid kyi gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin du bris nas yar sde khag gi mgo gtso la sprod pa red/de ltar byed dgos don ni slob deb dang rgyu cha gsar ba lo rer thon bzhin yod pas/ de'i nang don la yang 'gyur ldog cung zad re byung dang 'byung bzhin yod/ de bzhin du slob deb cung rnying ba zhig yin tshe de'i nang don la rnying ba'i cha cung zad yod nges pas slob deb kyi nang du nang — 196—
don gsar ba bsnan dgos pa ni nges par dge rgan gyis bsgrub dgos pa'i bya ba zhig yin zhing / de bsgrub pa la yang dge slob gnyis kyi thun mong gi bsam tshul la brten nas legs bcos byas na legs po zhig 'khyongs nges yin/mdor na/ phyi gling gi slob grwa chen mo rnams su tshogs 'du'i rnam pa can gyi slob khrid dang /bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid/ 'chad ston gyi sbyong brdar/ gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan gyi slob khrid byed thabs gtsor bzung ste/ dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la mdzub ston byas te dpe cha gang mang bklag tu 'jug pa dang / rtsom pa po'i lta tshul gtso bo rnams la rtsad bsdur dang / lta tshul de dang mi mthun pa'i bsam tshul gzhan rnams la'ang dpyad brjod nan mo byed du bcug ste bslab bya'i gzhung lugs kyi don rnams cung gting zab pa'i sgo nas blo la nges su 'jug par ma zad/ bgro gleng gi rnam pa can gyi slob khrid de la brten nas slob ma'i zhib 'jug gi nus pa skyed sring dang /dge rgan dang slob grogs rnams kyis phan tshun la rgyu cha 'don sprod dang bsam tshul brje res gang mang byas te mthar phyin dpyad rtsom bri bar mthun rkyen gang legs bskrun pa dang / 'chad ston gyi sbyong brdar la brten nas slob ma'i rgyu cha 'tshol sdud kyi nus pa dang / gzhung lugs thad kyi dogs pa dang dri bar gan 'debs pa'i nus pa/ ga tam bshad kyi nus pa sogs skyed sring byed pa red/ da dung slob mjug tu slob ma'i bsam 'char sdud len byas te de gzhir bzung nas slob khrid byed thabs dang slob deb kyi nang don sogs je legs su gtong ba red/ slob khrid byed thabs 'di dag la dge mtshan mang po ldan par mthong zhing de la brten nas skyed sring byas pa'i slob chen gyi slob ma ni gzhung lugs thad kyi dpe cha mang po bklags myong ba dang / gros bsdur dang dri ba dris lan gyi lam nas de la rtsad bsdur dang dpyad 'jog byas pas gzhung lugs kyi lta rgya che zhing gzhung don rnams cung gting zab pa'i sgo nas blo la nges yod pa dang gcig bgro gleng gi slob khrid khrod du dpyad rtsom bri bar sbyong brdar gang mang byas pas zhib 'jug gi thabs la mkhas shing dpyad rtsom bri — 197 —
ba'i kho lag rgyas pa dang gnyis/ 'chad ston gyi sbyong brdar gang mang byas zin pas rgyu cha 'tshol sdud la cung byang zhing rang gi zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu dang lta tshul rnams mi mang tshogs pa'i dbus su 'dzem dogs med par 'chad pa la mkhas pa dang gsum/ gzhung lugs kyi thad nas dri ba dris lan gyi sbyong brdar mang po byas pas dpe char lta dus dang 'chad khrid la nyan dus gtso gnad kyi skor 'dzin shes shing dogs pa khong slong dang dri ba 'dren pa la byang cha song ba dang bzhi ste 'chad pa dang rtsom pa/ rtsod pa bcas phyogs gang thad nas skyed sring byas pa red snyam/ slob khrid byed thabs gang yin yang gros bsdur dang kha 'bral thabs med la/ dge rgan ni mdzub ston pa dang slob ma ni slob thun gyi skabs su 'khrab ston byed mkhan lta bu yin pa'i slob khrid byed thabs 'di la dge mtshan mang po ldan no/ /— 198—
yod kyi skad yig slob gso la nye bar mkho ba'i phyisgrung gi slob khrid byed sgo gal chen 'ga' gleng pa/deng gi dus 'dir srol rgyun gyi slob khrid byed thabs la bcos sgyur byas te da lta'i dus rabs dang 'tsham pa'i thabs lam gsar pa spyad nas slob khrid byed pa dang / slob thun gyi skabs su byed sgo sna tshogs spel nas shes bya gsar pa rnams slob ma'i rgyud la nges su 'jug par kun gyis 'bad 'bungs byed kyin 'dug la/ nga tsho'i slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum gyi dge rgan rnams kyis kyang slob khrid byed thabs gsar pa dang byed sgo legs po rnams bed spyod bya rgyu ha cang gal che bas/ 'dir bod kyi skad yig dang slob gso gong 'phel du 'gro bar cung zad phan na snyam pa'i kun slong dang bcas phyi gling gi slob khrid byed sgo mang po las nye bar mkho ba nyi shu logs su bsal nas mtshams sbyor bya rgyu yin/①1 sgor dbyibs kyi rol rtsed/ (0070 caca779)slob ma rnams sgor dbyibs ltar tsog pur 'dug pa dang / mthun rkyen 'dzoms tshe slob ma rnams rkub stegs steng du sdod du 'jug dgos/ dge rgan sgor dbyibs kyi dbus su bsdad de rol rtsed cig gi mgo brtsam dgos la/ sgor dbyibs kyi dbus su da dung slob grogs shig sdod dgos pa dang / de rol rtsed kyi skabs su myur du mtha' skor du song nas rkub stegs stong ba'i thog tu 'dug dgos/ thog mar dge rgan gyis bslab bya'i nang don dang 'brel ba'i brda sprod skor gyi tshig grub — 199 —
cig bzo dgos pa dper na/ kha sang a phas nga la gtam rgyud cig bshad dang yang na sang nyin nga rang slob grwar 'gro dgos zhes pa lta bu/ skabs der slob mas nges par dge rgan gyis bshad pa'i tshig de 'grig min myur du thag bcad de/ gal te bshad tshul de yang dag pa yin na slob ma rnams myur du yar langs nas rkub stegs gzhan zhig btsal nas 'dug dgos pa dang / tshig de nor 'khrul can zhig yin tshe slob ma rnams mu mthud du sngar gyi rkub stegs thog tu bsdad chog mtha' mar 'dug sa'i rkub stegs med pa'i slob ma de sgor dbyibs kyi dbus su yong nas tshig grub gzhan zhig bzo dgos/2 'dri tshig brgyud sprod byed pa/ ( 9853256'khu ca :07)'di la lgang li zhig dang yang na sar lhung yang mi gas pa'i dngos po zhig dgos pa dang /bslab bya'i kha byang dang 'brel ba'i 'dri tshig skor zhig kyang gra sgrig byed dgos/slob ma rnams sgor dbyibs ltar yar langs nas sdod pa dang dge rgan de'i dkyil du 'dug dgos/ de nas dge rgan gyis dri ba zhig bton rjes gang 'dod ltar slob ma zhig la lgang liṃ ster dgos/ dper na/ skyid po'i ldog zla ci zhig yin dang yang na a me ri kha'i rgyal sa gang yin zhes pa lta bu/ gal te slob ma des dris lan gang yin shes tshe lan 'debs zhor du lgang liṃ phyir dge rgan la ster pa dang / lan 'debs ma thub na slob ma des nges par dgongs dag zhus nas lgang li slob grogs gzhan zhig la ster dgos/slob grogs gnyis pas dris lan shes tshe lan 'debs zhor du lgang li phyir dge rgan la ster pa dang /gal te dri bar lan ma thebs na kong ltar dkongs dag zhus nas mu mthud du lgang li slob grogs gzhan zhig la ster dgos/ 'di ltar dris lan yang dag pa zhig 'debs rag bar du lgang liṃ slob ma rnams kyi bar du phan tshun la ster dgos la/ dri bar lan yang dag pa zhig btab rjes dri ba gsar ba zhig 'phangs nas yang bskyar mgo brtsam dgos/— 200—
3 thog mar tha snyadaskyong ba/ (kha 'a 855600775/77)dge rgan gyis brjod bya'i kha byang dang dam du 'brel ba'i tha snyad lnga nas bcu sgo sam ngos su bri ba dang / tsho chung rer slob ma 'ga' re dang yang na gnyis re bgos te kho tshor gong gi tha snyad de rnams kyi don gang yin la tshod dpag byed du 'jug dgos pa dang / tsho chung rer tha snyad re'i nang don ci yin bshad du bcug ste de rnams 'grig min 'dzin grwa'i slob grogs gzhan rnams la dri dgos la/tshan chung so sos tha snyad de dag gi don ci yin ming mdzod nang du btsal nas de rnams kyi nang don gsal bor bshad dgos/ 4 stong cha skong ba/ (303577ca'ab sta //)dge rgan gyis brjod bya'i don gtso bo mtshon par byed pa'i tshig 'ga' gra sgrig byas te/ slob tshan gyi nang don gzhir byas nas stong cha yod pa'i tshig mi 'dra ba gnyis su phye ba dang / slob mas tha snyad dang tshig thung gtso bo rnams bkol nas sto/nga cha bskang dgos/ yin na yang tshig/ gnyis kyi stong cha rnams gcig 'dra yin mi rung ste/ tshig dum ka ba'i nang du tshig dum kha ba'i lan yod pa dang /tshig dum kha ba'i nang du tshig dum ka ba'i lan yod/ dge rgan gyis slob ma gnyis re tsho chung gcig tu bgos nas mi rer tshig dum mi 'dra ba re byin te/ phan tshun la dri ba 'dri ru bcug nas stong cha'i kha bskang du 'jug dgos/ gsham du de'i dper brjod cig bkod na 'di ltar/ tshig dum ka ba/slob dpon thon mi ni rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i ring gi blon po zhig yin pa dang / khos rgya gar du lo ngo ( ) ring la slob gnyer byas nas phyir bod du phebs te bod yig gsar bzo byas pa yin/tshig dum kha ba/ slob dpon thon mi ni rgyal po ( ) ring gi blon po zhig yin pa dang / khos rgya gar du lo ngo bdun ring la slob gnyer byas nas phyir bod du phebs te bod yig gsar bzo byas pa —201—
yin/ zhes pa lta bu dang / tshig dum ka ba lag tu thon yod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis rang gi 'dug rogs la slob dpon thon mis rgya gar du lo ngo ci tsam la slob gnyer byas pa yin zhes dri dgos pa dang /tshig dum kha ba lag tu thon yod pa'i slob ma rnams kyis rang gi 'dug rogs la slob dpon thon mi ni rgyal po su'i ring gi blon po zhig red ces dri dgos/5 rang byung tshan pa rnams kyi go rim bsgrig pa/ (98383389535ma 5600336507707)slob tshan zhig gi rang byung tshan pa rnams go rim dkrugs nas 'jog pa dang / slob tshan gyi nang don la bsam blo btang tshe tshan pa rnams go rim ji ltar bsgrig dgos pa shes thub pa zhig bya dgos/ gal te rang byung tshan pa bsgrig rgyu de cung dka' drags na dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams la tha snyad gtso bo skor zhig sngon du bshad chog thog mar slob ma rnams la slob tshan bklag tu 'jug pa dang / mi gnyis dang yang na mi 'ga' re tsho chung gcig tu bkos te kho tshor rang byung tshan pa rnams yang dag pa'i go rim ltar bsgrig tu bcug nas dge rgan gyis slob grogs tsho dang mnyam du rang byung tshan pa'i go rim sgrig stangs de 'grig min la blta dgos shing / de rjes mnyam du slob tshan la zhib tu bltas nas slob mas slob tshan la go ba gting zab mo zhig lon min brtag par byed/6 nyan 'bri/ (khu nga 06/༷33)dge rgan gyis go sla ba'i rang byung tshan pa gnyis yan chad bdam ste/ mgyogs tshad ran zhing skad gdangs mthon po'i sgo nas klog 'don byed pa dang slob ma tshos nan tan gyis mnyan dgos/ de rjes dge rgan gyis yang bskyar slob tshan gyi rang byung tshan pa dang po klog 'don byed dgos pa dang /slob ma rnams kyis rang byung tshan pa de'i nang don gtso bo zin bris su 'god par byed pa dang / kho tshos tshig 'bru ji ma ji bzhin du bri dgos pa'i nges pa med la brda sprod thad kyi nor 'khrul la'ang de —202—
'dra'i mnyam 'jog bya mi dgos/ de ltar dge rgan gyis mu mthud du rang byung tshan pa rjes ma klog 'don byed pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis de'i nang don gong ltar zin bris su 'god dgos/ slob tshan tshar rag bar du mu mthud du klog 'don byed dgos pa dang slob mas kyang de'i nang don yongs rdzogs zin bris su 'god dgos/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis rang gi 'dug grogs dang mnyam du zin bris kyi nang don ltar slob tshan yi ger bris nas bsgrig dgos pa dang / kho tshos sngar bklags pa'i slob tshan gyi tshig 'bru ji bzhin bri mi dgos mod/ yin na yang slob tshan gyi nang don gtso bo dang go rim zhib tshags la ci nus kyis do snang bya dgos/ mjug mthar slob mas bsgrigs pa'i slob tshan la zhu dag byed skabs de'i nang don la do snang byed pa las tshig 'bru ji bzhin thon yod med dang yig nor dang brda sprod skor de 'dra'i gal chen du 'dzin mi rung /7 shes bya'i 'gran bsdur/ ( 570ca 0gidzo 46) ①dge rgan gyis brjod bya'i kha byang skor gyi dri ba skor zhig gra sgrig byed dgos pa dang / slob grogs gnyis re dang yang na gnyis yan chad la dri ba gcig re yod dgos la/ de dag gi dris lan thung zhing tha snyad gcig yin na shin tu legs/ dris lan rnams re re bzhin sgo sam ngos su gang 'dod ltar 'bri dgos/ de nas 'dzin grwa'i slob ma rnams tsho chung gnyis su bgo ba dang / tsho chung gnyis po sgo sam dang thag cung ring sar gshib nas bsgrig(slob grogs gcig gi rgyab tu gcig re re bzhin bsgrig dgos/)tu bcug ste sgo sam ngos kyi dris lan gsal bor mthong mi thub par bya dgos/de nas tsho chung re'i slob ma dang po'i lag tu sa smyug gam smyu gu re 'jog dgos pa dang / dge rgan gyis skad gdangs mthon pos dri ba dang po dri dgos te/ dper na/ dbyin ji'i rgyal sa gang yin zhes pa lta bu dang / tsho chung gnyis kyi slob ma sngon ma de gnyis myur du sgo sam gyi gam du yong ste yang dag pa'i dris lan la gor thig cig rgyag dgos shing / dris lan yang dag pa thog mar bdams pa'i slob — 203 —
ma de'i tsho chung la skar ma gcig thob pa dang / de nas kho tsho phyir song nas rang gi tsho chung gi gral mjug tu bsgrig dgos/ de rjes tsho chung re'i slob ma gnyis pa de gnyis kyis nges par dri ba rjes mar gsal bor mnyan dgos pa dang / yang gong ltar sgo sam gyi gam du song nas dri ba gnyis pa'i lan der rtags rgyag dgos/ de ltar slob grogs tshang ma zhugs tshar rag bar du rol rtsed spel dgos/8 yang dag pa dang nor ba'i rkyab stegs/ (7756777kham/ca'adzukhrim 33) buthog mar 'dzin grwa'i slob grogs rnams tsho chung ka ba dang kha ba gnyis su bgo ba dang / rkub stegs gnyis khyer yong nas gcig gi steng la yang dag pa dang gzhan pa de'i steng la nor ba zhes bris nas slob ma rnams kyi mdun du 'jog dgos/ rkub stegs gnyis dang bar thag cung tsam yod sar tsho chung gnyis gshib nas bsgrig dgos/ dge rgan gyis yang dag pa dang yang na nor ba'i tshig 'ga' gra sgrig byed dgos te/ dper na/ a me ri kha'i rgyal sa nyig yo yin zhes pa dang yang na slob khang nang du cog tse nyi shu yod ces pa lta bu yin la/ dge rgan gyis tshig de bklags ma thag tsho chung gnyis la'i slob ma dang po de gnyis kyis tshig de 'grig min myur du thag bcad de brgyugs yong nas yang dag pa dang nor ba'i rtags bkod yod pa'i rkub stegs thog tu 'dug dgos/ ma nor bar rkub stegs steng du thog mar sdod mkhan gyi slob ma de'i tsho chung la skar ma gcig thob/ de rjes mu mthud du tshig rjes ma klog 'don byed dgos pa dang mjug mthar skar 'bras thob pa ches mang ba'i tsho chung de rgyal ba yin/9 dri ba dris lan gnyis bsgrigs pa/ (57405 khri 'a593 077778bcagi 3)dge rgan gyis shog leb cig gi ngos su dri ba zhig dang shog leb gzhan zhig gi ngos su dri ba de'i lan bris nas gra sgrig legs po zhig byas te slob ma re re la dri ba dang dris lan gang rung re ster —204—
dgos/ slob ma re la shog leb re ster pa dang kho tshos tshig de rnams klog 'don byas nas yid la bzung rjes shog leb rnams phyir dge rgan la sprod pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis tshig de rnams gtan nas 'bri mi rung / de nas slob ma rnams slob khang nang du phar 'gro tshur 'ong byas nas dri ba 'don pa dang dris lan 'debs par byed la/ dri bar 'tsham pa'i dris lan de rnyed tshe kho tsho dge rgan gyi gam du song nas dris lan de dri ba de'i lan yin min thag gcod dgos/ gal te kho tshos dri ba dang dris gan bsgrigs pa 'grig tshe rang nyid kyi 'dug stegs thog tu bsdad chog pa dang /dri ba'i lan ma rnyed tshe mu mthud du dri ba dang dris lan btsal dgos shing / dri ba yongs rdzogs la dris lan re bsgrigs tshar rag bar du rol rtsed spel dgos/10 rang byung tshan pa'i go rim sgrig pa/ (077'dzo khri kha 3323896)dge rgan gyis brjod bya'i kha byang skor gyi rtsom yig cig gra sgrig byas nas de'i rang byung tshan pa'i tshig rnams so sor dra dgos pa dang / de nas slob ma rnams tsho chung 'gar bgos nas slob ma rer tshig gcig re dang / tsho chung rer rang byung tshan pa gcig re bgo dgos/ dper na/ gal te rang byung tshan pa zhig tshig lnga las grub pa yin na slob ma lnga tsho chung der bgo ba dang / slob ma re la rang byung tshan pa de las tshig gcig re thob pa yin/ slob ma rnams kyis tsho chung nang du rang gi tshig de bklags nas rang byung tshan pa de'i tshig rnams kyi go rim bsgrig dgos pa dang / bsgrigs tshar rjes rang byung tshan pa de'i tshig rnams yang dag pa'i go rim ltar 'don dgos/11 nor bcos byed pa/ (54094565 34766)dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams mi gnyis nas lnga can gyi tsho chung 'gar bgo ba dang / tsho chung re res tshig gsum nas lnga bri dgos pa dang tshig re re'i nang du tsho chung gzhan pas rnyed dka' ba'i nor —205—
'khrul re yod dgos la/ tshig de dag slob ma tshos slob bzhin pa'i bslab tshan dang 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin yang chog de nas slob mas bris pa'i tshig rnams tsho chung phan tshun la byin nas nor bcos byed du 'jug pa dang / nor bcos byas tshar rjes tsho chung re res sgo sam ngos su tshig rnams bris nas dag bcos bya dgos/ nor bcos byas pa 'grig tshe tsho chung der skar ma gcig thob pa dang / nor 'khrul gang yin ma shes tshe tshig de bri mkhan gyi tsho chung der skar ma gcig thob/ gal te kho tshos nor 'khrul gzhan zhig rnyed tshe de la'ang skar ma gcig thob nges yin /12 gtam rgyud bri ba/ (1040316/ca5 ༷pa)'dzin grwa'i slob grogs rnams mi gsum nas lnga can gyi tsho chung 'gar bgo ba dang / de nas dge rgan gyis gtam rgyud kyi kha byang zhig bshad pa dang yang na slob ma dang mnyam du gtam rgyud kyi kha byang zhig gtan 'khel byas rjes/ tsho chung re'i slob grogs shig la shog leg cig byin nas de'i gong du tshig gnyis 'bri ru 'jug pa dang tshig dang po'i 'og tu tshig gnyis pa de 'bri dgos/ tshig de gnyis ni gtam rgyud kyi tshig mgo ma gnyis kyang yin/ gtam rgyud kyi tshig de gnyis bris tshar rjes shog leb bltabs te tshig dang po gab nas tshig gnyis pa ma gtogs mthong mi thub pa zhig byas te shog leb de tsho chung nang gi slob grogs gnyis par byin nas gtam rgyud kyi tshig phyi ma gnyis bri ru 'jug dgos pa dang / slob grogs des kyang gong ltar shog leb bltabs nas tshig rjes ma(tshig bzhi ba)ma gtogs mthong mi thub pa zhig byas nas shog leb tsho chung nang gi slob grogs gzhan pa zhig la ster dgos/ shog leb de tsho chung gi slob grogs re re'i lag tu thengs gnyis nas gsum la brgyud dgos①pa dang / mjug mthar tsho chung re res shog leb kyi lteb ma rnams bshig nas 'dzin grwa'i slob ma yongs la gtam rgyud de 'don dgos/— 206—
13 rnam 'gyur gyis mtshon pa/ (khu ca0rna bca )dge rgan gyis slob ma rnams tsho chung ka ba dang kha ba gnyis su bgo dgos pa dang / brjod bya'i kha byang dang 'brel ba'i tha snyad rnams shog leb kyi ngos su bris nas legs par bltabs te sgam chung zhig gi nang du 'jog dgos/① de nas tsho chung ka ba'i slob ma zhig 'dzin grwa'i slob grogs rnams kyi mdun du yong nas sgam chung las shog leb gcig blangs nas de'i ngos kyi tha snyad la bltas rjes/skar cha sum cu'i nang du slob ma des skad cha tshig gcig kyang mi bshad par rnam 'gyur la brten nas rang gi tsho chung gi slob grogs rnams la tha snyad de'i nang don ci yin shes su 'jug dgos/ skabs der tsho chung kha ba'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang skad cha bshad mi chog la/ tsho chung ka bas skar cha sum cu'i nang du tha snyad de gang yin tshod dpag byas tshe tsho chung der skar ma gcig thob pa dang / tshod dpag byed ma thub tshe tsho chung kha bar tha snyad de gang yin tshod dpag byas nas skar 'bras len pa'i go skabs yod/ de rjes tsho chung kha ba'i slob ma zhig 'dzin grwa'i slob grogs rnams kyi mdun du yong nas gong ltar bsgrub dgos la/ slob ma tshang mas rang gi rnam 'gyur la brten nas tha snyad de rnams gang yin gsal bshad byas tshar rag bar du byed sgo spel dgos/14 gros bsdur/ (20305330༷ 3)'dzin grwa'i slob grogs rnams mi gsum nas lnga can gyi tsho chung 'gar bgos nas kho tshor gros bsdur gyi kha byang zhig byin te/ kha byang de'i skor gyi lta tshul mi 'dra ba'i rgyu cha re 'don sprod byed thub na de las kyang legs shing / rtsod pa bslang thub pa'i gleng gzhi'i dri ba gnyis dang yang na gsum gra sgrig bya dgos/ de nas slob mar las bgos byas te rang skya thub pa'i sgo nas dri ba de rnams la bsam blo gtong du 'jug pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis sgrub byed mang po btsal nas rtsod gleng la gra — 207 —
sgrig legs po bya dgos/ bgro gleng ma byas gong tsho chung re res 92tshogs gtso〉〉 gcig dang 99yi ge ba〉〉gcig (phyogatam bshad mkhan〉〉 gcig ste bsdoms pas slob ma gsum gdam dgos pa dang / kho tshor skar ma gcig gi dus tshod byin nas mnyam du dris lan rnams la gros bsdur byed du bcug ste slob grogs yod tshad 'thad pa byung ba'i thun mong gi dris lan zhig gra sgrig bya dgos/ 99tshogs gtso 〉 yis gros bsdur gyi mgo 'dzin dgos pa dang / 46yi ge bsna yis gros bsdur gyi mjug 'bras sam thun mong gi dris lan rnams zin bris su 'god dgos/ de nas tsho chung re'i 99gtam bshad mkhan〉〉 gyis res mos sgos rang gi tsho chung gi dris lan re re bzhin 'don dgos/ dper na/ nga tsho'i bsam tshul ltar na / zhes pa lta bu/ dge rgan dang slob ma gzhan rnams kyis nges par dris lan de dag gi nang don mdor bsdus shig zin thor 'god dgos pa dang / mjug mthar dge rgan gyis dri ba de dag thad kyi rang mos gros bsdur zhig spel te slob ma rnams la rang rang gi lta tshul 'don du 'jug dgos pa las tsho chung gi lta tshul bshad du mi 'jug pa red/15 tshod lta'i rgyugs len pa/ ('a5ཿ7)thog mar 'dzin grwa'i slob ma yongs rdzogs tsho khag gnyis su bgo ba dang de nas tsho khag re re yang mi gsum nas lnga can gyi tsho chung 'gar bgo dgos/ tsho chung re res skabs su bab pa'i sbyang bya'i skor gyi dri ba dang dris lan gsum nas bzhi bri dgos pa dang / dri ba de rnams la nges par dris lan yang dag re yod dgos par ma zad/ tsho chung des dris lan rnams gsal bor shes dgos/ dper na/ bod kyi rgyal po thog ma su yin dang / rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan la nang gses kyi dbye ba du yod dang / tshig phrad ces pa'i don ci zhes pa lta bu/ kho tshos dri ba dris lan rnams bris nas gra sgrig byas tshar rjes phyir rang gi tsho khag nang du 'gro dgos/ de nas tsho khrag ka bas tsho khag kha bar dri ba zhig dri dgos pa dang tsho khrag kha bas der dris lan yang dag pa zhig btab tshe kho tshor skar ma gcib —208—
thob/ de rjes tsho khag kha bas dri ba zhig bton nas tsho khag ka bas der gan 'debs dgos/ de ltar dri ba yod tshad dris tshar ba dang dris lan thams cad btab tshar rag bar du rol rtsed spel dgos/16 'khrab ston/ ( 50/'a kha/75)'khrab ston gyi khrod du mi sna mi 'dra ba rnams yod pa'i tsho chung zhig gtan la phab ste/ 'dzin grwa'i slob ma rnams mi sna 'dra ba'i tsho chung 'dra mnyam 'gar bgo dgos te/ dper na/ a h+phe ri kha'i lho ma rgyal khab tu mi rigs 'dra mnyam min pa'i lam lugs skor 'khrab ston bya dgos na phal cher mi sna rnams tshang ba'i tsho chung gsum dgos te/ sa gnas kyi mi dang / dbyin ji'i mi/ po ar gyi mi gsum dgos pa dang mi sna de rnams 'dzoms pa'i tsho chung rnams mnyam du bsre dgos/ tsho chung re res mi sna mi 'dra ba rnams ji ltar bkod sgrig byed par gros bsdur byed pa dang / dge rgan gyis dri ba 'ga' 'don sprod byas te kho tshor mi sna'i bkod sgrig skor la bsam blo gtong du 'jug dgos/ dper na/ sa gnas kyi mi rnams la 'di ltar dris chog ste/ po ar gyi mi rnams gnas 'dir ma thon gong khyod tsho'i 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul ga 'dra zhig yin zhes pa lta bu dang / po ar gyi mi rnams la khyod rang a h+phe ri kha'i lho ma rgyal khab la gnas spar don ci zhes dri ba dang / dbyin ji'i mi rnams la khyod la a h+phe ri kha'i lho ma rgyal khab kyi ci zhig dgos pa yin zhes dris chog mi sna 'dra ba'i tsho chung rnams kyis rang nyid kyi lta tshul dang bsam tshul skor la gros bsdur byas tshar rjes/ kho tshos slob grogs rnams yang bskyar tsho chung gsar ba 'gar bgo ba dang / tsho chung rer gong gi mi sna rigs mi 'dra ba re dang yang na gnyis yan chad dgos te/ tsho chung rer sa gnas kyi mi 'ga' dang dbyin ji'i mi 'ga'/ da dung po ar gyi mi 'ga' nges par yod dgos/ tsho chung re res gros bsdur dang bkod sgrig sbyong brdar bcas la brten nas 'khrab ston la gra sgrig bya dgos pa dang / tsho chung re'i slob ma yongs rdzogs 'khyab ston la zhugs dgos/ 'khrab ston 'di'i bkod sgrig dang sbyong brdar gyi go rim la slob thun — 209 —
gcig yan gyi dus tshod dgos shing / tsho chung re res slob grogs gzhan pa rnams la 'khrab ston byed dgos/ 'di ni slob thun zhig mjug rdzogs nas slob ma rnams kyis de'i nang don la go ba gting zab mo zhig lon rjes da gzod byed sgo 'di spel na ha cang bzang /17 ri mo dang de'i gsal bshad gnyis bsgrig pa (5740khri 560053719nu 07)dge rgan gyis ri mo skor zhig gra sgrig byas te slob ma rnams mi gsum nas lnga can gyi tsho chung 'gar bgo ba dang / tsho chung rer ri mo gnyis nas gsum ster pa dang de dang mnyam du ri mo rer shog leb chung chung re yang ster dkos/ tsho chung re re'i slob ma rnams kyis shog leb de dag gi ngos su ri mo'i gsal bshad thung ngu re bri dgos pa dang / de rjes tsho chung tshang ma'i ri mo dang shog leb rnams mnyam du bsres te yang bskyar gang 'dod ltar tsho chung re re la ri mo dang shog leb rnams ster dgos/de nas tsho chung dang pos ri mo'i gsal bshad cig 'don dgos pa dang tsho chung gzhan rnams kyis ri mo rnams la blta dgos shing / tsho chung dang pos gsal bshad byas pa'i ri mo de bzung yod pa'i tsho chung des nges par ri mo yar bsgrengs nas skad gsang mthon pos bshad dgos la/ de rjes tsho chung gnyis pas kho tshor byin pa'i ri mo'i gsal bshad de 'don pa dang / de ltar mu mthud du rol rtsed spel dgos/18 skar cha sum cu'i rol rtsed/ (30—50007736776) ①dge rgan gyis shog leb cig gi ngos su brjod bya'i kha byang dang 'brel ba'i ming rkyang skor zhig bris nas gra sgrig byed dgos la nyu nga mtha' yang slob ma rer shog leb gcig re yod dgos/ shog leb rnams bltabs nas sgam chung zhig gi nang du 'jog pa dang / dus tshod tshod 'dzin byed spyad kyi chu tshod 'khor lo zhig kyang gra sgrig bya dgos/ de nas 'dzin grwa'i slob ma rnams tsho chung ka ba dang kha —210—
ba gnyis su bgos rjes/ tsho chung ka ba'i slob ma zhig slob grogs rnams kyi mdun du yong nas gang 'dod ltar sgam chung las ming rkyang bris yod pa'i shog leb cig blangs te slob grogs rnams la tha snyad de ci zhig yin pa bshad dgos/ slob ma des skar cha sum cu'i ring la mtshams ma chad par tha snyad de'i skor gyi gtam bshad bya dgos pa dang / gal te kho rang rgyal tshe kho'i tsho chung der skar ma gnyis thob pa yin la/ kho'i gtam bshad mtshams chad nas skar cha gnyis sam gnyis yan 'gor tshe/ tsho chung kha ba'i slob grogs gang rung zhig gis skad gdangs mthon pos mtshams chad thal zer nas kur brgyab chog skabs der dge rgan gyis kho'i gtam bshad mtshams chad song zhes bsgrags tshe gtam bshad mtshams bzhag nas tsho chung kha bar skar ma gcig ster dgos/ de rjes tsho chung kha ba'i nang gi mtshams chad thal zer nas kur rgyag mkhan de slob grogs rnams kyi mdun du song nas skar cha sum cu'i ring la mtshams ma chad par tha snyad de'i skor gyi gtam bshad bya dgos pa dang /gal te kho rang rgyal tshe kho'i tsho chung la skar ma gcig thob pa red/ tsho chung ka ba'i slob grogs rnams kyis nan tan sgos nyan nas/ gtam bshad mtshams chad min la mnyam 'jog bya dgos/ gal te slob grogs shig gis bshad mtshams chad song zhes 'ur brgyab tshe tsho chung ka bar ska ra ma gcig thob/skabs der kur rgyag mkhan slob ma de la yang bskyar skar cha sum cu'i ring la gtam bshad pa'i go skabs shig thob pa yin la rgyal tshe yang skar ma gcig thob pa yin/ skar cha sum cu 'gor rjes tsho chung kha ba'i slob ma zhig bdams nas tha snyad gsar ba zhig gang 'dod ltar len du bcug nas yang bskyar rol rtsed kyi mgo brtsam dgos/ 'di ltar dus tshod thon rag bar du rol rtsed rtse chog19 gsum ge gnyis gcig (3—2— 1 )slob mar skar ma bcu tsam gyi dus tshod byin nas cha rgyus yod pa'i brjod bya zhig skar ma gsum ring la bshad rgyur gra sgrig byed du 'jug dgos pa dang / slob ma tshos zin tho nyung tsam zhig bkod — 211 —
nas gra sgrig byed pa las rang gi bshad bya de ji ma ji bzhin du blor 'dzin mi rung / tsho chung rer slob ma gnyis re bgo dgos pa dang slob grogs ka ba smru gtam bshad mkhan dang slob grogs kha ba ni nyan pa po yin/ slob grogs ka ba rnams kyis skar ma gsum ring la gtam bshad bya dgos pa dang / dge rgan gyis dus tshod thon pa na brda gtong dgos/ de nas slob ma'i 'dug rogs brjes te thengs gnyis par slob grogs ka ba rnams kyis skar ma gnyis ring la gtam bshad de yang bskyar spel dgos pa dang / de'i nang du kho tshos nges par skar ma gsum ring gi gtam bshad kyi nang don tshang ma 'dus ci thub la 'bad dgos/ de rjes slob ma'i 'dug rogs rnams yang thengs gcig la brjes nas slob grogs ka ba rnams kyis skar ma gcig ring la gtam bshad de yang bskyar bya dgos pa dang /de'i nang du kho tshos nges par skar ma gnyis ring gi gtam bshad kyi nang don tshang ma 'dus ci thub la 'bad dgos/ de mjug rdzogs pa na slob grogs ka ba rnams ni nyan pa po dang slob grogs kha ba rnams ni gtam bshad mkhan yin pa'i 'gan bgos te rol rtsed mu mthud du spel dgos/20 mtshams mi chad par bshad pa/ (56697lnga rdzo 76)dge rgan gyis ri mo mang po yod pa'i shog bu zhig dang chu tshod 'khor lo zhig gam yang na skar cha'i chu tshod cig gra sgrig byas rjes/ 'dzin grwa'i slob ma rnams tsho chung ka ba dang kha ba gnyis su bgo ba dang / chu tshod 'khor lo'am yang na skar cha'i chu tshod steng du dus yun ha cang thung ngu zhig gtan 'khel byas ( dper na skar ma gcig lta bu) te dus tshod ci tsam yod pa slob ma rnams la bshad mi rung / de nas ri mo de tsho chung ka ba'i nang gi slob ma zhig la ster pa dang / slob ma des nges par ri mo de dang 'brel ba'i kha tshig cig bsgrig dgos te/ dper na/ nam mkha' na byi'u zhig 'phur bzhin 'dug dang rtswa thang du 'brog pa'i sbra khyim mang po yod ces pa lta bu/ skabs der dge rgan gyis slob ma'i tha snyad bkol stangs dang brda sprod kyi thad nas nor 'khrul yod med la bltas nas tshig de — 211 —
'grig min thag gcod dgos/ gal te mi 'grig na slob mar dag bcos byed du 'jug pa dang yang na kha tshig gzhan zhig bsgrig tu 'jug dgos/zlo gal te kha tshig bsgrigs pa 'grig tshe slob ma des ri mo de tsho chung kha ba'i nang gi slob grogs gang rung zhig la sprad chog de nas tsho chung kha ba'i nang gi slob grogs des kha tshig mi 'dra ba gzhan zhig bsgrig dgos pa dang / ri mo de tsho chung gnyis ku'i bar nas phar ster tshur len byed bzhin yod la slob grogs re res kha tshig mi 'dra ba re bsgrig dgos/dge rgan gyis gtan 'khel byas pa'i dus tshod de thon pa na brda ston pa'am yang na skar cha'i chu tshod kyi sgra grag pa dang / skabs der ri mo lag tu bzung yod pa'i slob ma de dra rgyar tshud pa yin pas pham pa dang tsho chung gzhan der skar ma gcig thob pa yin/ de ltar mu mthud du rol rtsed kyi rgyun bskyangs te grub 'bras legs po zhig thob rag bar du rtse dgos/mdor na/ gong du bkod pa'i phyi gling gi slob khrid byed sgo 'di rnams slob thun gyi skabs su gang 'tsham gyis bkol tshe slob mar rang 'gul sgos slob sbyong byed du 'jug thub pa dang / kho tsho'i phyogs yongs kyi nus pa skyed sring byed thub pa/ sgos su dgag gzhag dang bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa gong 'phel du gtong thub pa/ gzhan da dung sbyangs zin pa'i shes bya rnams bkol spyod byed thub par ma zad/ spro snang ldan pa'i sgo nas slob gnyer byed pa sogs la phan pa nges can zhig yod par gdon mi za/ de bas rgya che ba'i rang re'i slob grwa chung 'bring che gsum gyi dge rgan rnams kyis byed sgo 'di dag bkol rgyu ha cang gal che zhing / rtsom 'di'i nang du nor ba dang skyon gyi cha yod pa rnams la dgongs 'char dang skyon brjod gang mang gnang rogs mdzod/mchan 'grel/① nyis stong bcu lo'i zla bcu bar kho bo phyi gling gi slob khrid byed sgo'i dpe cha zhig bsgyur pa'i las gzhi zhig gi nang du zhugs pa dang dpe cha de'i ming la byed sgo (84ṣ+ṭha ca) zhes btags yod/ de ni674518zhes pa'i tshogs — 213 —
pa zhig gis par du bskrun pa'i glog rdul gyi dpe cha zhig red/ de'i nang du slob khrid kyi byed sgomi 'dra ba drug cu re gcig bkod yod pa las 'dir nye bar mkho ba nyi shu bdams nas mtshams sbyor byas pa yin/⑨ dri ba rnams go sla ba'i skabs su dge rgan gyis sgo sam ngos la dris lan rnams ma bris par slob ma rnams la yang dag pa'i dris lan 'bri ru bcug chog pa dang dris lan thog mar 'bri mkhan der skar ma thob pa yin/① byed sgo 'di spel skabs slob ma rnams la yang dag pa dang nor ba'i tshig re ste bsdoms pas tshig gnyis re shog leb ngos su 'bri ru bcug nas de rnams khug ma zhig gi nang du 'jog pa dang / slob ma zhig gis gang 'dod ltar shog leb gcig blangs te skad gdangs mthon pos klog 'don byas na'ang chog ste/ tsho chung re'i slob ma dang po des tshig de 'grig min thag bcad rjes rkub stegs thog tu sdod dgos pa dang /de rjes mu mthud du slob ma gzhan zhig gis khug ma'i nang gi shog leb cig blangs nas skad gdangs mthon pos klog 'don byas te mu mthud du rol rtsed rtse ru bcug chog① dus tshod yod tshe thengs gsum yan brgyud chog pas gtso bo dus tshod yod med la rag las pa yin/① slob ma rer tha snyad re nges par yod dgos/pya dge rgan gyis gtam bshad mkhan la las tshig dang ming rkyang / rgyan tshig sogs bskyar zlos byas mi chog pa'i sgrig lam bzos te byed sgo 'di je dka' ru btang chog pa dang / slob ma tshos yun / da / lta bu sogs zer mi chog par gtan 'khel byas nas skar ma gcig gi ring la mtshams ma chad par gtam bshad spel du bcug chogdu dge rgan gyis slob mar mdzub ston byas te tshig nor ba rnams la dag bcos byed du 'jug dgos pa red/—214—
rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod la rags tsam dpyad pa/gleng slong ba'i gzhi/de yang rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di'i lo ngo stong tsho mang po'i rtsom rig byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus khrod du/ rim bzhin gangs can ljongs 'di'i rigs mthun skye 'gro yongs kyi mos khams dang mthun zhing mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos 'bor chen zhig grub yod la/ de ni bod kyi rig gnas kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig yin par ma zad/ mes rgyal rig gnas kyi bang mdzod nang gi 'od stong 'phro ba'i nor bu rin thang bral ba zhig kyang red/ yin na yang da lta'i dus 'dir kha cig gis bod kyi gna' rabs brtsams chos rnams ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi rjes 'jug pa rnams kyi smyug rtse nas thon pa yin pas nang bstan gyi dgongs don kho na ston zhing / sems gtso smra ba'i phyogs su lhung bas da lta'i dus rabs dang mi 'tsham pas/ bod kyi gna' rabs rtsom rig spangs nas rgya nag dang nub gling gi rtsom rig las legs cha bsdus te bod kyi deng rabs kyi rtsom rig spel dgos zhes ma brtag gya tshom du smra ba ni ji 'dra'i dgod bro ba zhig red ang / deng 'dir 'dzam gling steng gi shes rig dar rgyas che ba'i mi rigs gang zhig yin rung /de dag la mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i gna' rabs kyi rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa —215 —
re yod la/ de'i rmang gzhi la brten nas rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas las legs cha bsdus te deng rabs kyi rig gnas spel ba ni sus kyang bsnyon du med pa zhig yin/ de'i phyir gna' rabs rtsom rig la ma brten pa'i deng rabs kyi rtsom rig yan gar pa zhig yod mi srid la/gzhan gyi legs cha ma bsdus par gna' rabs rtsom rig kho nar brten na rtsom rig la 'phel rgyas chen po 'byung mi srid/ des na 'dir dpyad yul du gyur pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 〈sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod〉 'di nyid ni byung rim kha tshang zhing brjod bya'i don gsal ba/ ming mngon brjod dang 'brel zhing rjod byed kyi tshig la snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis che cher spras pa/ tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs pa sogs kyi khyad chos ldan pas rang blos ci lcogs kyis de la dpyad pa gtong khul re byas na/ deng rabs kyi rtsom rig la blo kha kun nas phyogs pa'i slob gnyer pa rnams kyis yab mes dang dam pa gong ma rnams kyi brtsams chos kyi yon tan mthong nas de la gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang ba dang / de las yar thon dang dge mtshan ldan pa'i bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal gyi cha bsdus te gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs na/ deng rabs kyi rtsom rig gong du 'phel ba la phan cung zad thogs nges yin snyam pa'i kun slong rnam dag gis yid kun nas bslangs te spro bas dpyad rtsom 'di nyid bri mgo brtsams pa yin/dang yo/ 〈sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod〉 kyi khungs bstan pa/mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ 99rang re'i mkhas pa rnams kyi rnam dpyod kyi 'char tshul/ rtsom pa'i sgrig stangs/ chas dang cho ga sogs sgo gsum gyi byed pa thams cad la til la til mar gyi tshul du rgya gar pa'i shan gyis khyab nas yod cing /〉〉 ( sha 8) zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/〈sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod〉 'di'i brjod bya'i sa bon yang gna' bo'i rgya gar gyi brtsams chos las blangs pa zhig yin/ de yang kun gyis shes gsal ltar rgya gar gyi rgyal po rab gsal du — 216—
grags pa de'i sras chos rgyal dge ba'i dbang po mchog la bram ze dga' ba'i grags pa zhes pas ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs te rtsom dgos pa'i skul ma nan mo mdzad pa dang / de la bar du chos rgyal rang gi grogs po na ka zhes bya bas ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu btus nas rtsom pa po chos rgyal dge dbang la mthun rkyen gang legs bskrun te/ rgya gar lho phyogs pa'i snyan ngag gi lam srol spyad nas rtsoms shig ces bskul pas/ dga' ba dang dad pa chen pos yal 'dab brgya rtsa bdun gyi bdag nyid can gyi 〈dpag bsam 'khri shing〉 brtsams pa dang / phyis su bkra shis kyi grangs longs pa'i phyir du khong gis sras la yal 'dab cig rtsoms shig ces bskul pa ltar sras zla ba'i dbang pos yal 'dab mtha' ma brtsams pa de'i ming la 〈rgyal po sprin bzhon gyi rtogs pa brjod pa〉 zhes zer pa dang /des snyan ngag ring mo 〈dpag bsam 'khri shing〉 zhes pa de yongs su rdzogs par byas/ da dung rgya gar gyi rje bo dpal ldan dga' ba'i lhas go sla ba'i zlos gar gyi rtsom rig 〈klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar〉 zhes bya ba zhig brtsams pa nang don gyi cha nas 〈dpag bsam 'khri shing〉 gi nang du bzhugs pa'i 〈rgyal po sprin bzhon gyi rtogs brjod〉 dang 'dra ba ni de gnyis kyi brjod bya'i sa bon ston pa'i 'khrungs rabs las blangs pa'i gnad 'di la thug dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i dus su shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 〈snyan ngag me long ma〉 dang / 〈dpag bsam 'khri shing〉 〈klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar〉 sogs bod yig tu bsgyur pa dang / mthar dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus su rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi mas chos rgyal dge dbang gi brtsams chos mang du gzigs pa dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi che ba brjod nas dge ba'i las bsags pa/ nang bstan chos lugs kyi rma med pa'i dgongs pa kun la bsgrag pa bcas kyi ched du/ 〈dpag bsam 'khri shing〉 gi yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad pa 〈rgyal po sprin bzhon gyi rtogs brjod〉 dang 〈klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar〉 gnyis gzhir bzung nas snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di nyid brtsams pa red/—211—
zhib 'jug dang bden don/snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i mjug tu yang 99dpal ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur pa sprin gyi bzhon pa'i rtogs brjod mkha' 'gro rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyud mangs ngo mtshar rna ba'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni dpag bsam 'khri shing dang klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gyi don 'grel gyi tshul du11 ( shanya67—968) zhes gsungs yod pa las kyang nga tshos gsal por shes thub/gnyis pa/ 〈sprin bzhon rtogs brjod〉 kyi brjod bya'i nang don dang bsam blo'i rang bzhin/snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 〈sprin bzhon rtogs brjod〉 kyi brjod bya'i nang don 'di lta ste/sngon rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal po sprin gyi tog ces bya ba zhig byung ba dang / de dang btsun mo chos spyod ma gnyis la sras shig 'khrungs pa de'i ming la sprin gyi bzhon pa zhes gsol/ de nyid rim bzhin nar son pa dang rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la bslabs pas gzhon dus nas mkhas par gyur/ de nas yab yum gnyis kyis rgyal srid sras la gtad de dben gnas ma la yar phyin/ shul du sras sprin bzhon gyis rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs nas mtshan snyan phyogs kun tu khyab na'ang des kyang rgyal srid spangs te dben gnas ma la yar gshegs/ de ru yab yum gnyis dang mjal bas dga' spro tshad med skyes shing me tog gi tshal du phyin pas lha mo gau ri mchod pa'i bu mo ma la ya dang 'phrad/ rgyal bu de la yid chags pa dang des kyang rgyal bu'i mdzes sdug la sems pa shor/ bu mo ma la ya'i pha rgyal po kun gyi dbyig dang rigs 'dzin sprin gyi tog gnyis khong gnyis kyi gnyen don la yid 'thad byung bas skyel bsu rgya chen gyi gnyen ston gzab rgyas shig mdzad pa dang / rgyal bu sprin bzhon gyis bu mo ma la ya can ma zhes bya ba btsun mor bzhes zhes gtam snyan phyogs kun la khyab/ gnyen ston gyi cho ga bshams nas nyin drug 'das pa'i phyi nyin rgyal bu mtsho 'gram du skyo sangs la phebs pa na/ mtsho ngogs su klu rgyal gyi lung gis zin pa'i bya khyung gi zas su babs pa'i —218—
rtags gos dmar bcings pa'i klu dung gi gtsug dang de'i ma gnyis smre sngags 'don bzhin mya ngan khur gyis mnan yod pa mthong / rgyal bus gtam dris te rgyu mtshan rnams rtogs pas snying rjes yid kun nas g.yos te spyan chab shor ba dang / bu'i tshab tu lus srog gtong bas sdug bsngal ma byed ces gsungs kyang dung gi gtsug 'thad pa ma byung / de nas skabs shig dung gi gtsug mtsho ngogs su song shul du nyug rum pa zhig gis rigs 'dzin yum gyis gnyen rtags su bskur pa'i gos dmar khyer yong ba rgyal bu la 'byor ba dang rgyal bus de bcings nas klu dung gi gtsug yin khul gyis bya khyung 'bab sa'i rdo chen steng du bzhugs shing / de'i mod la bya khyung mgyogs pa'i shugs kyis 'ongs te rgyal bu la mchus bsnun nas khrag gis sbags par byas/ rgyal bu'i gtsug rgyan khrag dang bcas rgyal po sprin gyi tog gi bste gnas su lhung bas ma la ya can dang bcas pa dran pa shor ba dang /brgyal ba las sangs te mkha' lding 'bab stegs su phyin pas khrag gis sbags pa'i rgyal bu mthong zhing / gdung bas gzir nas smre sngags 'don bzhin dran pa yang yang shor bas bya khyung yang 'gyod pa tshad med skyes nas bdud rtsi len du lha yul la 'phur/ ma la ya can gyis lha mo gau ri la 'khang ra byed bzhin bsregs khang rtsig pa'i dus su/ srid pa'i yum gcig lha mo gau ris spyi blugs kyi chu bran nas shes brjod kyi dbyangs bsgrags pa dang mnyam du sprin gyi bzhon pa sos par gyur/ yab yum bcas pa dga' nas lha mo gau ri la phyag 'tshal/ de'i mod la bya khyung gis bdud rtsi phab pas khos zos pa'i klu rnams kyang sos/ de nas lha mo gau ris rgyal bu sprin bzhon gling bzhi'i rgyal por dbang bskur cing / skad cig la glang chen dkar po dang khri sogs rtsol med du byung ba dang / gnam nas me tog gi char babs shing bstod dbyangs bsgrags/ de tshe sprin gyi bzhon pa 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal por gyur ces pa ni snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya'i nang don yin/ gsham du gong gi brjod don gzhir byas nas snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin skor cung zad gleng pa la gtso bo gnyis su 'dus te/— 219 —
1 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la snying po med par bstan nas dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub par skul pa/snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di'i nang du/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa yin pas 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la snying po til 'bru tsam yang med pa dang / zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba yin pas de las thar dgos na nges par dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub dgos pa bstan yod de/ rgyal po sprin gyi tog la rgyu nor mnga' thang phun sum tshogs pa ldan pa dang / rang 'khor blon 'bangs kun gyis gtsug gi rgyan du bkur pa/ phyogs so so'i rgyal po las khyad du 'phags shing snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu khyab yod na'ang / rgyal srid dang rgyu nor mnga' thang la chags zhen spu tsam yang med par sras sprin bzhon la gtad de btsun mo dang mnyam du dben gnas ma la yar phyin pa dang /shul du sras sprin bzhon gyis rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs nas snyan pa'i grags pa kun la khyab cing 'dzad mtha' med pa'i rgyu nor longs spyod ldan na yang / des kyang yod tshad blos btang ste dben gnas ma la yar gshegs pa ni dam pa'i lha chos 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa'i ched du yin zhing / de las srid pa'i phun tshogs la snying po ci yang med par bstan pa dang / rgyu nor longs spyod 'dzoms kyang bsags pa'i mtha' mar 'dzad par 'gyur bas de la yid chags pa ni dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub pa'i gegs yin pa/ las kun las dam pa'i lha chos bsgrubs pa gtso bo yin pa'i nang bstan chos lugs kyi dgongs don bstan nas mi rnams kyi blo kha chos la 'jug par skul ma mdzad yod/ yang rgyal bu dang bu mo ma la ya can ma gnyis gnyen bsdebs pa'i gtam snyan kun la khyab pa'i dus der rgyal bu'i dpal 'byor la sdang ba'i blo can ma tang gis rgyal bu sprin bzhon gyi rgyal srid brlag 'dod kyi blo bcangs pa las kyang rgyu nor mnga' thang dang khyim thab bsgrigs pa rnams ni mi dge ba'i las gsog byed kyi rgyu yin pa dang / de la sems chags pa'i skye bo la mi dge ba'i las ni mi 'dod bzhin —220—
du 'ongs pas bde ba nam yang med pa/ srid pa'i phun tshogs la snying po ci yang mi 'dug pa dang de dor nas dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub dgos tshul bstan yod/ da dung rgyal bu ma la ya can ma dang 'phrad pas yid kho mor chags pa dang kho mo'i sems kyang rgyal bur shor nas gnyen bsdebs pa las/rgyal bru yang so skye phal pa dang 'dra bar bu mo mdzes mar chags pa'i sems ldan pa bstan nas ma la ya can dang mnyam du 'tsho bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa shin tu che ba dang pha ma gnyis 'dzoms kyi dus su yang rang lus dung gi gtsug gi srog bsrung phyir phangs med du dor ba las kyang 'khor ba'i phun tshogs la chags zhen skye mi rung ba dang / dge ba'i las gsog ched yod tshad blo sa gtong dgos pa bstan te mi rnams dam pa'i lha chos la 'jug dgos tshul bstan pa red/2 sbyin pa btang tshul dang de'i 'bras bu brjod nas dam pa'i lha chos la 'jug par skul pa/snyan ngag gi bstan ba cos 'di'i nang du zang zing phun sum tshogs pa'i nor la sred pa cung tsam yang med par sbyin pa btang ba dang / de la phan 'bras ga 'dra yod pa gtso bor brjod nas mi rnams lha chos la 'jug par skul ma mdzad yod de/ rgyal po sprin gyi tog gi che ba brjod dus 99'dod rgu 'jo ba'i dpag bsam ljon shing dang / /〉〉 ( sha nya48) zhes dang / yang rgyal sras sprin bzhon gyis rgyal srid skyong ba brjod dus/ 99gang gi phyag ni dpag bsam 'dab bzhin 'dod rgu sbyin la rnam par brkyangs/ / ( sha nya51 ) 17 zhes bkod de/ rgyal po dang sras gang yin yang rgyu nor mnga' thang la yid mi chags par dge ba'i las sbyin gtong la dga' ba dang / de la brten nas snyan grags rgyas pa'i tshul bstan te mi rnams la dge ba'i las bsgrub par gdams pa dang / lhag par du rgyal bu sprin bzhin gyis gnyen bsgrigs nas yun ring bo ma lon pa'i snying sdug bu mo ma la ya can ma dang yab yum sogs bskyur nas lus mkha' lding la phangs med du sbyin pas/ sdig las la blo mig ldongs — 221 —
pa'i bya khyung blo 'gyod skyes te phyin chad sdig pa'i las mi bsags pa'i dam bcas pa dang / lha mo gau ris chu bran nas rgyal bu sos pa/ bya khyung gis bdud rtsi'i char phab pas khos zos pa'i klu rnams kyang sos pa gtso bor bkod de/ mi rnams la dus dang rnam pa kun tu gzhan la gnod pa mi skyel bar gzhan phan gyi bsam pa bcangs te dkar po'i las bsags par 'bad dgos pa dang / las dge ba las 'bras bu bde ba 'byung bar bstan pa/ rgyal bu sprin bzhon gyis lus sbyin pa des mi rnams la las dkar po bsags pa'i mig dpe tshad mthon po zhig bstan nas sbyin pa'i phan nus bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod de chos la 'jug par skul ma mdzad yod/ srid pa'i phun tshogs la snying bo med pa dang sbyin pa'i las dang de'i 'bras bu gtso bor bkod de dam pa'i chos la 'jug dgos tshul bstan pa ni rtogs brjod 'di'i bsam blo'i rang bzhin yin zhing / bsam blo'i rang bzhin de lta bu zhig yin dgos don ni rtsom pa po nyid khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i btsun pa zhig yin pas khong gi bsam blo dang / 'jig rten lta tshul/ kun spyod sogs la nang bstan chos lugs kyi lta ba zab mos tshod 'dzin byas yod pa dang / ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khrungs rabs gleng nas de'i che ba brjod na/ dad mos nyams pa rnams kyi yid la dad pa skyes pa dang / dad mos can rnams kyi dad pa dang gus pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba// kun gyis nang bstan chos lugs kyi dgongs don rtogs pa la brten nas dam pa'i lha chos bsgrub par blo phyogs pa bcas kyi ched du/ mu tig srad bur brgyus pa bzhin brtsams chos 'di'i mgo nas mjug bar nang bstan chos lugs kyi lta bas khyab yod/gsum pa/ 〈sprin gyi rtogs brjod〉 kyi sgyu rtsalakhyad chos/dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i yar sngon du bod la snyan ngag gi rig pa yod kyang de 'dra'i khyab bdal du song med/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i skabs su shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 〈snyan —227—
ngag me long ma〉 bod du bsgyur rjes/ 〈snyan ngag me long ma'i〉 gzhung lugs ltar brtsams pa'i brtsams chos 'bor chen zhig rabs dang rim par thon pa dang chabs cig bod kyi snyan ngag gi rig pa dang rgyan sogs sngar las 'thus tshang du gyur/ rgya nag pa 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi mas mdzad pa'i snyan ngag 'di thog mtha' bar gsum du snyan ngag me long ma'i lugs ltar brtsams pa zhig yin pas tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs shing / tsheg bar mi gcig pa'i sho lo ka phan tshun bsdebs yod pas klog pa por sun snang mi skyes pa dang / snyan ngag me long ma'i rgyan rnams gang la gang 'tsham gyis bkol yod pas bklags tshe rna bar snyan zhing skabs bab kyi brjod bya'i don gsal ba/da dung snyan ngag gi rnam pa can gyi gtam rgyud 'di'i byung rim la kyag kyog ldan zhing 'char yan ring lugs kyi mtshon thabs kyang spyad yod pas klog mkhan la bde sdug bar ma'i tshor ba bskyed pa sogs ni 〈sprin bzhon rtogs brjod〉 kyi sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos yin/ gsham du de'i skor cung zad gleng pa la/1 tshig dang sho lo ku'i sdeb sbyor legs shing go sla ba/snyan ngag gi brtsams chos 'di la sgra gdangs 'jam pa'i tha snyad bkol ba mang bas bklags tshe kha la bde zhing / yongs su ma grags pa'i mngon brjod brda rnying gab tshig sogs kyis bcings med pas go sla ba/ tshig rkang gcig chad na'ang skabs bab kyi brjod bya'i don ston pa dang snyan ngag gi nyams 'don pa sogs la gnod pas dgos med kyi tshig lhag med pa dang / snyan ngag me long ma'i lugs ltar brtsams pa yin pas tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs shing rna bar snyan pa la sogs pa'i khyad chos ldan gshis klog pa po rnams kyi yid dbang cig car du 'phrog par byed de/ brtsams chos 'di'i sho lo ka nyer drug pa rgyal bo sprin gyi tog dang btsun mo gnyis dben gnas su gshegs khar sras sprin gzhon gyi mdun du lhags te rgyal srid mi dgos ma zer bar skyongs zhes par (9dam pa — 223 —
rnams ni gzhan gyi phyir/ / 'jig rten las la'ang dga' bas 'jug / 'dam na gnas kyang pad mo ni/ / sbrang rtsi'i zas can yid 'phrog byed/ /〉〉 ( sha nya50 ) ces pa'i sho lo ka 'di lta bu la mtshon na/yongs su ma grags pa'i mngon brjod dang brda rnying sogs kyis bcings med pas go sla ba dang /dgos med kyi tha snyad lhag ma gcig kyang med pas tshig la nying bsdus kyi rang bzhin ldan pa/ tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs pa'i sgo nas skabs bab kyi brjod bya'i don te/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni gzhan don bsgrub pa'i ched du 'jig rten khyim pa'i las yin yang spro dgas 'jug pa dpe dang sbyar nas gsal bor bstan yod/ de'i sho lo ku'i sdeb sbyor la'ang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos ldan te/tsheg bar bdun ma'i tshigs bcad dang / tsheg bar dgu ma'i tshigs bcad/ tsheg bar bco lnga can gyi tshigs bcad rnams phan tshun bsdebs nas brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di la khyon bsdoms pas sho lo ka brgya dang re dgu yod pa las mang che shos ni tsheg bar bdun ma'i tshigs bcad dang tsheg bar dgu ma'i tshigs bcad phan tshun bsdebs yod pa dang / mtshams mtshams su tsheg bar bco lnga'i tshigs bcad sho lo ka re bsdebs yod pa de ni rtsom pa pos bsam bzhin du de ltar mdzad pa min par brjod bya'i don mtshon pa'i dgos pa ltar rang thugs kyis thon pa'i snang ba ster zhing / des ro mi gcig pa'i zas la rol pa bzhin klog pa por mu mthud du bklag 'dod kyi 'dun pa bskyed par ma zad/ snyan ngag gi brtsams chos 'di'i lus kyi bu mor rgyan cha'i phras brgyan pa lta bu'i nus pa thon yod pa ni brtsams chos 'di'i tsheg bar mi 'dra ba'i sho lo ka rnams phan tshun bsdebs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig red/ gong gi phyogs 'di gnyis las nga tshos shes thub pa ni snyan ngag gi brtsams chos 'di'i tha snyad phan tshun sdeb legs pas tshig rkang la mdzes pa'i nyams thon pa dang / tshig rkang phan tshun sdeb legs pas sho lo kur mdzes pa'i nyams thon pa/sho lo ka phan tshun bar 'brel chags pas tshig dang sho lo lnga'i sdeb sbyor legs pa'i sgo nas rtogs brjod 'di nyid kyi brjod bya'i don gsal bor bstan yod/— 224—
2 snyan ngag gi rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/mkhas pa'i dbang po zur mkhar pa blo gros rgyal pos/ rgyal po lang tshos dregs gyur kyang / /rgyan med pa na skye bos gleng / / de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ / bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/ / ces dang / rgyal po dge ba'i dbang pos/ mkhas pa nyid ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min/ / mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa rnams ni ne tso'i klog dang 'dra/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin du bod kyi sngon byon mkhas pa re res snyan ngag gi gzhung la legs par sbyangs te rang rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i tshig gi sdeb stangs dang rgyan gyi sbyor stangs re goms yod pa dang / de la brten nas rtogs brjod dang rnam thar/ bsla ba bya dang mgur ma/bstod gsol dang legs bshad sogs rtsom pa zhig yin pas rtogs brjod 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum du'ang rgyan sna tshogs gang la gang 'tsham sgos spras te skabs bab kyi brjod bya'i don gsal por bstan yod de/ sho lo ka brgyad par rgyal po sprin gyi tog gi che ba brjod dus/ 99de yi zhabs skyes me tog dkar/ / phyogs kyi sa skyong thod du mdzes/ / grags pa'i rnga ni 'jig rten na/ / yon tan dbyu gu nyid kyis brdungs/ /11 ( sha nya48 ) zhes gzugs rgyan dang sbyar te rgyal po sprin gyi tog ni rgyal po gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa dang / khong la thun mong ma yin pa'i yin tan ldan pas snyan grags phyogs kun tu khyab pa gsal bor bstan pa dang / sho lo ka bcu gnyis par (6'on kyang stobs kyis bsdigs min zhing / / zas nor thabs kyis brid min yang / / phyogs kyi rgyal blon ma lus pa/ /byams pas btud de 'di yi chos/ /〉〉 ( ke 949 ) zhes pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gtso bor bkod de phyogs so so'i rgyal blon thams cad rgyal po sprin gyi tog gi rgyal khrims chos bzhin bskyangs pa la rjes su yi rang byed pa gsal bor bstan pa dang / sho lo ka nyer gcig par (tsamatho ris dpal 'byor brgya yis rnam rtsen yang / / gzhan don skad cig tsam yang g.yel pa med/ / chu gter rlung gis —225 —
rol pa dang 'grogs kyang / / rba rlabs dus las 'da' ba srid na med/ /〉〉 ( sha nya50) ces zla bo'i dngos po'i dpe dang sbyar te rgyal bu sprin bzhon la rgyu nor longs spyod ldan yang gzhan don bsgrub par skad cig tsam la'ang mi g.yeng bar 'bad brtson byed pa bstan pa dang / yang sho lo ka brgyad cu gya dgu par (4de tshe bser bus skyod pa yis/ / sa 'dzin 'khri shing g.yo ba dag /gzhon nus thub chod ma mdzad ces/ / brtse bas ring nas bzlog pa bzhin / /3〉 ( sha )58 ) zhes pa sems med rab rtog dang sbyar te rgyal bu sprin bzhon mkha' lding 'bab sa'i rdo chen steng du bzhugs rjes khor yug gi ljon pa rnams rlung gis bskyod pas phar g.yo tshur g.yo byed pa'i rnam pa des rgyal bu la mi 'os pa'i bya ba ma bsgrub ces brtse ba chen pos 'gog pa dang 'dra zhes brjod de brjod don gsal bor bstan pa dang / yang sho lo ka brgya dang zhe gcig par 99brnag dka'i sdug bsngal me lces bsregs gyur kyang / / snying khong tsan dan chu las lhag par grang / / mya ngan ri bo'i khur gyis non gyur kyang / /rnam rig rgyu ba dpyid kyi rlung ltar 'phyo/ /〉〉 (sha nya64) zhes pa 'gal ba'i rgyan dang sbyar te sprin bzhon mkha' lding gis zos pas bu mo ma la ya can mar bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal skyes pa bstan pa dang / sho lo ka brgya dang zhe brgyad par 99gzhon nu'i lus kyi gdungs pa dang / / mdzes pa'i mya ngan mnyam du sangs/ / 'dab bzang zhi ba'i brtul zhugs dang / / gdengs can dga' ba lhan cig 'phel/ /〉〉 ( sha nya65 ) zhes pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan dang sbyar te rgyal sras slar sos pa dang chabs cig bu mo ma la ya can ma'i sdug bsngal sangs pa dang / khung chen gyi sems rgyud zhi bar gyur nas bdud rtsi'i chus bran pa dang mnyam du klu rigs rnams kyang slar sos te yid la dga' ba 'phel ba gsal bor bstan/ da dung phreng ba'i dpe dang / don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ rgyu'i rgyan/rab spel gyi rgyan sogs kyis spras pa mang yang re re bzhin 'chad na yig tshogs mang bar 'gyur bas 'dir ma spros/ mdor na skabs bab kyi brjod bya'i don gyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas rgyan sna tshogs gang la gang 'tsham gyis bkod yod pa des skabs bab kyi brjod don gsal bor mtshon pa la —226—
nus pa chen po thon yod pa ni rtogs brjod 'di'i rgyan gyi sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos yin la/ rtsom rig la 'jug mkhan nga tsho slob gnyer pa rnams kyi blang bya'ang yin/ de bas srol rgyun rtsom rig gi 'di dang 'di lta bu'i dge mtshan gyi cha rgyun 'dzin byas pa la brten nas rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan gyi rtsom rig gi sngon thon sgyu rtsal rnams sdud len byas te/ dus rabs gsar pa dang 'tsham zhing mi rigs kyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i brtsams chos gsar pa spel na da gzod shin tu legs snyam/3 phyi rol pa'i rig byed gtam rgyud dang sbyar ba'i kyag kyog dang ngo mtshar che ba'i byung rim/snyan ngag me long ma bod du bsgyur rjes/ bod kyi mkhas dbang rnams kyis de nyid snyan ngag bslab bya'i gzhung tshad mar byed pa dang / de ni rgya gar gyi 'tsho ba'i khor yug dang yul srol goms 'dris/ 'jig rten lta tshul dang chos lugs kyi lta ba/ rig byed gtam rgyud sogs brjod byar byas te brtsams pa'i snyan ngag gi gzhung zhig yin gshis/ bod kyi rtsom rig la rgya gar rig byed gtam rgyud kyis kyang shan shugs zab mo thebs yod pa dang / lhag par du snyan ngag gi brjod bya 'tshol ba dang dper 'god bcas kyi thad la nus pa chen po thon yod/ rtogs brjod 'di nyid kyi brjod bya'i don yang phyi rol gyi rig byed gtam rgyud la sbyar cing kyag kyog dang ngo mtshar che ba'i byung rim ldan pa'i sgo nas bstan yod pas klog pa po'i yid dbang cig car du 'gugs par byed/ rtogs brjod kyi nang du bu mo ma la ya can gyis lha mo gau ri mchod pa dang / bya khyung gis klu rigs za ba sogs ni phyi rol gyi rig byed gtam rgyud yin la/ de la brten nas brjod bya'i don kha tshang zhing byung rim kyag kyog ldan pa zhig bskrun yod de/ dang thog sras sprin bzhon la yab kyis gnang ba'i rgyal srid dang rgyu nor mnga' thang sogs thob ste rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs nas snyan grags kun tu khyab pa dang /de nas dben gnas ma la yar phyin nas yab yum gnyis dang mjal zhing bu mo mdzes ma ma la ya — 221 —
bod mi'i rus rgyud kyi ming gi gnad don 'ga' gleng pa/de yang rus rgyud kyi ming ni bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas kyi grub cha zhig yin la/ dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i nang du bod pa rnams kyis rgyun du bed spyod byed bzhin pa zhig kyang yin/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi skabs su bod yul du nang bstan chos lugs rgya cher dar ba dang gzhan pa'i rgyu rkyen du ma zhig kyang tshogs pa la brten nas bod mi'i rus rgyud kyi ming rim bzhin nyams pas deng gi dus 'dir bod pa phal mo che la rus rgyud kyi ming med pa dang / ming gcig 'dra can mang po thon pas rtsom pa po dang ched las mkhas pa skor zhig gis rang ming gi mgor sa ming sogs sbyar nas ming gcig 'dra can rnams las khyad par 'byed ci thub byed pa dang / dgon pa gcig gi nang du ming gcig 'dra can rnams kyi grwa ba'i chos ming gi mgor sa ming sbyor ba dang yang na mtshang ming nas bzung ste 'bod pa/ slob grwa'i nang du'ang ming gcig 'dra can rnams khyad par 'byed ched chung 'bring che gsum du phye nas ming 'bod kyin 'dug da dung mi rigs gzhan dang 'brel 'dris byed skabs dang phyi'i rgyal khab tu 'gro dus rus rgyud kyi ming med pas stabs mi bde ba mang bo byung dang 'byung bzhin yod pas 'dir bod mi'i rus rgyud kyi ming gi gnad don skor cung zad gleng par bya/dang po/ mkhas pa snga ma'i zhib 'jug gi gnas bab/rgya bod kyi mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis bod kyi rus ming thad la zhib 'jug byas te de'i skor gyi dpyad rtsom nyi shu tsam zhig bris yod pa las 'dir gtso bo 'ga'i zhib 'jug gi 'bras bu rnams —230—
mdo tsam brjod pa la/ rtsom pa po ma grong mi 'gyur rdo rje lags kyis bod rigs la rus rgyud kyi ming mi 'dra ba 140 lhag yod pa dang / bod rigs kyi rus rgyud kyi ming mang por tshig 'grel bya rgyu yod pa ma zad/ rus rgyud kyi ming khag gcig la da dung rus bshad yod pa dang / rus rgyud kyi ming gzha na dag rnams ni rus rgyud kyi ming gi phyi mo bod mi'u gdung drug las rim par mched tshul/ nang bstan chos lugs bod du dar rjes chos sgor zhugs pa'i grwa ba rnams la chos lugs kyi nang don ldan pa'i ming btags pa des bod mi'i ming 'dogs tshul thad la shugs rkyen chen po thebs pa dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su nang bstan chos lugs la grub mtha' 'dra min sna tshogs thon pas bla ma rnams kyis rab tu byung mkhan dang byis pa rnams la dam chos kyi nang don can gyi ming btags pa de la mthong chen byas nas rus rgyud kyi ming la do snang ma byas pa dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su bod kyi rig gnas dar rgyas byung ba dang bstun nas mkhas pa rnams la paṇ+ḍi ta dang / bka' bcu ba/ rab 'byams pa/ lha rams pa/ sman rams pa sogs kyi ming thogs pa dang mkhas dbang de rnams kyi ming gi mgor yul dang gnas kyi tha snyad sbyor ba'i lugs srol dar ba des rim bzhin rus rgyud kyi ming gi tshab byas pa/ dpon 'bangs kyi rnam dbye mngon gsal du mtshon ched dpon po'i khyim rgyud kyi dpon gnas kyi go sa'i ming gis rus rgyud kyi ming gi tshab byas pas rim bzhin mi ming 'dogs tshul la rtsa ba'i 'gyur ldog byung ba dang sbrags rgyu rkyen du ma tshogs pa las rus rgyud kyi ming spyod srol de rim bzhin nyams par gyur tshul bstan yod/④rtsom pa po sga zla ba tshe ring lags kyis mi'i ming tsheg bar ches mang ba ni nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang ches nyung ba tsheg bar gcig can yod pa dang / ming ji ltar bsdu tshul dang gces ming 'dogs srol bcas gtso bor brjod de mdo dbus khams gsum so sor ming 'dogs tshul thad la rang rang gi khyad chos ldan pa bstan yodabul/ rtsom pa po dpal lhas dus rabs bcu ba'i bar du bod mi'i ming gdung rus ded nas 'dogs pa'i srol yod pa dang / bod sil bur song rjes bod mi'i ming — 231 —
'dogs tshul phun sum tshogs pa'am 'dogs tshul mi 'dra ba sna tshogs byung tshul/ dus rabs bcu pa'i dus mjug nas rus rgyud kyi ming 'dogs pa'i srol de rim bzhin nyams rgud du gyur pa dang /bod mi'i ming la bskyar zlos mang ba'i khyad chos ldan tshul sogs brjod yod/① rtsom pa po don grub tshe ring lags kyis bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming gi grub tshul spyir dmigs bsal yin pa dang / ming gcig 'dra can te bskyar zlos kyi ming dang ming ring bo can mang zhing / bod kyi dpe cha dang bstan bcos sogs kyi rtsom pa po dang lo tsā ba rnams la ming du ma yod pa/ gang zag tha dad pa'i ming gcig 'dra yin tshul/ da dung mtshan hril bo dang / bsdus ming / zhe sa'i ming / ming gzhan sogs bkol tshul mi 'dra ba mang zhing cung rnyog dra che bas bod yig gi dpe cha dang ched rtsom sogs dag sgrig byed skabs mnyam 'jog bya dgos tshul brjod yod/①yang rtsom pa po rta mgrin rgyal lags kyis bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming ji ltar byung tshul dang /bod kyi gna' rabs kyi ming 'dogs tshul/ gna' rabs bod mi'i rus rgyud kyi ming 'dogs tshul gyi dbye ba las yul gyi ming rus rgyud kyi ming du thogs pa dang / gna' rabs rgyal phran dang gzhis ga'i ming gi sgo nas rus rgyud kyi ming 'dogs srol yod tshul/ spyi tshogs steng gi srid 'dzin dpon po'i ko gnas rang gi rus rgyud kyi ming du chags tshul/ ming 'dogs tshul 'gyur ba dang rus rgyud kyi ming nyams par gyur tshul/ deng rabs bod mi'i ming 'dogs tshul gyi khyad chos tshan pa bcur bsdus nas brjod yod pa dang / rus rgyud kyi ming gi byed nus ni nye du gnyen sdeb 'gog par byed pa dang / de la rgyud 'dzin rig pa dang / rtsis gzhung / sman dpyad rig pa sogs spyi tshogs tshan rig dang lus khams rig pa'i dpyad gzhi'i rin thang ches cher lda/na pas da lta rus rgyud kyi ming 'bod srol nyams par gyur pa de rus rgyud rim bzhin nyams 'gro ba'i rtags dang 'dzam gling mi rigs gcig can du 'gyur 'gro ba'i snga ltas yin gshis kun gyis de la do snang bya rgyu ha cang gal che tshul bstan yodabupa dang / rtsom pa po rwa yum skyabs lags kyis a mdo'i mi ming la bon chos dang — 237 —
yul chos kyi shan zhugs che ba dang / dbus khams gnyis su ming tsheg bar bzhi can mang shos yin zhing / a mdo'i rong 'brog khul du rig gnas kyi rgyun ring zhing ko ba zab pas mi ming tsheg bar gsum can dar che/ yang bod rgya 'dres mtshams su gzhis chags pa'i bod mi rnams la rgya'i rus rgyud kyi ming dang bod ming mnyam du sbyar ba yod pas so sor yul dus kyi rang bzhin ldan tshul bcas brjod de/ nga tshos bu rgyud rnams la bod ming tshad ldan yang dag cig 'dogs rgyu ni bod kyi lo rgyus dang mi rigs kyi ngo bo/ rig gzhung gi rgyun gtsang ma zhig tu 'gyur ba'i gzhi dam pa zhig yin tshul bstan yod/① rtsom pa po 'jam bu mkha' 'gro tshe ring lags kyis bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming rnams ni 'dod rgyal gyi ming ma yin par de rnams la byung tshul re yod pa dang / bod la rus rgyud kyi ming gtan nas med pa min par sa cha la lar da dung rus rgyud kyi ming 'dogs bzhin yod tshul/pha ma gnyis kyi ming zur sbyar nas byis par ming 'dogs srol yod pa dang nad gdon bar chad dang tshe yi gegs sogs kyi sri gcod par dmigs nas ming 'dogs srol yod tshul sogs brjod yod/① gong du bkod pa ni zhib 'jug pa dang mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis bod kyi rus ming thad la zhib 'jug byas pa'i gnas bab yin la/ de rnams su bod mi'i rus rgyud kyi ming nyams par gyur pa ni gnad don tshabs chen zhig yin tshul skor brjod med pas gsham du de'i skor rags tsam gleng par 'dod/gnyis pa/ 'brel 'dris byed skabs kyi rus ming gi gnad don/deng gi dus 'dir spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun nas rgyal nang gi mi rigs so so'i dpal 'byor dang 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen je legs su 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / gnas gzhan par lta skor du 'gro ba dang mi rigs so so'i bar 'brel 'dris byed pa'i tshad kyang je mang du 'gro bzhin yod/ mi rigs mi 'dra ba gang yin yang rang rang la thun mong ma yin pa'i yul srol goms gshis — 233 —
re yod na yang nga tshos mi rigs gzhan gyi mi rnams dang 'brel 'dris byed dus thog mar phan tshun gyi rus rgyud kyi ming ci yin dri bar byed pa dang / rus rgyud kyi ming nas bzung ste mtshams sbyor byed pa ni rgyun ldan gyi gnas tshul zhig yin/ mi rigs gzhan pa'i mi rnams kyis nga tsho'i rus ming skor dri dus/ la las bod pa rnams la rus rgyud kyi ming med ces lan 'debs par byed pa dang / la las rus rgyud kyi ming yod kyang da lta bod pa mang shos kyis bkol spyod byed bzhin med ces brjod pa dang / yang la las bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming nyams zin pas bod pa mang che shos la rus rgyud kyi ming med pa dang de bed spyod byed pa'i gnas tshul ha cang nyung tshul bshad pa red/ gnas tshul 'dis mi rigs gzhan pa'i mi rnams kyi blo ngor bod pa rnams la ming ma gtogs rus rgyud kyi ming yod pa ma red ces pa'i bsam tshul zhig ngang ngam thugs kyis skye ru bcug yod de/ bā zhi u khyung ( glokhugu14 ) gis 99dus yun ring bo zhig nas bzung mi rigs rig pa dang dmangs srol rig pa'i blo mthun mang po zhig gis bod rigs la ming kho na las rus rgyud kyi ming med par 'dod pa dang / bod rigs re gnyis kyis rang nyid la rus rgyud kyi ming yod ces bshad kyang gzhan pas de ni ming gi sngon du khang ba'am cho lo'i ming bzhag pa tsam las ma 'das par bsams/ yang kha cig gis bshad pa ltar na ming gcig 'dra can mang po rnams phan tshun mi 'dres pa'i ched du ming gi snga rjes su las rigs dang gces ming sbyar nas khyad par phye ba red 1 ①ces gsungs/ don du nga tshor rus rgyud kyi ming gtan nas med pa min par nyams par gyur pa las lta tshul de rigs byung ba red/rus rgyud kyi ming nyams pas stabs mi bde ba'i gnas tshul mang po zhig byung dang 'byung bzhin yod de/ dper na/ nga tshos mgron khang zhig la kha par btang nas zhag sdod bya rgyu'i gtan 'khel byed pa dang / za khang zhig la 'brel gtugs byas te za ma za rgyu'i dus 'debs skabs/thog mar 'phrad pa ni rus rgyud kyi ming gi gnad don yin te/ mgron khang dang za khang gi zhabs zhu bas thog mar sku mgron gyi rus rgyud kyi ming ci yin dang rus ming la ci zer zhes dri bar byed pa dang /— 234—
nga tshos ming gi thog ma'i yig 'bru gcig po de rus rgyud kyi ming yin khul gyis pha rol po la brda sprod par byed/ de nas mgron khang du zhag sdod byed du song ba dang za khang du phyin tshe/ zhabs zhu bas sku zhabs ga ge mo dang lcam mo ga ge mo yin min dris dus/ nga tshos rus rgyud kyi ming ma yin pa'i ming gi thog ma'i yig 'bru gcig po de rus rgyud kyi ming yin khul gyis pha rol po la bshad
