bzhin yod pa dang / zhabs zhu bas nga tsho'i ming gi thog ma'i yig 'bru gcig po de rus rgyud kyi ming du 'khrul te rin chen don grub zer pa zhig yin na rin sku zhabs dang lha mo sgrol ma zer pa zhig yin na lha lcam mo zer nas 99rus rgyud kyi ming〉〉 nas bzung ste 'bod pa red/ yang skabs 'gar mi gzhan dang 'brel 'dris byed skabs rang gi rus rgyud kyi ming ma gtogs ming gsal bor bshad mi 'dod pa'i skabs kyang yod la/ de'i dus su rus rgyud kyi ming yod pa zhig yin na de gcig pu pha rol por bshad nas ngo sprod byas chog la/ rus rgyud kyi ming gcig 'dra can gyi mi cung mang bas gzhan pas rus rgyud kyi ming rtogs pa tsam gyis mi su yin gsal bor shes par mi 'gyur te/ dper na/ sga zla ba tshe ring la sga sku zhabs dang / ldong tshe ring lha mo la ldong lcam mo zhes 'bod du bcug chog pa red/ des na nga tsho bod pa rnams kyi rus rgyud kyi ming spyod srol nyams par gyur pas mi rigs gzhan dang 'brel 'dris byed par ha cang stabs mi bde bar gyur/de las gzhan da dung deng gi dus 'dir na gzhon pho mo rnams kyi gnyen don pha mas thag gcod pa'i gnas tshul je nyung du gyur pa dang / lhag par slob chen mthar phyin nas bya ba gnyer pa'i bod pa mang che shos kyis rang nyid kyi gnyen don rang gis thag gcod pa dang / rus rgyud kyi ming bkol spyod byed pa'i srol nyams par gyur pas pho mo na gzhon zung gis ming gcig pu las phan tshun bar gnyen nye'i 'brel ba yod med mi shes pa dang / gal te da lta da dung rus rgyud kyi ming bkol spyod byed bzhin pa'i dbang du btang na pho mo gnyis kyi rus rgyud kyi ming las phan tshun bar gnyen nye'i 'brel ba yod med shes te/ dper na/ 'khon nyi ma tshe ring / 'gos bkra shis mtsho mo — 235 —
lta bu la mtshon na rus rgyud kyi ming gnyis las phan tshun bar gnyen nye'i 'brel ba med pa rtogs thub pa dang / gal te na gzhon pho mo zung gi rus rgyud kyi ming gcig 'dra yin tshe zhib tu rus rgyud kyi ming gi khungs ded de sha rus nye ring gi 'brel ba gsal bo zhig dris chog pas rus rgyud kyi ming gis nye du gnyen sdeb 'gog par nus pa gal chen zhig thon bzhin yod de/ ma grong gis 92de snga bod rigs kyi nye du'i 'brel ba mtshon byed gtso bo zhig ni rus rgyud kyi ming la brten nas rus khungs 'ded pa/ nye du zhes pa de rigs rus kyi 'brel ba'i gnyen bshes de pha ma gang rung gi mi rabs bdun rgyud tshun chad la gnyen sgrig byed mi chog pa de yin/ des na mi ming gi mgor rus rgyud kyi ming sbyor ba'i dgos pa ni rus rgyud kyi ming gcig pa gnyen sdeb sngon 'gog gi ched du yin par ma zad/ gnyen sgrig byed mkhan pho mo'i dbar rigs rgyud 'brel ba'i rgyang thag ji tsam ring ba de tsam gyis legs pa'i ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod pa de ni deng rabs tshan rig dang mthun pa zhig kyang yin/〉〉④ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ da lta rbad pa mang che shos la ming ma gtogs rus rgyud kyi ming med pa 'dis bod rigs nye du gnyen sdeb 'gog pa 'i thad la'ang gnod skyon chen po zhig thebs bzhin yod/ 'di las kyang nga tshos bod mi rnams la ming gcig pus mi chog par rus rgyud kyi ming nges par dgos pa gsal bor shes thub/gsum pa/ rus rgyud kyi mingastoms pa la brten nas ming gcig 'dra can mang po byung ba'i gnad don/nga tshos shes gsal ltar da lta bod kyi sa khul kun tu ming gcig 'dra can ha cang mang ba dang /de yang gtso bo bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming spyod srol nyams par gyur pas ming gcig pu ma gtogs rus rgyud kyi ming med par gyur pa dang gcig nang bstan bod du dar rjes bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming 'dogs srol la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ chos sgor zhugs pa'i grwa ba rnams la nang bstan chos — 236—
lugs kyi tha snyad ming du btags par ma zad/ khyim pa rnams la'ang nang chos kyi tha snyad mang po ming du btags pa dang gnyis las bod kyi spyi tshogs nang ming gcig 'dra can mang po thon zhing /des dus rgyun 'tsho ba'i nang du bod pa rnams la stabs mi bde ba mang po bzos dang bzo bzhin yod/ ming gcig 'dra can rnams so sor ma 'dres par ngos 'dzin pa'i ched du byed thabs kyang sna tshogs shis spyod bzhin yod de/ bod rigs kyi nang du mtshang ming can cung mang ba yang ming gcig 'dra can mang po'i gnad don las byung ba yin te/ go mus ( ṣ+ṭhaṣ+ṭha) 92bod kyi skya ser pho mo'i khrod du mtshang ming bkol spyod byed pa'i khyab che zhing / mtshang ming ni gtso bo ming gcig 'dra can dang spyir btang du phan tshun khyad par 'byed ched kha snon byas pa dang / de mang che shos lus po'i khyad chos dang bya spyod kyi thad nas btags pa mang / bod rigs khrod ming gcig 'dra can ha cang mang ba dang / dgon pa dang sde ba gcig gi nang du'ang rgyun du ming gcig 'dra can 'ga' re yod pas mtshang ming yang de la brten nas byung ba dang des ming rnams phan tshun khyad par phye par nus pa thon yod/11 ①ces gsungs/de bzhin du bod kyi rtsom pa po dang ched las mkhas pa skor zhig gis rang nyid skye sa'i rdzong dang sde ba'i ming sogs rang ming gi mgor sbyar nas ming gcig 'dra can rnams las khyad par 'byed bzhin yod de/ dper na/ 'brong rtse nyi ma don grub dang rgyal rtse nyi ma don grub/ rgya ye bkra lho dang gcan tsha bkra bho/ bya mdo don grub tshe ring dang rmog ru don grub tshe ring zhes pa lta bu ste/de dag las rgya ye dang rmog ru ni sde ba'i ming dang bya mdo ni yul gyi ming / gcan tsha dang 'brong rtse/rgyal rtse bcas ni rdzong gi ming yin/ sa ming sogs bed spyod byed pa'i gnas tshul 'di las nga tshos ming gi mgor sbyar rgyu'i rus rgyud kyi ming zhig dgos pa gsal bor rtogs thub/slob grwa zhig la mtshon na'ang 'dzin grwa gcig gi nang du rgyun par slob ma bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu tsam yod pas de'i nang du ming gcig 'dra can gyi slob ma gnyis re yod pa ni rgyun ldan gyi snang —237—
tshul zhig yin la/ skabs 'gar ming gcig 'dra can gyi slob ma gsum yod pa'i 'dzin grwa'ang yod/de'i skabs su de rnams che 'bring chung gsum du bkar nas ngos 'dzin par byed pa yin te/ dper na tshe ring don grub che ba/ tshe ring don grub 'bring ba/ tshe ring don grub chung ba zhes gzugs kyi ring thung dang lo'i che chung sogs la bltos nas khyad par 'byed pa dang / 'dzin grwa gcig gi nang du ming gcig 'dra can gyi slob ma bzhi yod tshe/ che 'bring chung gsum gyi nang du 'dus thabs med pas rgyun par sa ming dang yang na gcig gnyis gsum bzhi'i grangs ka sbyar nas slob ma rnams kyi ming 'bod par byed pa dper na/ rtsom pa pos nyis stong brgyad nas dgu lor mtsho sngon dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i mi rigs dge thon slob gling du slob skabs gnyis ring la dbyin ji bslabs pa'i 'dzin grwa zhig tu rin chen mtsho zer ba'i slob ma bzhi yod pa dang / zhon hwa rin chen mtsho dang dpa' lung rin chen mtsho/ gcan tsha rin chen mtsho dang kos nan rin chen mtsho zhes sa ming mgor sbyar nas ming 'bod dgos byung ba dang / bde skyed dang le can me gnyis kyis bshad pa ltar na 92spen pa tshe ring ches sun snang skyes pa ni ming gcig 'dra can mang ba de red/ spen pa tshe ring gis 2bod ljongs su ming la spen pa tshe ring zer ba'i bod pa shin tu mang / nga slob chung du 'gro ba'i skabs su/ 'dzin grwa'i nang du spen pa tshe ring zer ba'i slob ma bzhi yod pa dang / dge rgan gyis nga tsho'i lo'i che chung ltar ming gi mgor gcig gnyis gsum bzhi sbyar nas khyad par phye zhing / skabs der nga rang lo na ches chung bas nga'i ming la spen pa bzhi ba zhes bos pa red/ ces bshad/23 ⑩ces gsungs pa dang / de las kyang tshabs che ba'i gnas tshul zhig yod pa ni ming gcig 'dra can rnams slob grwa chen mor rgyugs sprod skabs ming phan tshun nor pa'i gnas tshul yod la/ slob ma rnams la rtsom yon dang dngos po sogs bskur yong tshe/ ming gcig 'dra can rnams phan tshun 'khrul nas rang gi rtsom yin dang dngos po gzhan gyis len pa'i gnas tshul yang byung dang 'byung bzhin yod/ bde skyid dang le can mes 82bod rang bshad pa ltar na/ lo rer 'bring rim dang slob chen gyi yig rgyugs skabs su ming gcig 'dra can mang ba'i snang tshul gyis kho tshor dka' ngal mang po bzo bzhin yod la/ kho tshos ches mnyam 'jog bya dgos pa'ang slob mar slob bsdu'i brda tho bskur skabs nor 'dzol byung srid snyam pa de red/11 6ces gsungs/ gzhan da dung da lta dra ngos su rtsom yig bkod tshe/ ming gcig 'dra can rnams phan tshun 'khrul nas gcig gis gcig la sdigs mo dang dgag bzhag byed pa sogs kyi gnas tshul mang bo 'byung bzhin yod pa 'di rnams ni bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming nyams par gyur pa las byung ba'i gnad don la 'brel yod pa yin/bzhi ba/ phyi'i rgyal khab 'grim dus snga rjes su 'phrad pa'i rus ming gi gnad don/nga tshos bod kyi rus rgyud kyi ming nyams par gyur pa de gnad don tshabs chen zhig yin par mi 'dod pa ni rgyal khab gzhan du song ma myong ba'i rkyen gyis red/ rgyal khab gzhan par song myong ba dang song nas lo gnyis gsum tsam la bsdad myong ba zhig yin na/ nga tsho bod pa rnams la rus rgyud kyi ming zhig nges par dgos snyam pa'i bsam tshul zhig ngang ngam shugs kyis skyes yong / de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhe na/ thog mar 'gro sa'i phyi rgyal gyi las khungs dang sa gnas bcas kyi mi la yi ge'i lam nas 'brel gtugs byed dus/ rang nyid kyi rus ming gsal bor 'god dgos pa dang / phyi'i rgyal khab mang che shos kyi goms srol ltar na ming sngon dang rus rgyud kyi ming rjes su 'god pa yin pas kho tshos krung go'i mi rnams la 'brel 'dris byas pa'i nyams myong ltar krung go nas yong ba'i mi tshang ma'i rus rgyud kyi ming sngon dang ming rjes su yod par 'dod de/ tshe ring rdo rje nas zhes ming bkod de yi ge bskur tshe/ kho tshos rang gi rus ming gi goms srol ltar so sor phye nas rdo rje tshe ring zhes bkod yod par ma zad/ rdo rje dang tshe ring gnyis kyi bar du bar stong zhig 'jog pa red/ de ltar mi de'i ming la tshe ring rdo rje zer bzhin du yi ge'i nang du rdo rje tshe ring zhes 'a god — 239—
pa red/ de ltar na phyi gling pa rnams kyis rdo rje ni ming dang tshe ring ni rus rgyud kyi ming yin par 'dod de rgyun du mi de la rdo rje dang yang na sku zhabs tshe ring zhes 'bod pa yin/ bod pa mang po zhig gi ming ni yig 'bru bzhi las grub na yang ming gi phyed snga phyi gnyis gang rung nas bzung ste ming 'bod par byed pa ni rgyun ldan gyi snang tshul zhig yin pas/ rgyun par snga ma'i yig 'bru gnyis kyis ming nas 'bod bzhin pa zhig la mtshon na/ dper na tshe ring rdo rje la tshe ring zhes 'bod pa lta bu zhig la phyi gling ba rnams kyis rdo rje ni ming dang tshe ring ni rus rgyud kyi ming du 'khrul nas rdo rje zhes 'bod nges yin/lhag par du nga tsho phyi'i rgyal khab 'grim dus lam yig gi ngos su rus dang ming gnyis nges par so sor bri dgos pa dang / rus med pas lam yig gi ngos su rus dang ming so sor 'god thabs bral pas nga tsho'i ming hril po rus rgyud kyi ming bri sar bkod de ming bri sar rtags tshatsho brgyab 'dug de ni ming med pa'am ming ci yin mi shes pa'i mtshon byed cig red/ gnam gru pa se nyos nas phyi'i rgyal khab tu 'gro dus pa se'i steng gi rus ming la gsal bor blta dgos te/ rgyu mtshan ni pa se'i ngos kyi ming dang / lam yig nang gi ming bri tshul cung zad mi mthun tshe gnam grur sdod du mi 'jug pa red/ dper na/ lam yig gi steng du ming med pa'i mtshon rtags 5khu brgyab yod pa dang /gnam gru pa se'i ngos su rtags de ji ma ji bzhin du 'god dgos te/ ma bkod par stong bar bskyur tshe rus ming gcig gyur min pas dus ltar gnam grur sdod mi thub la/ sgor mo mi nyung ba zhig gron par byed nges yin/phyi'i rgyal khab tu slob grwa dang dngul khang sogs gnas gang du song yang lam yig ni gnas de'i thob thang dpang yig yin pas rgyun du lam yig bkol spyod byed dgos pa dang / lam yig ngos su ming med pa mthong ma thag phyi gling pa rnams cung ha las pa'i ngang nas ming med pa'i rgyu mtshan dri bar byed pa dang / der mthud nas bod pa rnams la rus rgyud kyi ming ma gtogs med tshe rang gi a —240—
pha dang rang nyid kyi rus rgyud kyi ming gi khyad par ji ltar 'byed dgos pa sogs kyi gnas tshul yang dri bar byed/ skabs der nga tshos bod pa mang che shos la ming ma gtogs rus rgyud kyi ming med pa red zer nas lan gdab dgos pa dang / des na ci'i phyir rus rgyud kyi ming bri sar ming dang ming bri sar ci yang bkod med pa ci zhes gnas tshul zhib mor dri srid/ de nas nga tshos re re bzhin dgos med kyi gsal bshad mang po zhig bya dgos te/ bod pa rnams la gdod ma nas rus rgyud kyi ming yod tshul/ de nas rim bzhin nyams par gyur te da lta bod pa mang che shos la ming ma gtogs rus rgyud kyi ming med tshul/ yang lam yig gi ngos su nges par rus rgyud kyi ming 'god dgos tshul sogs bshad dgos pa dang / des phyi gling pa mang po zhig la bod kyi rus ming gi spyod tshul ha cang rnyog 'dzing che ba zhig red snyam pa'i 'dod tshul zhig skye ru 'jug pa red/ de bas phyi'i rgyal khab tu song myong ba'i bod pa zhig yin na bod kyi rus ming la gnad don chen po zhig 'dug ces mi bshad mkhan ha cang nyung ba dang / rang gis rang la rus rgyud kyi ming zhig 'dogs dgos zhes bshad mkhan yang yod/de dang 'dra bar da dung rus ming gi gnad don mang po zhig la 'phrad srid de/ rgyun par phyi'i rgyal khab tu re'u mig sogs bri skabs rus rgyud kyi ming dang ming so sor bri dgos pa dang / skabs der nga tshos mi 'dod bzhin du ming hril po rus rgyud kyi ming bri sar bkod dgos pa dang / ming bri sar ming med pa'i mtshon rtags 05 bri dgos pa red/ ming hril po phyed snga phyi gnyis su phye nas gcig ni rus rgyud kyi ming gi stong cha'i nang du bri ba dang / gzhan cig shos de ming gi stong cha'i nang du bris chog mod/ yin na yang gzhan pas nga tsho'i lam yig dang bsdur nas lta dus gcig mthun min pas de ltar bri mi rung ba red/ rus rgyud kyi ming nyams par gyur pa des mi 'dod bzhin du nga tshor ngo gnong dgos pa'i gnad don mang po zhig la kha gtad du bcug pas de rnams nges par thag gcod dgos snyam/—241—
